New and/or existing symbols fill the gaps each time, and this gives you a dynamic reels mechanic.If you manage to remove all the blocker tiles via exploding winning symbols, you are rewarded with a spin on the Feature Wheel. This gives you either 4 or 7 free spins, the bonus trail feature, or the super bonus trail feature. You can gamble your free spins to upgrade to the bonus trail, and you have a 33 % chance with 4 FS and 52 % chance with 7 FS. Losing the gamble takes you back to the base game.In the Free Spins round, you’ll see that some of the blocker tiles come with bombs attached. These bombs go off when adjacent to a winning combo, and this turns all symbols on the relevant reel into a random matching symbol type. The symbol transformation feature always optimizes for the best possible win, and you get +3 extra spins if you clear all blocker tiles.The Bonus Trail feature comes with a token that moves 1 to 6 positions along the trail per turn. You start with 3 fuel can lives, and a life is lost per turn. Landing on a fuel can resets the tally to 3 again, but this also removes the fuel can from the trail. Running out of lives, or hitting the win cap, means the feature ends.Regular trail positions come with cash prizes up to 1,000x, and landing on truck positions gives you a bonus modifier. Silver trucks can give any of the below listed modifiers, while the golden truck always gives you the persistent or collect all feature. All cash prizes are multiplied by x3 if you make a full round, and this also upgrades the number of lives by +1. Here’s an overview of the modifiers:In the Super Bonus Trail, you get a golden truck in the position that’s closest to the starting point. It’s a silver truck in the regular bonus trail feature. Non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can purchase a spin on the Feature Wheel for 50x the stake. The regular Bonus Trail costs 90x your stake, while the Super Bonus Trail sets you back 250x your stake.The almost 5-minute highlights video starts off with a bang, as you get to see a longer cascading win sequence which triggers a spin on the feature wheel. Regular wins hardly pay that much though, due to the low symbol values, so you really need to trigger features to do damage in this game. That being said, anything is possible with up to 46,656 ways to win.The visual presentation of the trail is a tad less impressive than it was in Dead Man’s Trail, but the feature is still highly entertaining. A full 3D world where the camera can swoop down to zoom in on the action would be next level, but you’re stuck with the bird’s eye view like before. The trail can be frustrating when things don’t go your way, but it’s also highly unpredictable. Don’t be afraid to try out different strategies and amounts and see which one will have you hitting all the right notes. Just remember, the longer you play and the more you bet, the better chance you have of hitting the game’s magical jackpot!

The Magic Flute may send you spinning with the exciting bonuses and payouts offered. But be warned– the Queen of the Night is the only one who can substitute symbols as the Wild, and the Scatter symbol is the elusive magical flute. If you manage to find three, you’ll get 15 free spins, with a chance to triple your winnings! What could possibly go wrong?

Match Papina and Tamino symbols for a payout that’ll make you feel like the wealthiest flutist in all the land. sc_description: Relax Gaming has seen decent success with their previous - and first - collaborative effort with the CasinoGrounds streaming community, and Beast Mode is visually similar to Iron Bank, at least with regards to the pastel color scheme and the anthropomorphic animal characters. The pace of the game is excellent, but the 25,000x potential is almost half of what the predecessor, Iron Bank, offers. The premiums pay between 2.5 and 25 x your stake for 6 of a kind wins, and the bling necklace Wild symbol steps in for all pay symbols to help complete winning combos. The wild holds no value of its own, and it appears on reels 2-6 only.All winning symbols are removed via the Cascading Wins mechanic, making room for new and/or existing symbols to drop down to fill the gaps. This process repeats as long as you keep winning, which gives you indefinite winning streaks from a single spin.You will trigger the Random Mystery Spin feature in the base game at random times, and it awards a minimum of 1 mystery symbol. The mystery symbols reveal a randomly selected matching symbol, and they remain in play for the whole cascading sequence. They change to a new symbol type per cascade though, but pure mystery symbol wins is not enough to keep the cascades going. You need to involve non-mystery symbols as well.You trigger the Bonus Round when 3-4 bonus scatters are collected in the same cascading sequence, and landing only 3 scatters gives you the option of gambling for the top-tier feature that you get directly from 4 scatters. You can choose between 3 different features, and each feature comes with either +1, +2 or +3 extra spins symbols to top you up.The Mystery Symbols Bonus Round comes with 6 free spins (or 10 in the top-tier version), and all mystery symbols that appear drop to the lowest possible position. They remain in play for the duration of the feature, revealing a randomly chosen matching symbol per spin and cascade. A special Bomb symbol expands the 4 middle reels by +1 row when it lands, and these reels can get up to 7 positions in total. You get +3 extra spins per row increase, and a maxed out grid gives you 38,416 win ways.The Multiplier Ladder Bonus Round starts you out with 8 free spins (or 9 in the top-tier version), and the multiplier ladder goes as follows: x1 to x20, x25, x30, x35, x40, x45, x50, x60, x70, x80, x90, x100, x150, x200, x300, x400 and x500. attr_description: NoLimit City had a very successful 2020, and with San Quentin xWays they’ve already - in the very first month of 2021 - released a strong contestant for the game of the year awards. This developer keeps pushing boundaries like few others, and even the theme of this game is somewhat unheard of. Parody prison slots exist in abundance, yes, but nothing with this kind of gritty realism has ever been let loose before.Granted, the designers have wisely taken the edge off somewhat with the semi-realistic, cartoon-style visuals, and the soundtrack sounds like a never-ending Metallica intro. You’ll meet Crazy Joe, Heinrich 3rd, Loco Luis, Biker Bill and Beefy Dick on the reels, with guard towers looming in the background. Bring your sharpest shiv, and be careful with the soap, cause this brutal beast might just turn you into its bitch before you can say “Lockdown”.Both the top and bottom rows of the reels are locked Enhancer Cells positions. Look closely, and you will see inmates work out or walk restlessly back and forth in their respective cells. The Enhancer Cells will open when you land 1 or 2 scatters, and they reveal premium symbols, wilds, xWay symbols or Razor Splits symbols.If you get the Razor Splits symbol from an Enhanced Cell, all regular symbols on that reel will split in two, increasing the number of win ways accordingly. If you get a Razor Splits from both the top and bottom position, the regular symbols split into 4. The xWays symbol will always reveal a randomly chosen matching symbol in stacks of 4.The scatter symbol is a depiction of a guard tower, and you need 3, 4 or 5 scatters anywhere in sight to trigger the Lockdown bonus round. This gives you 1, 2 or 3 Jumping Wilds, respectively. How many free spins you get is decided randomly by numbers between 1 and 3 that appear in the open Enhancer Cells. The Enhancer Cells from the triggering reels will remain open throughout the Lockdown Spins feature.The reels will then spin to determine which one of the 5 inmate symbols that will be beefed up with a multiplier. You can also get the Jumping Wild as your chosen symbol here. The triggering reels land with a mystery symbol, and you get the same multiplier value attached to the randomly chosen symbol as the number of scatters you triggered the feature with.The Lockdown Spins take place in the yard, and more precisely on the basketball court. You will see silhouettes of inmates cheering on the riot, as cells are burning in the background. The Jumping Wilds move around to random positions on each free spin, but they can also come with multipliers attached. A Razor Split will effectively double the multiplier value on any Jumping Wild on the same reel.You can double the jumping multiplier wilds all the way up to x512, but this is not a regular win multiplier as you might be used to from other games. Instead, the multiplier value indicates the number of wild symbols contained in that position.When you land a scatter symbol on a free spin, both Enhancer Cells on that reel are opened and you get an extra free spin. The scatter then becomes a Jumping Wild, unless you already have 3 from before.As usual from NoLimit City, non-UK players have the option to buy the bonus round. You can choose between 1, 2 or 3 Jumping Wilds, and the price tag for the most potentially lucrative option became legendary long before the game was even released.You will need to cough up a whopping 2,000x your stake for 3 Jumping Wilds, while 1 or 2 Jumping Wilds will set you back 100x and 400x your stake, respectively. Your best shot at the 150,000x max win comes from the 3 Jumping Wilds option, and the RTP also increases to 96.95 %, if you dare.NoLimit has stated that they are unsure if the world is ready for this game, but we’ve certainly been ready for a long time. After a while of base game grinding, we couldn’t wait any longer, so we decided to buy the Lockdown Spins feature. We went with the 2 Jumping Wilds option, and you can see how it all went in the 5-minute highlights video below. The bonus round starts around 1 minute into the video, if you just want the best part.It’s safe to say that NoLimit City starts the new year with a bang. San Quentin xWays is not only a milestone release for the highly successful Swedish developer, but for the whole industry as such. The hardcore convict theme is daring enough, but then you have the insane 150,000x potential to boot. Granted, it took 1.83 billion spins for that to happen during testing, and you should also know that you need the 5-scatter bonus round to stand a chance to get even close to such numbers.The volatility is as brutal as the tattooed inmates depicted, and you will mostly land smaller payouts during the lengthy base game grinding sessions. Regular symbols are not worth all that much, and you need to rack up some serious Jumping Wild multipliers to truly benefit from the bonus round. As groundbreaking and “cool” as the 2,000x bonus buy option is, let’s face it, very few players will ever go there. This powder keg of a game is bound to be on everyone’s lips in 2021, and it might very well be that we’ve already seen the game of the year in the very first month.ProsConsPunk Rocker - has a somewhat similar vibe as the game at hand, but it’s a few notches down on the badass scale. You will benefit from xWays mystery symbols here too, as well as respins with sticky wilds and a bonus round with 5 different modifiers.Deadwood - is a gritty wild west slot from NoLimit City, and it’s loosely inspired by the HBO cult series by the same name. You can win up to 13,950x in the Shoot Out Free Spins round, and it combines the extras from the 2 lower-tier features.Warrior Graveyard - is the hard-hitting follow-up game to Barbarian Fury, and NoLimit is not holding back in either of these titles. The game depicts the aftermath of war, and the progressive xNudge Multiplier will not reset in the bonus round.

Theme & Graphics in Joker Split

There are countless slots built around the joker from a traditional deck of playing cards, but this particular game stands out somewhat. First of all, the joker is female. She also comes with a couple of special tricks, such as multipliers and the ability to split in two.

The 6×6 reel grid sits in the middle of an olde worlde town square, for instance, while nearby chickens cluck away in the background. Anyone familiar with Relax Gaming slots will immediately recognise the control panel beneath the grid. The overall look-and-feel is highly reminiscent of other titles from this developer.

Most new slots contain some sort of tumble or cascade mechanism, but not Joker Split. Still, there are several other interesting features in this game, as you’re about to discover.

Next we have the joker-related paraphernalia; a pair of blue dice, plus two different sets of juggling equipment. All of these pay 0.5x for five, up to a maximum of 20x.

The final regular symbol is the king’s crown, which returns 30x for a cluster of 15 or more. A combination of five will earn you 1x.

A large letter “B” framed in gold is the game’s scatter, or bonus symbol. Collect three, four or five anywhere on the reels and you’ll win five, six or seven free spins.

The game’s wild symbol is a female joker, which can substitute for any standard symbol. In addition, they sometimes appear with a multiplier, which increases wins accordingly. If more than one multiplier is used, the numbers are added together.

Splitting Wild Respins

However, if a wild forms part of a winning cluster, it splits into two and triggers a respin. Any wilds collected from the previous spin then jump back onto the grid.

Should a wild land on a space that’s already occupied by another wild, their respective multipliers will be added together.

During the free spins bonus, any wilds which have turned gray are stored in a box to the left of the reels. They’ll eventually turn into regular wilds, jumping back into play on the first respin of every free spin.

attr_description: Not only did Monopoly Live win the Gaming Intelligence Award for Best Game in 2019, but Evolution also landed the prestigious EGR Award for Game of the Year. The first time we saw the Augmented Reality (AR) version of Mr Monopoly do his live studio antics, and step into the stunning 3D-animated city with the classic board game smack in the middle, we were basically sold.This live game takes the already popular Dream Catcher to a whole new level, and any fan of the physical game will be filled with awe the first time the camera takes you on a sweeping tour around the board. The surrounding city is brimming with life, and it’s almost like you wish Mr Monopoly guy would step off the board for just a minute, and take a stroll down main street.The massive Dream Catcher-inspired Monopoly Wheel of Fortune comes with 54 segments. Each segment is separated by pins that help slow down the Wheel, and it will eventually come to a grinding halt with one segment as the winner.Before the live host spins the Money Wheel however, you will choose between 4 different numbers to bet on. These are numbers 1, 2, 5 and 10, and they pay the same amount as the number (ie. 1x, 2x, 5x and 10x). You can also bet on 2 different variations of the bonus game, one with 2 rolls and another option with 4 rolls.You have 12 seconds to place your bets up front, and all bets are off a few seconds after the Money Wheel starts spinning. You can place bets on multiple numbers, and/or bonus games, or all of them if you wish. 48 of the equally sized Wheel segments are numbers, while you also have 2 Chance segments and 4 Bonus Roll segments.You can go with the Frequent Feature bonus round, and this simply means that you will benefit from more frequent Shooting Wilds and Valkyrie Undercover symbol transformations.Landing on the Chance segments means that a Chance card will be drawn. This will either award an instant cash prize, or a multiplier will upgrade all the Money Wheel values. If the latter is the case, the Wheel is spun again with all the bets in place. You can get up to a 10x multiplier of the Wheel numbers this way, and if you get a new multiplier on the extra spin, it will multiply with the previous multiplier.The best case scenario however, happens if the multiplier is followed by the Roll Bonus Game. This is where the real fun starts. You’ll see the augmented reality Mr Monopoly guy wander off the live studio. He then emerges to step onto the classic monopoly board surrounded by an amazing 3D city with a fairground in the middle.You will first be taken for a sweeping tour around the board, as Mr Monopoly assigns multipliers to the different board positions. The default multiplier values range from 1x to 100x, with Mayfair as the most lucrative property. However, if you had a 10x multiplier card from before, for example, the starting values are 10x to 1,000x around the board.No matter if you have a multiplier from the chance card from before, or not, Mr Monopoly Man will always assign random multipliers up to 10x to certain properties before the bonus game starts. Combine that with a multiplier card value of 10x, and things could get really interesting with properties worth up to 10,000x your stake.You get either 2 rolls or 4 rolls, depending on which bonus game version you triggered. You will get 1 extra dice roll whenever you roll a double (ie. 5 and 5, for example). As you roll the dice, Mr Monopoly will move around the board accordingly, and you win whatever property multiplier he lands on. Of course, the further you go from the starting position, the more valuable the properties will be.If Mr Monopoly manages to go a full round around the board, all the property values will be doubled. Mr Monopoly can land on a Chance Card and Community Chest also, and this can award you cash prizes. However, this can also reduce your current winnings from the bonus game.If you land on income tax or super tax, you will lose 10 % or 20 % of your winnings, respectively. What you really want to avoid is going to jail. You will then be stuck, and have to roll doubles to get out. Since you have so few rolls to start with (2 or 4 in total), this can break your whole bonus round if you’re unlucky.Pretty much everyone has a nostalgic relationship to the classic Monopoly board game, at least if you grew up before video games took over completely. Evolution has won multiple prizes for Best Game with Monopoly Live, including EGR Operators Award for game of the year 2019. This is well deserved in our view, as this is truly innovative live gaming at its very best.The regular “base game” is perhaps not all that exciting, but the Roll Bonus Game is simply stunning. Having Mr Monopoly as an animated AR figure in-studio with the live host is also something brand new, and the bonus game offers massive payouts up to £500,000. Of course, the RTP and volatility will depend on your bet here, and certain bets come with theoretical returns as low as 91.30 %.ProsConsDream Catcher - is the original template this Monopoly version is based upon. Dream Catcher is much simpler however, and it comes with 2x and 7x multiplier segments on the Money Wheel. You can still win up to a capped max win of £500,000 though, which is solid.Monopoly Megaways - is a grand slot version to check out, and it comes with cascading wins and up to 117,649 win ways. The Reel Adventure bonus game mimics the board game, and you can win up to 15,000x via the unlimited progressive multiplier in the bonus round.Slingo Monopoly - is a highly entertaining hybrid between bingo and slots, and the Monopoly theme really shines here too. You move around the board to win cash prizes and other bonus features here, but the max win potential is not even close to what the live game at hand offers.

Sugar Monster Details, RTP and Volatility

Regular Symbols

Wild

The titular Sugar Monster serves as the Wild, replacing all regular symbols in an interesting animation. It eats up these symbols to fill the Sugar Level progress bar at the top of the grid. Once full, the free spins round begins.

Scatters

Sugar Monster does not have a dedicated Scatter symbol.

Scatter Wins

Whereas many online slots use paylines, the Sugar Monster slot opts for a Scatter Wins system. If 12 or more identical symbols appear simultaneously anywhere on the grid, you’ll win a prize.

Symbol Cascade

At the end of each spin, all winning symbols are removed from the grid so that new ones can drop in to replace them. This continues until no more wins are formed.

Cotton Multiplier

One unique power that the Sugar Monster possesses is the ability to barf out cotton candies after ingesting enough sugar. These random multiplier symbols come with values ranging from x2 to x100, and they’re applied after each spin.

Some years after the release of the original part, NetEnt produced a Christmas Edition just in time for the winter festive season of 2015, and this year players are once again offered to return to the fruit shop, but now with some enhancements.With the acquisition of Red Tiger studios, NetEnt finally obtained Big Time Gaming's license for producing slots on the base of the Megaways engine. It didn't take long for the first overhaul to be made, and Fruit Shop is the third NetEnt's classic game to get an injection of Megaways steroids. Back in 2011, Fruit Shop was a huge sensation once released with its light-hearted design and exciting Free Spins feature. And now, 10 years after, it's given a rebirth with a similar concept at the core, but greatly enlargened reel set.The gameplay is not the only thing that NetEnt retained as the developers also kept the original DNA in terms of the design. The Megaways version boasts the same charming cartoonish graphics and simple drawing style, though, a couple of changes are immediately apparent. Alongside an expanded game area, the look is now supplemented by a new wallpaper showcasing dense vegetation and crystal clear blue sky.Playable on any device, Fruit Shop Megaways allows players to place wagers from 0.2$ to 100$ per spin. In comparison to the original Fruit Shop, this version comes with a cut-down payback percentage. It's still slightly above the average level at 96.06%, so it's not that crucial. Anyway, the trade-off is a bumped-up volatility level, meaning better prizes are now available. Hence, wins of up to 10,000x of the bet on a single spin are theoretically possible.As we head to the paytable, we see a bunch of recognizable symbols taken from the first part of Fruit Shop. The symbol collection includes 10 regular symbols, split into two categories. The pay symbols start on the lower end with classic A-10 royals, which are followed in ascending order by watermelons, oranges, lemons, plums, and cherries. Scoring wins requires matching at least 3 symbols on a line starting from the leftmost reel, while only 2 are needed for the cherries. The game's logo symbol is Wild and it helps you form winning combos by substituting for any other regular symbols. It lands only on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5.From the gameplay perspective, Fruit Shop Megaways is light on changes. NetEnt a bit rethought how Multipliers should be applied, but other than that, no significant adjustments to be found here as players will benefit from the same Free Spins feature, plus some Megaways magic. Depending on the number of symbols involved in a combo, the amount of spins awarded varies from 2 to 5. A combination of 3, 4, 5, and 6 fruits awards 2, 3, 4, and 5 free spins respectively. Meanwhile, as cherries pay starting from 2 symbols only, 1 spin can be obtained for a 2-of-a-kind combination of these berries.Retriggers are also possible, though, now low-paying symbol combos count too. Thereby, up to 4 additional spins can be awarded when a combo with any royal symbols occurs, while premiums still award up to 5. Another major change is that a progressive multiplier comes into play during the Free Spins feature. It starts at 1x and increases by 1 with every winning spin, with the cap at 10x.NetEnt slowly but steadily expands its Megaways suite of slots, and it's only a matter of time before other cult slots get a remake. There's still a lot of anticipation of overhauls of huge titles like Starburst and Dead or Alive, just to give two examples, but for now, the devs just seem to drum up some interest and release more or less sought-after slots. Even though NetEnt doesn't use the complete grace of the Megaways engine, cutting down some features, the game still feels like a decent follow-up to classic Fruit Shop. Either it's just a lazy approach or a nod to the past that the developers kept nearly every aspect of the game almost untouched, fans of the original slot won't find anything to complain about here. Fire in the Hole Slot Review

This Fire In The Hole review looks at a mining-themed slot from an innovative and award-winning developer. Nolimit City is known for producing games with extremely high levels of volatility and massive potential wins, and this March 2021 release is no exception.

Prepare to delve deep underground and learn all about this 96.06% RTP slot, including the Lucky Wagon Spins and xBomb Wild features.

RTP 96.06%

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.20 – $50

Number of Paylines Up to 46,656

Basic Details of the Fire In The Hole Slot

Fire In The Hole Details, RTP and Volatility

Let’s begin our Fire In The Hole review with a look at the game’s key stats. Most versions of this game offer a solid 96.06% RTP. Take care though, for some casinos use less-rewarding rates of 94.11% and 90.02%.

A maximum potential win of 60,000x awaits, a figure that blows most slots out of the water. That figure is due to the extremely high volatility level, which is a common feature of Nolimit City titles.

The action takes place on a grid of six reels and three rows, though more can be uncovered as you mine. This makes for a possible 46,656 paylines on which to form wins. Play from $0.20 per spin, up to a maximum of $50.

A bet of $1 is set, seen in the bottom-left corner. Above this is a yellow star symbol which opens the Feature Buy menu.

Theme & Graphics in Fire In The Hole

As slot themes go, mining is fairly common, but Nolimit City always knows how to differentiate itself from the crowd. This release is not as dark as many of the developer’s other titles, but there is still a moody undertone.

Gameplay marches along to a slow-paced, heavy tune, punctuated by the explosions of mining activity. During the bonus, this music becomes even more ominous, and wouldn’t feel out of place in a Rammstein track. What’s more, the game’s main character is an angry-looking dwarf who can be heard snarling.

Fire In The Hole Slot Features

Like many Nolimit City slots, there are plenty of features to keep us entertained. We’ll discuss these in the following section of our Fire In The Hole review.

Regular Symbols

Ten ordinary symbols are used to form winning combinations. The five lower-paying playing card icons are K through 9. These pay between 0.2x and 0.3x for three on a payline, up to a maximum of 1.5x for six.

Five higher-paying symbols are depictions of mining equipment. From lowest to highest, these are the pickaxe, rope, mining boots, satchel and lantern. The highest-paying symbol returns 7.5x for six on a payline, with smaller prizes of 4x, 2x and 0.75x for five, four and three.

Collapsing Mine

At the beginning of each spin, you’ll notice three active rows, with three more covered. To unlock those and cause the mine to collapse, creating additional ways to win, one of three things must happen:

Form a winning combination;

Trigger the Wild Mining feature;

Blow up an xBomb wild with no win.

Winning symbols involved in a collapse are removed, making way for more to tumble in.

Wild Mining

Should you line up three, four or five of the same symbol horizontally without a win, the Wild Mining feature triggers. The symbols which activated the bonus are removed, leaving wilds in the central positions. That means one wild symbol for a line of three, with two and three resulting from a line of four or five.

In addition, all other regular symbols are blown from the reels, replaced with new ones.

xBomb Wilds

The xBomb Wild acts as any regular-paying symbol to create wins. If a spin results in a payout, any xBomb Wilds on screen will explode, wiping out adjacent symbols and allowing new ones to fall onto the grid. This occurs regardless of whether or not the wilds were involved in forming the win.

Every exploding xBomb Wild increases the multiplier by one, enhancing the next payout.

Scatters

A gold nugget bearing the letter “S” serves as the game’s scatter. Collect three, four or five to activate the Lucky Wagon Spins. Three triggering scatters opens up two rows of the bonus game’s reels. For each additional scatter, an extra row is uncovered.

Lucky Wagon Spins

You’ll start the feature with three spins, but for every coin that appears, the counter resets. As you play, carriages on the top row reveal various game modifiers, detailed below:

Coin Values: This sets the value of any coins appearing below. It can range from 1x to 100x.

Multipliers: Carts full of gold represent multipliers. These enhance the values of any coins already on the reel below, ranging from 2x to 25x.

Dynamite: These perform multiple actions. It first increases the coin value by the number of sticks of dynamite, before blowing up blocked positions and activating chests on the bottom row.

Bag: Coins on that reel are bagged up and deposited into one space.

Chest: All coins on the grid are collected and deposited into one space.

Dwarf: This collects all coins on the reels like the chest, but continues to do so for subsequent spins.

Feature Buy

Buy your way directly into the feature using the yellow star symbol, which presents you with three options:

60x: two open rows;

157x: three open rows;

500x: all four rows open.

One free spin remains during the feature, seen in the top-left. Seven coins lie on the reels for a combined 42x multiplier.

How to Play Fire In The Hole Online

Before playing Nolimit City’s Fire In The Hole slot, select a stake by tapping the coin icon in the bottom-left corner. You may also toggle the lightning bolt symbol opposite to change the gameplay speed.

When you’re ready, hit the curved arrow to spin. Alternatively, use the triangular “play” button to configure as many as 1,000 automatic spins. To win, match at least three symbols on a payline from left to right, starting from the first reel.

Try the Fire In The Hole Demo for Free before playing for real money

With so many features and mechanics to get your head around, we strongly recommend trying our free Fire In The Hole game. This allows you to learn how the game works before risking real money. It’s always better to make your mistakes in demonstration mode first.

Fire In The Hole Review – Our Final Verdict

We love Nolimit City slots. They usually feature large maximum potential payouts, as well as dark and creative storylines that often contain controversial elements. However, with the release of Fire In The Hole xBomb, the developer managed to steer away from any negative press. In addition, the now-popular xBomb Wild was introduced.

This is a great addition, which really spices up the boring old wild symbol, bringing the game to life. What’s more, the dynamic reel grid and Wild Mining features keep you on your toes and it feels like there’s always something happening.

Admittedly, not everyone will enjoy the high volatility level. At least there’s a Feature Buy, with three different settings, to help offset that. A minor gripe is that the feature itself took a little while to understand. Still, once you’ve seen it in action a few times, it comes together nicely and is a thoroughly enjoyable bonus game.

attr_description: The historical Gautama Buddha was all into ‘The Golden Middle Way’, and we can only wonder what this enlightened Avatar - famous for his ‘4 noble truths’ - would think of something like Buddha Megaways. Gambling is hardly part of the ‘Noble Eightfold Path’ as far as we can figure, although it can certainly teach people a sense of self-discipline. You’ll need both discipline and a non-restless mind to stay with this game very long however, as it gets boring real quick.The audiovisual presentation is pretty generic, although a tad better than the ‘communist grey’ stone tiles that fills the screen in Booongo’s Megaways debut effort, Aztec Pyramid Megaways. The cascading win multiplier leads mostly to top-up wins in the base game, if even that, and the 12,500x potential is most likely to be cracked when the unlimited multiplier only keeps building in the bonus round.You get between 2 and 7 symbol positions randomly for all 6 reels per spin, and this generates between 64 and 117,649 ways to win. You need matching symbols on at least 3 adjacent reels starting from the uttermost left to win, and the premium animal icon symbols pay between 2 and 10 x your stake. The golden Buddha statue Wild steps in for all pay symbols to help complete winning combos, and it appears on reels 2 to 5 only.The Wild holds no value of it’s own however, but each win triggers the Collapsing Symbols feature. This means that all winning symbols are removed from the grid, leading to new and/or existing symbols cascading down from above to fill the gaps. This process repeats as long as you keep winning, and the progressive win multiplier increases by +1 per cascade. The multiplier resets between base game rounds though.Landing 3+ golden temple scatters anywhere in view in the same collapsing sequence triggers the Free Spins round. More precisely, you’ll win 10, 15, 20 or 25 free spins when you land 3, 4, 5 or 6 scatters in the same cascading sequence, and the progressive win multiplier does not reset between bonus round spins.You can choose to gamble for extra spins up front if you wish, and up to 30 free spins can be won at the most. If you land on the losing segment of the bonus wheel on your first or second attempt, the bonus round is lost. Losing after reaching the top 2 tiers simply bumps you down to a tier that awards fewer free spins.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone living in an eligible jurisdiction, may take advantage of the Bonus Buy feature. This will set you back 100x your stake, and it guarantees 3+ scatters to land on the spin that follows.You get to see a few base game cascading wins, before we purchase the bonus round at 0:45 into the 2-minute highlights video. We decided to try the gamble for extra spins system, and we succeeded to get 15 free spins. We didn’t dare push our luck any further than that though, and you can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.While Buddha Megaways is a tad more colorful than Booongo’s less-than-memorable Megaways debut, Aztec Pyramid Megaways, it comes with several drawbacks in comparison. The max megaways feature has been removed from this second effort, and the 50,000x potential from the first release has been reduced to 12,500x your stake here. What you get instead is a collapsing/cascading reels multiplier that’s active also in the base game.You’ll mostly collect top-up wins in the base game grind though, and the bonus round would be textbook Megaways if it wasn’t for the up-front gamble for extra spins option. It’s a risky feature to say the least, but it might appeal to certain daredevils out there. The free spins round itself plays out with a non-resetting and unlimited progressive win multiplier, which increases your odds for larger payouts.ProsConsThai Flower Megaways - takes you to the land of smiles and buddha, and this is a beefed up version of Reel Time Gaming’s original exotic release. It comes with up to 15,625 ways to win, and the bonus round plays out with 3 randomly pre-selected symbols for payouts up to 50,000x your stake.Aztec Pyramid Megaways - is the first ever Megaways release from Booongo, and it comes with similar exploding stone tile symbols that can generate up to 117,649 ways to win. The megaways can be maxed out at random times, and the collapsing wins feature increases the win multiplier per spin with no upper limit in the bonus round. This can lead to 50,000x payouts at the most.Fu Fortunes Megaways - is a volatile, oriental-themed dynamic reels release from iSoftBet, and the licensed feature comes with up to 46,656 win ways in this installment. All the low-paying symbols are removed in the bonus round, and wilds can trigger up to x20 multipliers. There are jackpots up to 1,000x up for grabs as well, and the overall max win is 25,000x your stake.

attr_description: Based on NetEnt's classic slot, Fruit Shop Megaways is a beefed-up version of the original Fruit Shop, bringing an extra layer of entertainment with flashy Megaways mechanics. Some years after the release of the original part, NetEnt produced a Christmas Edition just in time for the winter festive season of 2015, and this year players are once again offered to return to the fruit shop, but now with some enhancements.With the acquisition of Red Tiger studios, NetEnt finally obtained Big Time Gaming's license for producing slots on the base of the Megaways engine. It didn't take long for the first overhaul to be made, and Fruit Shop is the third NetEnt's classic game to get an injection of Megaways steroids. Back in 2011, Fruit Shop was a huge sensation once released with its light-hearted design and exciting Free Spins feature. And now, 10 years after, it's given a rebirth with a similar concept at the core, but greatly enlargened reel set.The gameplay is not the only thing that NetEnt retained as the developers also kept the original DNA in terms of the design. The Megaways version boasts the same charming cartoonish graphics and simple drawing style, though, a couple of changes are immediately apparent. Alongside an expanded game area, the look is now supplemented by a new wallpaper showcasing dense vegetation and crystal clear blue sky.Playable on any device, Fruit Shop Megaways allows players to place wagers from 0.2$ to 100$ per spin. In comparison to the original Fruit Shop, this version comes with a cut-down payback percentage. It's still slightly above the average level at 96.06%, so it's not that crucial. Anyway, the trade-off is a bumped-up volatility level, meaning better prizes are now available. Hence, wins of up to 10,000x of the bet on a single spin are theoretically possible.As we head to the paytable, we see a bunch of recognizable symbols taken from the first part of Fruit Shop. The symbol collection includes 10 regular symbols, split into two categories. The pay symbols start on the lower end with classic A-10 royals, which are followed in ascending order by watermelons, oranges, lemons, plums, and cherries. Scoring wins requires matching at least 3 symbols on a line starting from the leftmost reel, while only 2 are needed for the cherries. The game's logo symbol is Wild and it helps you form winning combos by substituting for any other regular symbols. The game is set in some kind of temple, with towering but ornate columns either side of the 5×3 reel grid. Candles illuminate an otherwise dim and gloomy room, while a relaxing sitar can be heard playing as you spin the reels.

Lord Ganesha himself serves as the scatter, which is the key to unlocking the game’s only bonus feature. He is beautifully depicted, with his famous elephant head, four arms and broken tusk faithfully recreated. Scatters can appear on any reel.

You can pay 75 % more per base game spin via the Scatter Boost ante bet feature, however, and this doubles your bonus round chances (as well as increasing the RTP to 96.78 %).You need at least 3 scatters in view to trigger the Plinko Bonus Round, and each scatter comes with a random number. The summed up number of all the triggering scatters becomes the number of starting drops in the Plinko Bonus Game. Each ball that hits a bumper, which can happen multiple times per ball, increases the meter above the grid. Fill the meter to level up and get +10 extra balls that play out on the next level.Each level-up doubles the number of total balls that will drop. Level 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 awards 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256 balls in total per round, respectively. Worry not, however, as you can always switch on the ante bet to shorten the gaps between the all-important and super-captivating Plinko Bonus Round. The regular bonus hit rate is a pretty solid 1 in 100 spins, while it increases to 1 in 50 spins when you pay for extra scatters via the ante bet.It was hard to put this thing down to actually get the review written, and we can’t wait to get back to drop more balls down that bumper grid. It’s no wonder this concept is so insanely popular in Japan, and hopefully this release can spark a fire also in the west. You forget all about winnings when the balls bounce all over as they trickle down the matrix, and you just want the pine man to hit the bell so you get extra drops. The 10,000x potential is solid though, and we really hope this release gets the mainstream attention it deserves.

Markus Antl Head of Sales and Key Account Management, GreentubeTrue to the style, the actions of the Golden Book of Ra slot take place in Egypt, and players will find themselves somewhere in a pharaoh's tomb. However, keep in mind that bigger wins are possible with progressive jackpots.As we head over to the paytable, we see a bunch of recognizable symbols that are split into highs and lows. The lower lot is made up of A-10 royals, and the premiums include in ascending order scarabs, totems, pharaohs, and explorers. Three or more low symbols landing adjacently on the reels starting from the leftmost create a winning combo, while higher symbols pay from two-of-a-kind and more. Five-of-a-kind combinations are worth from 10x to 15x the stake for low symbols and from 75x to 500x the stake for high symbols. Contrary to what you might expect, Wilds are represented by Eye of Horus symbols instead of classic book symbols. They can appear on all reels to substitute for any other regular symbols in winning combinations, plus they have values of their own, paying as much as the highest premium symbol.Look out for bonus symbols that always appear with a random cash prize or a free spins number. When 6 or more instances appear simultaneously on the reels, the Lock and Spin feature comes into play. The possible prize values are 1x, 2x, 3x, 10x, and 20x your bet or 1, 2, 3, and 5 free spins.Anyway, back to the feature, it plays on special reels where only bonus symbols appear. Players receive 3 respins to start with, while all triggering symbols lock in place for the remainder of the bonus. When a new bonus symbol lands, it also sticks to the reels, as well as resets the respins counter. Bonus symbols can also display special rewards and award one of the following prizes:Moreover, filling the entire reels with bonus symbols awards an additional Grand Jackpot prize. Once all positions are filled or the player runs out of respins, all cash values and free spins in view will be summed up and paid as a total prize.Before the Free Spins feature kicks off, a random regular symbol is chosen to turn into a special expanding symbol, which pay anywhere on the grid, even on non-adjacent reels. Whenever a winning combination is possible, the special symbol expands to cover the reel entirely and awards a payout across all 10 winlines.During the free games, special Book symbols become available. Landing 3 of them scattered on any of the reels on a single spin during the feature awards +10 extra free spins. However, Wild and bonus symbols are not available in the bonus game.Last but not least is the Gamble feature that allows you to increase your winnings. Whenever you score a payout during the base game, you will be offered a Gamble, where the aim is to guess the card suit correctly to double your win. The feature is repeatable up to 5 times. However, should you guess incorrectly, all winnings will be lost.If you enjoy slots like Golden Book of Ra Cash Connection, then you should definitely also check out the following alternatives:  Cash Connection Book of Ra - is an exciting slot game combining adventure and riches. Players explore ancient Egypt, uncovering hidden treasures and bonus features for big wins.In conclusion, Golden Book of Ra Cash Connection is an enjoyable slot with numerous beloved features on board. More importantly, it is a part of Greentube's jackpot network and offers two massive progressive jackpot prizes. All said and done, it's a decent addition to the Book of Ra series that is bound to be enjoyed by both the classic-loving audience and jackpot-chasing punters.

Our Extra Chilli review picks up where the blockbuster slot Bonanza left off. Apparently, the miner who struck gold at Mt. Cashmore has a new job – collecting hot chillies.

Big Time Gaming’s dynamic Megaways engine makes a comeback in this highly-volatile slot, as does the extra reel feature. What’s more, there’s a potential payout of 20,000x on display, plus an RTP of 96.41%.

There’s lots more to unpack in our Extra Chilli review, so let’s dive right in.

Basic Details of the Extra Chilli Slot

Extra Chilli Details, RTP and Volatility

Not much has changed from Bonanza, the game which put the Megaways mechanic on the map. The layout still comprises six reels of between two and seven symbols, with an additional horizontal reel. This format creates up to 117,649 paylines, dubbed “ways to win”.

The Extra Chilli slot RTP is usually 96.19%. However, the Feature Drop mechanic causes the RTP to increase, varying from 96.26% to 96.82%.

In addition, just like its predecessor, the game is highly-volatile. Players can wager any amount from $0.40 to $25 for a chance to win up to 20,000x their stake.

Seven symbols appear on reel five, courtesy of the extra reel. The spin features 3,024 ways to win, seen above the grid.

Theme & Graphics in Extra Chilli

This Big Time Gaming title subtly combines Mexican and Chilli slot themes. Legend has it that the old miner from the Bonanza slot retired to Mexico, spending his days at the market, exchanging his gems for chilli.

As such, the slot is set in an open-air marketplace, with the reel grid flanked by chilli peppers, garlic and vegetables on both sides. In the backdrop are some extremely colorful stalls, while the top of the grid displays the number of paylines on each spin.

For a 2018 release, Extra Chilli does have fairly good graphics. And although the tonal contrast leaves much to be desired, the overall display does have some aesthetic appeal. There’s also a festive soundtrack thrown in to spice things up.

Extra Chilli Slot Features

At first glance, Extra Chilli might appear rather ordinary, but on closer inspection, you’ll find some of Big Time Gaming’s signature twists. Let’s take a look.

Regular Symbols

Four chili peppers and six playing card icons 9 through A are the regular symbols in this slot. The latter pay between 0.1x and 0.2x when landing three of the same type, up to 1.75x for a combination of six.

As for the chillies, they appear in green, blue, red and purple colors. The purple pepper pays the highest, with 50x for six of its kind. What’s more, this is the only symbol with a payout for two on a payline.

Wilds

An image of three lit firecrackers is the wild symbol. This substitutes for all others, except for the scatters and Feature Drop symbols.

Scatters

Spell out the word “HOT” using the H, O and T scatters to trigger eight free spins. Extra golden scatters can still appear, rewarding you with an additional four free spins for each.

There’s also a free spins scatter that’s unique to the bonus round. Styled as sacks of red chillies, these only appear on the extra reel during free spins. Landing three or four offers four and eight extra spins, respectively.

Reactions

In many new slots, this feature is known as “Avalanche” or “Cascading Reels”. Slot veterans will know the drill. After a win, all symbols involved in the combination disappear, causing the rest of the icons to drop. Newer symbols then appear from above to fill in the spaces created.

Feature Drop

For the price shown to the right of the reels, you can buy your way straight into the slot’s free spins bonus. Purple-colored Feature Drop symbols may also land on the reels, reducing the cost. Occasionally, this value may drop to zero, causing the feature to trigger automatically.

Free Spins

Before heading into the free spins round, you’ll have the chance to try your luck and increase the number of bonus plays. Press “Gamble” to spin a wheel with up to 24 free spins available. However, you could also leave with zero spins.

Opt out of the gamble feature by clicking “Collect”. Doing so takes you to the bonus game with the number of free spins that initially triggered the feature.

Unlimited win multipliers are active throughout the free spins round. The multiplier starts at x1, increasing by one after each reaction.

Three adjacent A symbols sit on reels 1 to 3 during free spins. A x6 multiplier is applied to the win, shown to the left.

How to Play Extra Chilli Online

Configure your preferred bet size using the green direction buttons to the right of the reels. Next, click the large triangle button in the bottom-right corner to spin. Land matching symbols on adjacent reels, from left to right, to secure a prize.

Click on the double arrow button to take advantage of the autoplay feature. This allows you to set up to 100 hands-free spins, including win and loss limits.

Extra Chilli Review – Our Final Verdict

Considering the buzz generated by Bonanza after its release, it makes perfect sense that Big Time Gaming would deliver a sequel. However, the two slots have completely contrasting themes, which doesn’t make a lot of sense.

Nevertheless, Extra Chilli does manage to improve upon the original, introducing a few spicy new features. The gamble wheel and Feature Drop immediately spring to mind, both of which help you along the way to an impressive maximum potential payout.

Sadly, the graphics don’t really match the quality gameplay. You can put that down to the game’s age, but they weren’t exactly mind-blowing upon initial release, either. Still, this doesn’t take away too much from the excitement, and Extra Chilli is definitely one to keep coming back to.

attr_description: If you take a look at 3 Oaks, it’s easy to see that they are a company that’s almost all about Hold and Win slots. We’ve already seen the Wolf Saga slot from them, and it’s probably the success of that slot that inspired the Black Wolf release. It’s surprisingly similar in many regards, but it has a bit more meat on the bones, so to say. So, let’s take a closer look at what you can find in this 5x4 slot with 25 paylines!Thematically, Black Wolf comes with a gorgeous forest environment, and it’s actually a fairly atmospheric slot as well. There aren’t a lot of animations, but the symbol designs are detailed, and we especially like how the high-paying symbols look. All in all, it’s a pleasant package overall, and one that is impossible to criticize.Mathematically, Black Wolf is a medium volatility slot, and its Grand jackpot is worth 1,000x your bet. That’s not particularly exciting, but it makes for a good experience for players that aren’t into high risk high reward action. The betting range is geared towards casual players, too. While the slot’s min bet is £0.25, the most that you can risk per spin is £25. Unfortunately, the theoretical RTP of Black Wolf is only 95.65%, which is nothing to write home about.There are 8 pay symbols in Black Wolf, and they are once again split fairly between low-paying symbols and high-paying symbols. The game’s low-paying symbols are card ranks from Jacks to Aces, and you’ll get 2x your bet if you find a five-of-a-kind combination of any of them. The high-paying symbols are better, featuring owls, eagles, lynxes, and elk. Elk are worth the most, paying 20x your bet for a full combination.Pay symbols aren’t the only symbols that you can find in the slot, of course. Aside from them, there are also Black Wolf Wilds, Huntress Scatters, Boost symbols, and Moon Bonus symbols. It’s all pretty similar to the previously mentioned Wolf Saga slot, in fact, and Black Wolf Wilds even come with their own payout values, which are equal to the payout values of elk symbols.If you find a Boost symbol alongside at least one Moon Bonus symbol, you’ll trigger the Boost feature, which will immediately collect all Moon Bonus symbols in view. Note that Boost symbols can appear only on the middle reel during the base game and during free spins, though they can appear anywhere on the board during the Hold and Win feature.To trigger the Hold and Win feature, you have to find at least 6 Moon Bonus symbols in view (or at least 5 Moon Bonus symbols alongside a Boost symbol). You’ll get 3 respins to start with, and the tally will be reset with each new symbol that lands. The feature will go on until you run out of respins or fill the entire board with symbols.If you fill the entire board with symbols, you’ll get the Grand jackpot, which is worth 1,000x your bet. There are smaller jackpots as well, called Mini, Minor, and Major. You can get to them via Jackpot Moon Bonus symbols, and they are worth 20x, 50x, and 100x your bet, respectively. You can also land special Mystery Moon Bonus symbols, which will transform into random Jackpot Moon Bonus symbols at the end of the Hold and Win feature.Last but not least, there’s the Free Spins feature that you can launch via 3 Huntress Scatters. You’ll get 8 free spins, and you can get 8 extra free spins by finding another set of Huntress Scatters during any free spin. Crucially, there are more Boost symbols and Moon Bonus symbols on the reels during the Free Spins feature, which makes it easier to get instant wins and to trigger the Hold and Win feature.If you love Black Wolf, you should also try:Black Wolf 2 - is an exhilarating sequel that immerses players in a dark, atmospheric world. With stunning graphics, engaging gameplay, and a captivating storyline, it's a must-play for action-adventure fansWhen all is said and done, Black Wolf is an improvement on Wolf Saga, and we’re happy that 3 Oaks didn’t go for a carbon copy of that game gameplay-wise. Everything is somewhat juicier here, even though we aren’t too impressed by the slot’s somewhat subpar RTP. In any case, we’re happy to recommend the Black Wolf slot to all fans of the Hold and Win niche.

That’s not much of an issue, fortunately, and we are always willing to dig into new Playson slots. With Book del Sol: Multiplier, we are getting a classic “Book of” slot with everything that entails. That includes a standard playing field with 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 winlines.The theme of Book del Sol: Multiplier takes us back to an age in which the Aztecs were still a major force. We’ve already been there on more than just a couple of occasions, but the production values are well above average here, so we can’t really complain. The symbols are all gorgeous and the visuals are nicely colorful, so the designers clearly deserve a lot of praise!The volatility level of Book del Sol: Multiplier is high, which means that you have to be ready for some serious swings. At the same time, the hit frequency clocks in at 31.22%, so things aren’t too harsh. The slot’s betting range starts at £0.20, while high rollers can take the ante to up to £100 if they want to. The theoretical RTP of Book del Sol: Multiplier is then 95.94%, which is very slightly below average.There are 9 pay symbols in Book del Sol: Multiplier, with 5 card rank low pays and 4 thematic high pays. The low pays show card ranks from Tens to Aces and pay up to 10x your bet for a full five-of-a-kind combination. The high pays are much more appealing, as they come with animal masks, shaman masks, jaguars, and conquistadors. It’s worth noting that all high pays pay even in a set of two, which is partly where the high hit frequency comes from. In any case, conquistadors are worth the most, as a set of five will give you a 200x payout.As you’d expect, Book symbols are the special symbols in Book del Sol: Multiplier. They work as both Wilds and Scatters, which means that they both substitute for other symbols and trigger the Free Spins feature.If you find 3 or more Book symbols on the board, you’ll trigger the Free Spins feature with 10 free spins. Retriggers are possible, too, as all extra sets of Book symbols will bring you 10 extra free spins. Before the feature begins, one of the pay symbols will be designated as Special Expanding. These symbols can expand to cover full reels and even pay in combinations that aren’t wholly adjacent, which is a proven concept in this kind of games. Even better, the Free Spins feature comes with a win multiplier that starts at 1x and that you can increase by finding special Sun symbols. This win multiplier – which can be as high as 5x – applies to all winnings from Special Expanding symbols.Players that don’t want to wait for their Book symbols can also take advantage of the Buy Bonus feature. This will set you back by 100x your stake, but you’ll get to trigger the Free Spins feature straight away!The bottom line? Book del Sol: Multiplier is a classic “Book of” slot that nevertheless comes with high production values and a juicy 12,330x jackpot. That means that we’re more than happy to recommend it to all players that just can’t get enough of the “Book of” gameplay – and we know that many of our readers belong to that category!

attr_description: Extra Chilli Megaways was already a pretty engaging BTG release, and Evolution has now “evolved” it into something we have a feeling a lot of players will like. Extra Chilli Epic Spins comes with a Live Host that spins the slot in 5-spin rounds per bet, and a Crate or Pinata breaks open on each spin to upgrade the win multiplier, reveal scatters, or trigger the bonus round directly (only the more rarely seen pinata can do that).The multiplier is carried over from the base game whenever you spell out H-O-T with 3 scatters, as this is your organic ticket into the bonus round. The multiplier only keeps building, and it can increment by up to +20 via the Pinata feature mentioned above. In the end you can win 2 + 2 extra spins from 2 different gamble wheels, and these might just be what you need to crack the 20,000x potential. The max win is the same as the original game in other words, so the multipliers haven’t changed that.The bottom reel effectively adds an extra row to reels 2, 3, 4, and 5, and you win by landing 3 to 6 matching symbols on adjacent reels from the uttermost left to the right. You get Wild symbols on the horizontal bottom reel only, and wilds step in for pay symbols to help complete wins. The top-tier purple Chilli symbol also pays for only 2 of a kind. The 3 mid-level Chilli symbols pay 0.7 to 1 x your stake for 6-oak wins, while the top-tier purple Chilli pays 10x for the same.Before the game starts you need to choose your bet level and place your bet, and each base game round consists of 5 spins performed by the live host. You need to wait until the current round is finished before your bet becomes part of the next round, just to be clear.A Crate is smashed during each spin, and it will sometimes reveal a Multiplier value between x1 and x5. It can also reveal the letters “H”, “O, or “T”. You need all 3 letters in view to form the word HOT to trigger the bonus round. All revealed multipliers are accumulated per spin, and they boost any win on the current spin. This means that the 5th and final spin per round is potentially the most lucrative, as you have accumulated the highest multiplier.In addition to spelling out the word HOT with scatter symbols, you can also trigger the Bonus Round from the Pinata. The Pinata will replace the Crate at random times, and it will reveal more lucrative multiplier symbols between x10 and x20 or the bonus round directly.The Free Spins Bonus Round starts once the current base game round is finished, and you get 8 free spins for starters. The random Crate or Pinata features are active during the bonus round as well, and they award accumulating multipliers as before. This is also how you can retrigger the bonus round with 8 extra spins. Multipliers from the base game are carried over into the free spins round as well, and the Gamble Wheel triggers at the end of the feature.There are 2 Gamble Wheels that come with a different set of colors each, and you will choose between red or purple on the first wheel. If your chosen color wins you get 2 extra free spins, and then the second gamble wheel will be spun by the live host. You will then choose between 4 colors, and once again you get 2 additional free spins if you win. Your accumulated multiplier level from the bonus round is carried over into the gamble free spins rounds. If you lose the gamble, or when both extra rounds have played out, you return to the base game.Evolution knows how to make a regular slot experience even more exciting, and fans of Big Time Gaming’s Extra Chilli Megaways are probably gonna love what’s on offer in this live version. It’s good fun to be able to play together with friends in a live setting, and each 5 spins game round builds up to a climax as the multipliers keep accumulating. This Live Host is also there to keep things more fun and engaging, and the social aspect is something many players enjoy.There are multiple ways into the bonus round, so each round will keep you on your toes in that regard. If you get the pinata it can take you to the feature directly, and we like that the base game multiplier you have achieved is carried over. It keeps growing as the bonus round plays out, and then you get the nerve racking wheel gamble in the end. This can lead to lucrative extra spins since the multiplier is most likely pretty solid by then, but the 20,000x potential has not been upgraded despite the extra multiplier action.

If you’re looking for a thrilling journey into the world of Norse gods, Asgardian Stones is the perfect slot game for you. sc_description: The already angry roughneck mining dwarf from NoLimit City’s original hit release, Fire in the Hole, has now grown into a bitter, grizzled alcoholic. While he was frantically digging for his long lost case of cold ones in his younger days, the stakes are higher in this somewhat darker Misery Mining. The Collapsing Mine dynamic reels engine alone makes this a worthwhile experience, and the potential has been bumped up to an even more solid 70,000x your stake.NoLimit City has an incredible ability to keep renewing themselves, and it’s remarkable how they manage to hit one home run after another. The two Misery Bonus Rounds offer highly entertaining, explosive and innovative Money Train 2-inspired action, while the base game is kept simpler than usual, which is actually kind of a relief. The xBomb Wild takes center stage also here, expanding the 3x3 default grid up to 7x7 with 823,543 win ways, while also increasing the win multiplier.You win by landing 3+ matching symbols on adjacent reels from left to right in the active grid area. The premium symbols pay between 5.25 and 16 x your stake for 7 of a kind, and the xBomb Wild triggers the Collapsing Mine mechanic. As a wild, the xBomb steps in for regular pay symbols, and when it explodes it expands the default 3x3 game area.In addition, winning symbols “collapse” and are removed, making room for new symbols to drop down. This repeats as long as you keep winning, and the xBomb Wild explodes all adjacent symbols, while also increasing the win multiplier by +1. Everything resets when you hit a losing spin with no more xBombs or scatters in view.However, if you have accumulated 1 or 2 scatters during the collapsing sequence, each scatter will transform into xBomb symbols that are not wild. The explosion still removes adjacent symbols though, which might prolong your collapsing winning streak. These non-wild xBombs also increase the win multiplier and expand the grid size the same way a regular xBomb Wild does.The Misery Bonus Round triggers when you land and/or accumulate 3 scatters in the same collapsing sequence, and here’s how it works:You will choose between Mouse Mode or Rate Mode no matter what tier of the bonus round you trigger, and Rat Mode is an extreme volatility ‘streak respins’ style feature where the respins tally resets to 3 again for each hit. The Mouse Mode version is high volatility, and comes with a fixed number of spins that don’t reset.You get scatters and super scatters in the active grid area, and these move around to random positions per bonus round spin. Reels 1 and 7 are locked collector positions on each side of the active grid, and the bottom row is blocked at the start. Random enhancer symbols roll in on the top sliding reel, and these activate any scatters and/or super scatters on the reel below. It works as follows:When you unlock side collector positions, their respective values are added to the total win on every spin that follows. Activating bottom row collector positions makes them collect all the value on the same reel, and this value is also added to the total win persistently on every spin.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone eligible, may purchase different versions of the bonus round via the NoLimit Bonus Buy feature:You get to see the xBomb Wild in action in the base game, before we purchase the top-tier bonus round. We decided to go with Mouse Mode in our first attempt, and the feature starts around 1 minute into the 5:13-minute highlights video. We then try our luck in Rat Mode, which plays out from 3:13, and you can check it all out for yourself by hitting the play button below.The dynamic reels experience is even better in this “loose” Fire in the Hole follow-up, and it could’ve given the Megaways engine a run for its money if it wasn’t so tailor-suited to the mining theme. The xBombs land quite frequently, giving you an explosively entertaining base game that’s somewhat less complicated and convoluted than usual. Still, anything can happen when the grid expands from 3x3 to 7x7, awarding up to 823,543 win ways as the win multiplier increases.The soundtrack is a tad darker perhaps, but similar, and it’s hard to imagine a better sequel to NoLimit City’s original smash hit. The potential has been dialed up to 70,000x your stake, with a decent 1 in 60 million probability from the base game (see FAQ below for more details). The two rodent bonus round modes complete each other like the dwarf and his drink, offering a highly entertaining thrill-ride with plenty of innovation to boot. What can we say, hats off to yet another rock solid NoLimit City installment.ProsConsFire in the Hole - is NoLimit City’s original mining slot installment, and you get to meet a younger version of the dwarf in search for his long lost case of beer. The reels are not quite as dynamic perhaps, but the xBomb Wild wreaks havoc also here. The MT2-style bonus round comes with 6 modifiers, and you can win up to 60,000x your stake.Money Cart 2 - is an offshoot in the ultra-popular Money Train 2 series, and it’s a bonus round-centric release where the hold-and-win style feature triggers with a very high frequency. It comes with the 9 usual MT2 modifier symbols, but the max win potential is reduced to 5,000x your stake.Dwarfs Fortune - is a pretty solid mining slot from Wazdan, and you get to choose your preferred pace and volatility from 3 settings. The top cart reel awards multiplier and modifiers, and the big highlight is the Hold the Jackpot bonus round. Fill all positions to win the 2,500x Grand Jackpot, which is also the overall potential.

Bonanza Slot Review

Big Time Gaming’s Megaways engine has been hugely successful, and this Bonanza review looks back at perhaps the most well-known title of all.

Released in December 2016, the highly-volatile game promised an impressive maximum payout of 12,000x, plus a potential 117,649 ways to win.

In those days, it was one of the most popular casino slots in the world, especially with streamers. But has it stood the test of time? Let’s find out in this Bonanza review.

Software Provider Big Time Gaming

Release Date December 2016

RTP 96.00%

Volatility High

Max Win 12,000x

Reels x Rows 6 x 2-7

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.20 – $20

Number of Paylines Up to 117,649

Themes Gold Mining, Wild West

Basic Details of the Bonanza Slot

Bonanza Details, RTP and Volatility

Thanks to the now-famous Megways engine, there are no fixed paylines in the Bonanza slot. The action takes place on a six-reel grid, but the number of rows varies with each spin. It’s possible to see a maximum of seven on each, creating a possible 117,649 ways to win.

The minimum bet amount is $0.20, but Bonanza isn’t really one for the high-rollers; the upper limit is just $20. In addition, the Return To Player rate of 96.00% is distinctly average.

A high-volatility slot, it boasts a maximum potential win of 12,000x per spin. At the time of its release, in December 2016, that was a considerable figure. In all fairness, it’s not exactly bad even today.

The first two letters of the word GOLD are seen on reels one and two. In the top-right corner, the Bonanza logo is visible.

Theme & Graphics in Bonanza

Set in the Wild West during the gold rush era, the reels feature valuable gemstones buried among the rock. Above the main grid is a train track, where carts ship new symbols into the mine in anticipation of the Reactions feature.

This release is undoubtedly one of Big Time Gaming ’s most successful slots. However, it’s fair to say that’s mostly due to the game’s entertaining gameplay, rather than its graphics. Revisiting this game in 2024, the visuals appear horribly dated. They weren’t incredible back in 2016, either.

Finally, a high-tempo country soundtrack accompanies the action, conjuring up images of rootin’ tootin’ rednecks.

Bonanza Slot Features

As we’ve already hinted, Bonanza’s longevity is mostly down to its compelling gameplay. It’s now time to learn more about the game’s engaging features.

Regular Symbols

Ten regular symbols can be found in this slot, six of which are the playing card icons 9 through A. Land three of the same type and you’ll earn rewards of between 0.1x and 0.2x. However, six-of-a-kind is worth as much as 1.75x.

The four higher-paying symbols are precious stones. A diamond is the most valuable, worth up to 50x for six on a payline. However, it’s extra special, as you only need two to secure a prize of 2x.

Scatters

Fittingly, the game’s main scatter symbols are four solid gold letters. Spell out the word “GOLD” and you’ll receive 12 free spins, which we’ll explain later in this Bonanza review.

There’s a special Free Spin Scatter too, though as you can probably guess, it only appears during the bonus game. If you land three, you’ll earn an extra five free spins, with ten available when you collect four. This special scatter can only appear in carts above the reels.

Wilds

A bundle of dynamite wrapped up in the word “WILD” can substitute for every regular symbol to help you form wins. This can appear on the main grid, as well as the horizontal reel above.

Reactions

During every spin, carts bring extra symbols into play, adding one to reels 2 through 5. If a winning combination is formed, the symbols involved are eliminated, with more carts delivering further new symbols.

This was a fairly new feature at the time, but most slots possess something similar today.

Free Spins

You’ll need four scatters during the base game to pick up 12 free spins. However, even after spelling out the word “GOLD”, it’s theoretically possible to earn one or two additional scatters. For each extra triggering symbol, there’s a reward of five free spins.

Throughout the bonus feature, an unlimited win multiplier remains active. Starting at 1x, every reaction increases the multiplier by one.

As explained earlier in our Bonanza review, there’s a special Free Spin Scatter too. Three or four of these earns you five or ten additional spins.

The reactions feature. Winning symbols are eliminated and new ones are about to fall in from the horizontal reel above.

How to Play Bonanza Online

Use the green arrow buttons to the right of the grid to set a wager, then tap the large green button beneath to spin. The icon with two circular arrows allows you to configure up to 100 automatic spins, as well as win and loss limits.

Bonanza is a pretty straightforward slot that revolves mostly around its free spins feature. Collect the G, O, L and D scatters to trigger that bonus. In the meantime, match three of any symbol, or two of the diamond, to earn a prize and trigger the Reactions feature.

Try the Bonanza Demo for Free before playing for real money

It’s always sound advice to play free slots before staking real money. Even though Bonanza is relatively simple to play, take advantage of our demo and make any mistakes in a risk-free setting.

Bonanza Review – Our Final Verdict

Bonanza wasn’t the first Megaways slot – that honor goes to Dragon Born – but it really catapulted the game-changing mechanic into the spotlight.

Released without much fanfare, it quickly captured the imagination of slots players around the world. And for a while, it felt like the only game that the streamers were playing.

Even today, in May 2024, this Big Time Gaming classic retains a dedicated following, despite the many dozens of Megaways titles now available. It’s just an extremely playable game – simple, unpretentious and utterly engaging.

The pang of nostalgia which it triggers probably adds to the positive vibe, too. It’s important to recognise what a huge impact Megaways had on slots. At that time, we’d never seen more than 1,024 paylines.

To offer some balance, we must say the graphics are very poor. In addition, the maximum bet of $20 won’t appeal to big spenders, and the spin speed is noticeably slower than modern releases. However, these are minor concerns that do little to remove the sheen from what is rightly regarded as an all-time classic.

Basic Details of the Fire In The Hole Slot

Fire In The Hole Details, RTP and Volatility

Let’s begin our Fire In The Hole review with a look at the game’s key stats. Most versions of this game offer a solid 96.06% RTP. Take care though, for some casinos use less-rewarding rates of 94.11% and 90.02%.

A maximum potential win of 60,000x awaits, a figure that blows most slots out of the water. That figure is due to the extremely high volatility level, which is a common feature of Nolimit City titles.

The action takes place on a grid of six reels and three rows, though more can be uncovered as you mine. This makes for a possible 46,656 paylines on which to form wins. Play from $0.20 per spin, up to a maximum of $50.

A bet of $1 is set, seen in the bottom-left corner. Above this is a yellow star symbol which opens the Feature Buy menu.

Theme & Graphics in Fire In The Hole

As slot themes go, mining is fairly common, but Nolimit City always knows how to differentiate itself from the crowd. This release is not as dark as many of the developer’s other titles, but there is still a moody undertone.

Gameplay marches along to a slow-paced, heavy tune, punctuated by the explosions of mining activity. During the bonus, this music becomes even more ominous, and wouldn’t feel out of place in a Rammstein track. What’s more, the game’s main character is an angry-looking dwarf who can be heard snarling.

Fire In The Hole Slot Features

Like many Nolimit City slots, there are plenty of features to keep us entertained. We’ll discuss these in the following section of our Fire In The Hole review.

Regular Symbols

Ten ordinary symbols are used to form winning combinations. The five lower-paying playing card icons are K through 9. These pay between 0.2x and 0.3x for three on a payline, up to a maximum of 1.5x for six.

Five higher-paying symbols are depictions of mining equipment. From lowest to highest, these are the pickaxe, rope, mining boots, satchel and lantern. The highest-paying symbol returns 7.5x for six on a payline, with smaller prizes of 4x, 2x and 0.75x for five, four and three.

Collapsing Mine

At the beginning of each spin, you’ll notice three active rows, with three more covered. To unlock those and cause the mine to collapse, creating additional ways to win, one of three things must happen:

Form a winning combination;

Trigger the Wild Mining feature;

Blow up an xBomb wild with no win.

Winning symbols involved in a collapse are removed, making way for more to tumble in.

Wild Mining

Should you line up three, four or five of the same symbol horizontally without a win, the Wild Mining feature triggers. The symbols which activated the bonus are removed, leaving wilds in the central positions. That means one wild symbol for a line of three, with two and three resulting from a line of four or five.

In addition, all other regular symbols are blown from the reels, replaced with new ones.

xBomb Wilds

The xBomb Wild acts as any regular-paying symbol to create wins. If a spin results in a payout, any xBomb Wilds on screen will explode, wiping out adjacent symbols and allowing new ones to fall onto the grid. This occurs regardless of whether or not the wilds were involved in forming the win.

Every exploding xBomb Wild increases the multiplier by one, enhancing the next payout.

Scatters

A gold nugget bearing the letter “S” serves as the game’s scatter. Collect three, four or five to activate the Lucky Wagon Spins. Three triggering scatters opens up two rows of the bonus game’s reels. For each additional scatter, an extra row is uncovered.

Lucky Wagon Spins

You’ll start the feature with three spins, but for every coin that appears, the counter resets. As you play, carriages on the top row reveal various game modifiers, detailed below:

Coin Values: This sets the value of any coins appearing below. It can range from 1x to 100x.

Multipliers: Carts full of gold represent multipliers. These enhance the values of any coins already on the reel below, ranging from 2x to 25x.

Dynamite: These perform multiple actions. It first increases the coin value by the number of sticks of dynamite, before blowing up blocked positions and activating chests on the bottom row.

Bag: Coins on that reel are bagged up and deposited into one space.

Chest: All coins on the grid are collected and deposited into one space.

Dwarf: This collects all coins on the reels like the chest, but continues to do so for subsequent spins.

Feature Buy

Buy your way directly into the feature using the yellow star symbol, which presents you with three options:

60x: two open rows;

157x: three open rows;

500x: all four rows open.

One free spin remains during the feature, seen in the top-left. Seven coins lie on the reels for a combined 42x multiplier.

How to Play Fire In The Hole Online

Before playing Nolimit City’s Fire In The Hole slot, select a stake by tapping the coin icon in the bottom-left corner. You may also toggle the lightning bolt symbol opposite to change the gameplay speed.

When you’re ready, hit the curved arrow to spin. Alternatively, use the triangular “play” button to configure as many as 1,000 automatic spins. To win, match at least three symbols on a payline from left to right, starting from the first reel.
