With so many features and mechanics to get your head around, we strongly recommend trying our free Fire In The Hole game. This allows you to learn how the game works before risking real money. It’s always better to make your mistakes in demonstration mode first.

Fire In The Hole Review – Our Final Verdict

We love Nolimit City slots. They usually feature large maximum potential payouts, as well as dark and creative storylines that often contain controversial elements. However, with the release of Fire In The Hole xBomb, the developer managed to steer away from any negative press. In addition, the now-popular xBomb Wild was introduced.

This is a great addition, which really spices up the boring old wild symbol, bringing the game to life. What’s more, the dynamic reel grid and Wild Mining features keep you on your toes and it feels like there’s always something happening.

Admittedly, not everyone will enjoy the high volatility level. At least there’s a Feature Buy, with three different settings, to help offset that. A minor gripe is that the feature itself took a little while to understand. Still, once you’ve seen it in action a few times, it comes together nicely and is a thoroughly enjoyable bonus game.

Bonanza Slot Review

Big Time Gaming’s Megaways engine has been hugely successful, and this Bonanza review looks back at perhaps the most well-known title of all.

Released in December 2016, the highly-volatile game promised an impressive maximum payout of 12,000x, plus a potential 117,649 ways to win.

In those days, it was one of the most popular casino slots in the world, especially with streamers. But has it stood the test of time? Let’s find out in this Bonanza review.

Software Provider Big Time Gaming

Release Date December 2016

RTP 96.00%

Volatility High

Max Win 12,000x

Reels x Rows 6 x 2-7

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.20 – $20

Number of Paylines Up to 117,649

Themes Gold Mining, Wild West

Basic Details of the Bonanza Slot

Bonanza Details, RTP and Volatility

Thanks to the now-famous Megways engine, there are no fixed paylines in the Bonanza slot. The action takes place on a six-reel grid, but the number of rows varies with each spin. It’s possible to see a maximum of seven on each, creating a possible 117,649 ways to win.

The minimum bet amount is $0.20, but Bonanza isn’t really one for the high-rollers; the upper limit is just $20. In addition, the Return To Player rate of 96.00% is distinctly average.

A high-volatility slot, it boasts a maximum potential win of 12,000x per spin. At the time of its release, in December 2016, that was a considerable figure. In all fairness, it’s not exactly bad even today.

The first two letters of the word GOLD are seen on reels one and two. In the top-right corner, the Bonanza logo is visible.

Theme & Graphics in Bonanza

Set in the Wild West during the gold rush era, the reels feature valuable gemstones buried among the rock. Above the main grid is a train track, where carts ship new symbols into the mine in anticipation of the Reactions feature.

This release is undoubtedly one of Big Time Gaming ’s most successful slots. However, it’s fair to say that’s mostly due to the game’s entertaining gameplay, rather than its graphics. Revisiting this game in 2024, the visuals appear horribly dated. They weren’t incredible back in 2016, either.

Finally, a high-tempo country soundtrack accompanies the action, conjuring up images of rootin’ tootin’ rednecks.

Bonanza Slot Features

As we’ve already hinted, Bonanza’s longevity is mostly down to its compelling gameplay. It’s now time to learn more about the game’s engaging features.

Regular Symbols

Ten regular symbols can be found in this slot, six of which are the playing card icons 9 through A. Land three of the same type and you’ll earn rewards of between 0.1x and 0.2x. However, six-of-a-kind is worth as much as 1.75x.

The four higher-paying symbols are precious stones. A diamond is the most valuable, worth up to 50x for six on a payline. However, it’s extra special, as you only need two to secure a prize of 2x.

Scatters

Fittingly, the game’s main scatter symbols are four solid gold letters. Spell out the word “GOLD” and you’ll receive 12 free spins, which we’ll explain later in this Bonanza review.

There’s a special Free Spin Scatter too, though as you can probably guess, it only appears during the bonus game. If you land three, you’ll earn an extra five free spins, with ten available when you collect four. This special scatter can only appear in carts above the reels.

Wilds

A bundle of dynamite wrapped up in the word “WILD” can substitute for every regular symbol to help you form wins. This can appear on the main grid, as well as the horizontal reel above.

Reactions

During every spin, carts bring extra symbols into play, adding one to reels 2 through 5. If a winning combination is formed, the symbols involved are eliminated, with more carts delivering further new symbols.

This was a fairly new feature at the time, but most slots possess something similar today.

Free Spins

You’ll need four scatters during the base game to pick up 12 free spins. However, even after spelling out the word “GOLD”, it’s theoretically possible to earn one or two additional scatters. For each extra triggering symbol, there’s a reward of five free spins.

Throughout the bonus feature, an unlimited win multiplier remains active. Starting at 1x, every reaction increases the multiplier by one.

As explained earlier in our Bonanza review, there’s a special Free Spin Scatter too. Three or four of these earns you five or ten additional spins.

The reactions feature. Winning symbols are eliminated and new ones are about to fall in from the horizontal reel above.

How to Play Bonanza Online

Use the green arrow buttons to the right of the grid to set a wager, then tap the large green button beneath to spin. The icon with two circular arrows allows you to configure up to 100 automatic spins, as well as win and loss limits.

Bonanza is a pretty straightforward slot that revolves mostly around its free spins feature. Collect the G, O, L and D scatters to trigger that bonus. In the meantime, match three of any symbol, or two of the diamond, to earn a prize and trigger the Reactions feature.

Try the Bonanza Demo for Free before playing for real money

It’s always sound advice to play free slots before staking real money. Even though Bonanza is relatively simple to play, take advantage of our demo and make any mistakes in a risk-free setting.

Bonanza Review – Our Final Verdict

Bonanza wasn’t the first Megaways slot – that honor goes to Dragon Born – but it really catapulted the game-changing mechanic into the spotlight.

Released without much fanfare, it quickly captured the imagination of slots players around the world. And for a while, it felt like the only game that the streamers were playing.

Even today, in May 2024, this Big Time Gaming classic retains a dedicated following, despite the many dozens of Megaways titles now available. It’s just an extremely playable game – simple, unpretentious and utterly engaging.

The pang of nostalgia which it triggers probably adds to the positive vibe, too. It’s important to recognise what a huge impact Megaways had on slots. At that time, we’d never seen more than 1,024 paylines.

To offer some balance, we must say the graphics are very poor. In addition, the maximum bet of $20 won’t appeal to big spenders, and the spin speed is noticeably slower than modern releases. However, these are minor concerns that do little to remove the sheen from what is rightly regarded as an all-time classic.

attr_description: Divine Fortune Megaways is yet another slot remake from NetEnt, brought to life once again with the Big Time Gaming’s Megaways engine. Staying true to the first, NetEnt kept the DNA of the original Divine Fortune in terms of design and features, though, those who have ever tried the original Divine Fortune know that it’s the progressive jackpot which made it that appealing. The devs omitted it this time, thereby making players ask themselves, will it be worth playing? Follow up with the review and we’ll help you find out whether the Megaways version will be able to follow the success of its predecessor.The original Divine Fortune is still relevant though and remains one of the most popular developer’s jackpot slots, so ’giving a rebirth’ won’t be too appropriate. It’s rather re-releasing their banger with a ’new’ mechanic, though not avoiding any significant blows, like the omission of the progressive JP to keep it balanced.Anyway, NetEnt sticks to its strategy of upgrading its oldies after acquiring the Megaways license. To say that they are a bit late would be an understatement since the interest in Megaways slots slowly fades. It doesn’t necessarily mean that Divine Fortune Megaways is doomed to failure. A lot of gamblers still enjoy Big Time Gaming’s engine-powered games, so it would just go to a very different niche now, even though a lot of things remained almost untouched.Speaking of that, Divine Fortune Megaways boasts the same design as its older sibling, taking players to Ancient Greece with the reels set amidst two female marble statues. The first thing that catches the eye is the widened game area, now providing 6 reels with 2-7 symbols in each row instead of a 5x3 layout with 20 ways to play. True to the Megaways’ style, the number of paylines reaches 117,649 once the grid is fully unlocked.When it comes to the math model, the payback percentage suffered a blow, whereas the betting range as well as the volatility remained on the same level. The Megaways version is powered by a medium volatile math model with the RTP of 96.09%, half percent lower than the one found in original Divine Fortune. The betting range is way wider than other Megaways slots have, offering players to place wagers from 0.1$ to 100$ per spin.Heading over to the paytable reveals a bunch of recognizable symbols. Those include a set of A-10 royals, making up the low pays, followed by 4 premiums, involving birds, bulls, lions, and mythical Medusa. Scoring a win will require matching at least 3 symbols on a line starting from the leftmost reel, while there are only 2 needed for Medusa. The payouts have also been cut for obvious reasons, and now symbols award no more than 5x of the bet for a 6-of-a-kind combo. The mighty Pegasus is Wild here, acting as a substitute for any other regular symbols, plus being the key to triggering features.The Megaways upgrade doesn’t deliver any changes to the feature set as well. Here players will benefit from familiar extras, including Falling Wild Respins, Wild on Wild, and Free Spins.Alongside the jackpot omission, there’s another major downside, if so to speak. NetEnt decided to exclude the Avalanching Wins feature, which is commonly found in most of the Megaways-powered slots. However, players will get Respins instead, so it’s not a big concern indeed. Any time a Wild symbols lands anywhere on the grid, the Falling Wild Respin feature kicks in. Those Wilds will nudge one position down, awarding respins until they eventually leave the reel set. Players will also have a final respin after Falling Wilds fade.Whenever a Wild symbols land on top of a Falling Wild, it’s called Wild on Wild feature. They will expand to cover the entire reel, leaving a stack of Wild symbols, which will also nudge down on each spin and continue to award respins.Should at least 4 Scatter symbols appear in view, the Free Spins feature will be triggered. 4, 5, and 6 Scatters award 10, 15, and 20 spins respectively, with each extra triggering Scatter awarding +5 additional spins to the total tally. Pegasus Wilds get a significant upgrade during the Free Spins for all Wilds landing on the grid always trigger the Wild on Wild bonus.Once in the free games round, 3 Bonus Win Symbols come into play. Any time they land, they are collected to fill the respective meter above the reels. Filling the Bronze, Silver, and Gold meter with 5 corresponding Bonus Win symbols will award 10x, 25x, or 500x of the bet respectively. It’s also possible to claim more than one jackpot at a time. Once the meter is filled, it resets, allowing players to fill it again and win another tasty payout.All said and done, the question remains, is Divine Fortune Megaways able to surpass or at least be the same fun and rewarding as the original title? Not sure actually. It was the progressive jackpot that kept punters hooked onto their screen playing Divine Fortunes, hunting the jackpot like hounds that catches a scent. Will players chase a 500x payout now? Probably not.Oddly enough, with a larger format, Divine Fortune Megaways boasts smaller potential. The features are nice and fun, no questions at these, but boy, 500x jackpot is nonsense. According to it, it will surely fail to repeat the success of its older barnburner brother, bound to become yet another Megaways slot, not being able to somehow stick out from the niche.Well, it’s not that bad. In case you’re OK with the relatively low potential, you may love its shift to the Megaways engine. All the features work pretty well on the largened grid, and the Respins instead of a common Avalanching Wins mechanic seem to be a nice solution. All up, Divine Fortune Megaways will appeal to those who appreciate the developer’s effort of switching their games to Big Time Gaming’s engine, though, it will surely struggle to make old players feel drawn to spin the reels on it.

A lot of gamblers still enjoy Big Time Gaming’s engine-powered games, so it would just go to a very different niche now, even though a lot of things remained almost untouched.Speaking of that, Divine Fortune Megaways boasts the same design as its older sibling, taking players to Ancient Greece with the reels set amidst two female marble statues. The first thing that catches the eye is the widened game area, now providing 6 reels with 2-7 symbols in each row instead of a 5x3 layout with 20 ways to play. True to the Megaways’ style, the number of paylines reaches 117,649 once the grid is fully unlocked.When it comes to the math model, the payback percentage suffered a blow, whereas the betting range as well as the volatility remained on the same level. The Megaways version is powered by a medium volatile math model with the RTP of 96.09%, half percent lower than the one found in original Divine Fortune. The betting range is way wider than other Megaways slots have, offering players to place wagers from 0.1$ to 100$ per spin.Heading over to the paytable reveals a bunch of recognizable symbols. Those include a set of A-10 royals, making up the low pays, followed by 4 premiums, involving birds, bulls, lions, and mythical Medusa. Scoring a win will require matching at least 3 symbols on a line starting from the leftmost reel, while there are only 2 needed for Medusa. The payouts have also been cut for obvious reasons, and now symbols award no more than 5x of the bet for a 6-of-a-kind combo. The mighty Pegasus is Wild here, acting as a substitute for any other regular symbols, plus being the key to triggering features.The Megaways upgrade doesn’t deliver any changes to the feature set as well. Here players will benefit from familiar extras, including Falling Wild Respins, Wild on Wild, and Free Spins.Alongside the jackpot omission, there’s another major downside, if so to speak. NetEnt decided to exclude the Avalanching Wins feature, which is commonly found in most of the Megaways-powered slots. However, players will get Respins instead, so it’s not a big concern indeed. Any time a Wild symbols lands anywhere on the grid, the Falling Wild Respin feature kicks in. Those Wilds will nudge one position down, awarding respins until they eventually leave the reel set. Players will also have a final respin after Falling Wilds fade.Whenever a Wild symbols land on top of a Falling Wild, it’s called Wild on Wild feature. They will expand to cover the entire reel, leaving a stack of Wild symbols, which will also nudge down on each spin and continue to award respins.Should at least 4 Scatter symbols appear in view, the Free Spins feature will be triggered. 4, 5, and 6 Scatters award 10, 15, and 20 spins respectively, with each extra triggering Scatter awarding +5 additional spins to the total tally. Pegasus Wilds get a significant upgrade during the Free Spins for all Wilds landing on the grid always trigger the Wild on Wild bonus.Once in the free games round, 3 Bonus Win Symbols come into play. Any time they land, they are collected to fill the respective meter above the reels. Filling the Bronze, Silver, and Gold meter with 5 corresponding Bonus Win symbols will award 10x, 25x, or 500x of the bet respectively. It’s also possible to claim more than one jackpot at a time. Once the meter is filled, it resets, allowing players to fill it again and win another tasty payout.All said and done, the question remains, is Divine Fortune Megaways able to surpass or at least be the same fun and rewarding as the original title? Not sure actually. It was the progressive jackpot that kept punters hooked onto their screen playing Divine Fortunes, hunting the jackpot like hounds that catches a scent. Will players chase a 500x payout now? Probably not.Oddly enough, with a larger format, Divine Fortune Megaways boasts smaller potential. The features are nice and fun, no questions at these, but boy, 500x jackpot is nonsense. According to it, it will surely fail to repeat the success of its older barnburner brother, bound to become yet another Megaways slot, not being able to somehow stick out from the niche.Well, it’s not that bad. In case you’re OK with the relatively low potential, you may love its shift to the Megaways engine. All the features work pretty well on the largened grid, and the Respins instead of a common Avalanching Wins mechanic seem to be a nice solution. All up, Divine Fortune Megaways will appeal to those who appreciate the developer’s effort of switching their games to Big Time Gaming’s engine, though, it will surely struggle to make old players feel drawn to spin the reels on it.

It’s tricky to incorporate whatever sport is depicted into the gameplay in a convincing and engaging way, it seems, but PG Soft has managed to do just that in Super Golf Drive. Of course, the multiplier never resets in the bonus round, and payouts up to 8,000x your stake was achieved in 1 billion simulated spins.The premium symbols pay between 15 and 50 x your stake for 6 of a kind wins, and the Asian female golfer is the top-tier symbol. The Wild comes in the form of a golden golf ball, and it steps in for all pay symbols to help complete and/or improve wins. The wild holds no value of its own in this game, and it can land on reels 2 to 5 only. Symbols can occupy up to 3 positions in height, but they will always represent 1 symbol in win calculations.Winning symbols are removed via the Cascading mechanic, bar the random symbols that come with a red frame. If the red-framed symbols are involved in a win, they will turn into the golfer Mystery Symbol. All present mystery symbols add +1 to the Win Multiplier, and they also reveal the same randomly chosen pay symbol as the cascading sequence comes to an end.You need at least 4 trophy scatters in view to trigger the Bonus Round, and this awards 10 free spins and +2 additional spins on top of that per additional triggering scatters. Any multiplier you may have racked up on the triggering spin is carried over into the bonus round, where the multiplier never resets for as long as the feature lasts. You can retrigger the bonus round by landing 4+ scatters in the same cascading sequence.We have to admit that we weren’t super excited when we first laid eyes on Super Golf Drive, as many sports games just aren’t that well-made and fun in our experience. The visuals are solid as usual, and you get some decent action commentary as well.The mobile-friendly developer really does have a knack for making small tweaks count, and each release comes across as fresh and unique despite essentially following a similar recipe. The big innovation here is the golfer mystery symbols, and it’s fun when they all swing their clubs to increase the win multiplier. It can lead to solid payouts in all stages of the game, and not least when the multiplier only keeps building in the bonus round. Up to 8,000x your stake is possible, and the advertised max win matches what was achieved in 1B simulated spins in this release (which is not always the case with PG Soft).

attr_description: Nolimit City's Tanked drops you straight into a chaotic battlefield where cartoon animal warlords clash in their miniature tanks. When 3 or 4 characters are stuck together, they trigger massive booms that clear symbols and expand the grid. To top it off, collecting beer scatters triggers different bonus round tiers with non-resetting win multipliers. While the volatility is high (a 10/10 on NoLimit City's scale), the 25,000x max win potential makes braving this chaotic battlefield worthwhile.There are tons of modifiers and features to cover in Tanked slot, even for a NoLimit City game. So, without further ado, let’s dive in!Payouts are awarded as the different characters collect any symbol within adjacent reach that matches their color. Once the initial collection frenzy subsides, the remaining symbols and new symbols drop down to fill the gaps. Any character can snag wilds and multiplier symbols, and more than one multiplier symbol collected means the values are added together before boosting your win.Tank Booster symbols can appear at random times, and all 4 characters can pick up any of the 4 types of tank boosters available. Any character armed with a tank booster waits until the end of the cascading sequence before unleashing their modifier, and they work as follows:Each character has 3 lives, respawning on the next symbol drop as long as they have lives left. The character keeps any tank booster he collected before being removed, and tank booster explosions do not remove wilds, xSplit, or xNudge symbols.xBombs and Barrel Bombs are special symbols that only activate when characters are stuck and there are no Tank Boosters to activate. The xBomb explodes, removing surrounding pay symbols and increasing the win multiplier by +1. The Barrel Bomb also explodes to remove pay symbols, expanding the grid size by 1 step.The game also features Boom explosions caused by character clusters. When 3 characters collide without being able to move, a Small Boom occurs, removing surrounding pay symbols and characters. A 4-character collision triggers a Big Boom, doing the same while also expanding the grid by 1 step.If a character loses all 3 lives within the same cascading sequence, it does not respawn and symbols of its color do not appear. However, the character will respawn with 3 new lives for the next round.The xNudge Wild nudges downwards until it hits a special symbol, increasing the win multiplier by +1 per nudge. The starting multiplier is x2 if no win multiplier is present when the xNudge Wild lands. The xSplit symbol turns into a wild after splitting symbols vertically or horizontally, while also doubling the value of any affected multiplier.Each time a rocket hits, a big boom triggers, or a barrel bomb explodes, the grid expands by +1 step. The grid can expand in different ways depending on the vertical or horizontal expansion, but essentially it can expand in steps from size 6x6 to 9x9. It will go directly to size 9x9 if a tank booster explodes an xBomb or Barrel Bomb.The Carnage Spins Bonus Round triggers from 3 beer scatters being collected, awarding 5 free spins where multipliers, grid size, and kill count are carried over from the base game.Collecting 4 beer scatters awards 7 Carnage Royale free spins, giving you a maxed-out 9x9 grid with +5 added to whatever multiplier is carried over. The Kill Count is also carried over.You’re upgraded to the Mayhem Spins feature if all 4 characters die in the same explosion (regardless of the number of lives they have left), with the remaining number of free spins playing out.The Mayhem Spins Bonus Round can also trigger from the base game. This happens in the rare event that all 4 characters first lose 2 lives and then all lose their final life in the same explosion. The feature plays out on a maxed-out 9x9 grid with +10 added to the win multiplier. Each character has 1 life and you win +1 free spin if they all die in the same explosion. This also adds +10 to the win multiplier.Eligible players can click the circular red button with a yellow lightning icon to open the Bonus and Feature Buy menu in the Tanked game. Here’s an overview:Tanked NoLimit City throws you into a war-torn world where animal combatants duke it out across a metallic grid. The 4-6-6-6-6-4 layout is populated by colorful gems and 4 distinct tank-driving characters, including an elephant and a walrus. Each character picks up tank booster weapons, with explosions expanding the grid. The combination of a photorealistic backdrop and quirky characters makes this game stand out, and the action is accompanied by an energetic soundtrack.ProsConsIt's not every day we see the usually innovative NoLimit City borrowing mechanics so blatantly, but Tanked is essentially a turbocharged version of ELK Studios' CollectR win system. Rumor has it a former ELK designer had a hand in this, and while imitation might be the sincerest form of flattery, it's still rare to see NoLimit City taking such direct inspiration. However, they've more than earned the right to borrow a bit, having revolutionized the slot world with so many unique creations.Frankly, I'm glad they "borrowed" this mechanic. It means we get to enjoy xLoot with NoLimit City's signature math model and higher RTP than ELK typically offers. So, get ready to make a deal with Mephistopheles and see where your fate takes you in the Faust slot game. With its exciting bonus features and free spins round, you’re sure to be entertained for hours on end.

attr_description: The grizzled, eye-patch alcoholic dwarf is back for yet another roughneck mining expedition. He’s after the big haul this time, digging his way towards the Federal Beer Reserve. Dead Canary is the 3rd installment in NoLimit City’s highly innovative and entertaining mining slot trilogy, and the dynamic grid comes with sliding cascades on tilted reels this time. You get plenty of action also in the base game, which is hardly unusual for this developer.It looks like this may be the last installment (at least for a while), or at least it’s indicated by the happy ending win story. Spoiler alert: the dwarf is saved from drowning in the federal beer pool by his future mermaid wife. Perhaps this cured him from his alcoholism as well, who knows, and you can look forward to an explosive canary prize collection hold & win bonus round. It comes with a solid 65,000x potential, and this is a must try for any mining slot enthusiast out there.You can switch on the xBet feature between base game spins, and it costs 40 % more per spin. The benefit is that the first blocked row is unlocked, and you are also guaranteed a scatter per spin (doubles your bonus round chances). The premium symbols pay between 2 and 7.5 x your stake for 6 of a kind wins, and you win by landing 3+ matching symbols from the uttermost left to the right.The 3-3-2-2-1-1 default grid can be expanded to 3-4-3-4-3-4, and a blocked row opens up per win. Winning symbols are removed via the Cascading mechanic, and new symbols slide down the diagonal reels to possibly create new winning combinations. The process repeats as long as you keep winning, and blocked rows are also blasted open by an adjacent xBomb or via the Wild Mining feature. The random multipliers at the bottom are activated if all barriers are removed, and the symbols destroyed, or if the final barrier reveals a scatter.The xBomb Wild steps in for pay symbols to help complete wins, and xBombs explode all adjacent symbols in a cross pattern. Scatter symbols and other xBombs are not exploded, however, and the win multiplier increases by +1 per exploding xBomb for the next cascade.On a non-winning spin, where 3, 4, or 5 matching symbols line up diagonally, you trigger the Wild Mining feature. The triggering symbols are replaced by wilds, and you get 1, 2, or 4 Wild bombs from 3, 4, or 5 triggering symbols, respectively. Each wild bomb explosion adds +1 to the win multiplier for the next cascade, and all symbols except xBomb symbols explode. If a scatter explodes, it will reappear in a random position on the next cascade.The Canary Bonus Round (1 in 197 hit rate (or 1 in 98 with xBet turned on)) triggers when you land and/or reveal any mix of 3 silver and gold caged canary scatters. The bonus round plays out on a 4-3-4-3-4-3-4 grid, and there is a locked vault in each corner. These are unlocked by xBomb explosions, and the triggering canary cages become sticky on the grid. They come with 3 lives each (hearts).You start with 3 respins in the tally, and the canary cage scatters have a starting value of x1. Silver cage scatters can collect in an x-shape from adjacent positions, while gold cage scatters can collect in an x-shape from the full reel and row. Also the vaults in the corner collect anything that lands in an adjacent position.The canary inside the scatter cages die when all 3 lives are lost (via adjacent explosions and similar), and this is how the scatter bet multiplier value is added to the total win. A new bird replaced the dead canary, however, and it starts with 3 lives and an x1 value again. Here is an overview of all the special symbols you can land in the bonus round:The feature ends when you run out respins, and all unlocked corner vault values are then added to the total win. Non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can use the Bonus Buy menu to purchase the Canary feature for 68x the stake. Barbarian Fury

Hold on to your swords, because Barbarian Fury is taking you back to medieval times! This game by Nolimit City is not for the faint-hearted. The design is a massive scroll of snow-capped mountains stretching across the background, with tree branches and mountains as the major focal points. Fierce-looking barbarian warriors take up the bulk of the symbols, while various forest creatures lurk in the background.

But don’t worry, no barbarians were actually harmed in the making of this game. It’s just really cool design! The graphics and sound effects make you feel like you are an actual member of the tribe, ready to conquer the snowy forest.

And let’s be real, who wouldn’t want to be a barbarian for a day? Instead of worrying about deadlines and emails, you’ll be smashing pumpkins and celebrating your wins with a good old-fashioned boar roast. Barbarian Fury’s design seamlessly immerses you in the game and makes it a thrilling and entertaining experience.

Get Ready to Roar with Barbarian Fury’s Wild Symbol and xNudge Feature

If you love online slot games that are packed with features, Barbarian Fury is the perfect choice. One of the exciting aspects of this game is the Wild symbol, which is represented by a big brown bear. This symbol can substitute for all other standard symbols to help you form winning combinations. However, the fun doesn’t stop there.

The Wild symbol in Barbarian Fury also comes with an additional xNudge Roaring Wild feature – and boy, does it pack a punch! Every time the Wild appears on your reels, it will nudge up or down to spin the entire Wild reel. Not only does this make for some seriously thrilling gameplay, but it also increases your chances of winning!

What’s more, every time the Wild nudges, it will add to a multiplier. This means that your potential payouts can increase up to 4x. So, not only will the Wild help you form winning combinations, but it will also give you the chance to increase your winnings – talk about a double win!

attr_description: Whenever we see the word Bonanza in the title we automatically assume we’ll be dealing with some kind of Sweet Bonanza copycat, and not least when the theme is related as well. This is hardly the case with Bakery Bonanza, however, so PG Soft took us by surprise with this one. You get plenty of cakes and sweet stuff on the reels for sure, but the Multiplier Reel they have come up with in this release is quite unique and potentially highly lucrative.It adds tension to each Cascading sequence, as things can escalate quickly out of the blue when luck is on your side. Each win from the bottom sliding reel adds to the total cascading sequence win multiplier, and the multiplier doesn't reset between free spins in the bonus round. This is a good example of how a “simple twist” can make a huge difference, and you can win up to a solid 12,190x your stake. PG Soft keeps impressing us these days, and we also like the high RTP of their games (with no adjustable RTP ranges).You win by landing matching symbols on adjacent reels from the uttermost left to the right. The number of matching symbols per reel are multiplied together, and the sum of this is then multiplied by the relevant paytable value to calculate the win.Larger symbols up to size 1x4 all represent a single symbol during win calculations, which gives you a dynamic grid experience with up to 32,400 bet ways, and you can land Wild symbols on reels 2 to 6. Wilds step in for pay symbols to help complete and/or improve wins, like wilds usually do.Winning symbols are removed via the Cascading mechanic, and pay symbols will sometimes land with a silver frame on reels 2 to 5. Silver framed symbols involved in a win are transformed into a randomly selected pay symbol after the other winning symbols are removed, and they are then upgraded with a golden frame. Golden framed symbols involved in a win are turned into up to 4 wilds after the other winning symbols are removed, depending on the size of the symbol.You will see a Multiplier Reel at the bottom of reels 2 to 5, and it slides in pay symbols per spin. The win multiplier increases by +2 for every pay symbol from the multiplier reel that is involved in a win, and the total win multiplier will be applied to the total win at the end of the cascading sequence.You need 4 scatter symbols in view to trigger the Free Spins Bonus Round, and scatters will accumulate in cascading sequences. This gives you 10 free spins as a minimum, and you get +2 additional free spins on top of that per additional triggering scatter.The Multiplier Reel multiplier starts at x3, and it increases by +3 for every multiplier reel pay symbol that’s involved in a win. The multiplier never resets for as long as the bonus round lasts, and it comes with no upper limit.You get +1 extra free spin per +1 symbol that appears during the feature, and non-UK players and anyone eligible can purchase the bonus round for 75x the stake. Taking advantage of the bonus buy feature guarantees at least 4 triggering scatters on the spin that follow.PG Soft has a knack for making small changes to their “standard” blueprint, and somehow these small changes make a big impact and make each game come across as unique. We believe other developers, and especially Megaways developers, have something to learn from this mobile-friendly and crafty studio. Bakery Bonanza doesn’t seem all that exciting at first glance, but once you get going this game will take you by surprise.They could’ve easily made some kind of Sweet Bonanza inspired copycat release, which we “feared” at first, but PG Soft has instead created something unique. The Multiplier Reel steals the show in this game, and it’s a great innovation that adds value to the often somewhat “tame” top or bottom sliding reel. It’s capable of building up solid win multipliers in all stages, and not least when it never resets in the bonus round. The 12,190x potential is solid as well, and we have no trouble recommending this release to pretty much anyone (except those who’re on a diet).

attr_description: AvatarUX got their proverbial ‘cherry’ popped as an online slot developer only a couple of years ago, but the release of CherryPop Deluxe is still a reminder that time certainly flies. The original release is the most popular installment in their ever-growing range so far, and this Deluxe version comes with a cartoonish Pop Art theme that’s quite different from the glossy and more traditional fruit slot-inspired original.Sadly, the math model has been significantly watered down however, which doesn’t exactly fit the bill for a ‘deluxe’ model. The 20,000x potential is solid enough, but still less than half of what you get in CherryPop, and the 95.96 % RTP is also a tad lower. A Buy Bonus Max option has been included though (not UK, of course), and the pace of the game is pretty good even without any turbo option.The premium symbols pay between 2.5 and 15 x your stake for 5 of a kind wins, and you don’t get wilds nor scatters in this game. The PopWins mechanic is going strong however, and it removes all winning symbols and replaces them with 2 new random symbols per ‘popped’ position. This process repeats indefinitely as long as you keep winning, but the grid maxes out at 6 rows and 15,552 ways to win in the base game.Maxing out the grid is how you trigger the Bonus Round, and you can choose to gamble for a better starting level (more spins and more rows), or accept the starting level you get. The pre-feature gamble plays out on a large wheel, and you’re either successful or you lose the whole bonus round altogether. Here’s an overview of what to expect:The gamble wheel can stop on a special golden segment as well, and this awards up to 12 FS on the first gamble, and up to 16 FS on the second attempt. The grid maxes out at 9 rows in the bonus round, which gives you up to 118,098 ways to win.The grid always resets to the lowest reel height between spins however, and the progressive multiplier starts at x2 and increases by +1 per PopWin. If you max out the grid, +2 extra spins are awarded. Also, +4 is added to the multiplier, which increments by +4 per win from that point forward.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone living in an eligible jurisdiction, may take advantage of the Bonus Buy options. This will set you back 75x your stake for the regular bonus round, which allows you to gamble for a better starting level. Alternatively, you can cough up 300x your stake for the Buy Bonus Max feature, which gives you a randomized better starting level with no possibility to gamble.You get to see a PopWins sequence or two before we purchase the bonus round at 1:10 into the 3-minute highlights video, and we went for the Max version, of course. This gave us 10 free spins and 21,168 ways to win for starters, and you can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.The first thing we noticed when testing CherryPop Deluxe was the improved spin pace. We’ve been nagging about this in many previous reviews, so it was nice to see an installment that flows in a more satisfying way. We’re unsure about the audiovisual makeover however, and especially the audio part. The piano note sound for each added symbol gets a tad annoying after a while, but the dreamy soundtrack is pleasantly similar to the original.Perhaps ‘deluxe’ isn’t the best subtitle for this release, as people will expect a superior math model. Instead, the 20,000x potential is less than half of the original, and even the RTP has been sliced a bit. The pop art theme is different from the more standard fruit theme of the original, sure, but the whole release seems a bit pointless since you now have a turbo option to mend the pace issue in the original. We doubt many fans of the first game will be converted, but this deluxe version will perhaps shepherd some new players into the PopWins universe.ProsConsCherryPop - is the 3rd installment in AvatarUX’ PopWins range, and it’s their most successful release so far. You get a glossy and classic fruit theme, where PopWins add rows and eventually triggers the progressive multiplier bonus round. This can lead to payouts up to 56,386x your stake, and the RTP of 96.2 % is more decent than this ‘deluxe’ version as well.MonkeyPop - is the visually most impressive installment in the PopWins series so far, and you get oriential watercolor art that’s a feast for the eyes. The PopWins expand the grid with up to 7 rows and 33,614 win ways, and a maxed out grid awards 2 free spins. You get a reward reel spin up front when the bonus round triggers, and the max win is 10,744x your stake.HippoPop - comes with the usual PopWins mechanic that doubles all winning positions, and the grid maxes out at 5x6 in the base game. The progressive multiplier is carried over into the bonus round, where the grid can expand up to 5x8 with 65,536 ways to win. You can win up to 48,150x your stake via the non-resetting bonus round multiplier.

New symbols drop down from above to replace them, and this process repeats as long as you keep winning.When you land 3 bank symbols anywhere on the same spin, you trigger the Pick’em Bonus Game. You will then pick from 3 banks to “rob”, and this awards a win multiplier of either 10x, 20x or 50x. The Metropolitan police badges are mystery symbols, and all instances transform into a randomly chosen matching pay symbol at the end of a spin.The mafia duo can drive by the reels sometimes, and throw dynamite onto the grid. The regular bonus round is triggered when you land at least 4 scatters anywhere in sight.This gives you 12 free spins, and you also get 4 extra spins per extra scatter you land above the minimum of 4. The progressive win multiplier starts at 1x, and increases by +1 for each cascading win. New scatters can land in the top reel only, and you get 6 or 12 extra spins when you slide in 3 or 4 scatters, respectively.The mafia duo drove by the reels, giving us dynamite symbol removal. Visually, the game looks a bit dated also, but the brick and mortar sound effects indicates that this might be intentional.The royal symbol removal might lead to decent base game payouts once in a while, but you’ll need the bonus round to get close to the 76,000x max win potential. attr_description: Dead or Alive is a classic western themed slot from NetEnt, and it has long since earned its cult following since it was launched back in May 2009. The western theme is popular among game providers, but few have succeeded like NetEnt has done with this game. It might be one of the older titles in their catalog, but it can still measure up to most of what is released today.The classic Morricone-like whistle we remember from the great spaghetti westerns sets the mood from the get-go, and every time you spin the reels it starts with the sound of a gun being cocked. It’s minor details like this that makes for a great game, and NetEnt knows how to deliver them every time. This is a rough ride on a high variance slot, but you can be rewarded with up to 3000 times your stake on very single spin.The free spins feature is the main attraction, and the big wins will come from the sticky wilds you get in that feature. The dusty town might look empty, but make no mistake, danger is lurking around every corner, and you better hold onto that six shooter as long as you’re visiting. A great game for any western fan, but perhaps not for the easily spooked, or the trigger happy who lacks patience to wait for the right moment.Before we take a closer look at all the good stuff this game has to offer, let’s reveal the technical details so you know exactly what kind of “trouble” you’re getting yourself into:The RTP on Dead or Alive is somewhat higher than the average, which is always positive. Most online slots have an RTP around 96%, while this game goes as high as 96.8%. With a house edge of only 3.2%, this game gives a lot back to the players, even if the Return to Player percentage is just a “theoretical measure” that is valid only in the long run.Starburst from NetEnt has RTP ranges. RTP ranges is a game feature when Casinos have the possibility to adjust RTP according to their needs. The RTP ranges could be quite wide and depends on certain factors. Since May 2021 game has 6 RTP options: 96.82%, 95.03%, 94.03%, 93.06%, 92.06%, 90.07%. Pay attention. Check the RTP of this slot at the casino before playing. Or make a request for the casino audit before playing!Another thing to be aware of is that the volatility - or variance as it’s also called - is legendary high on this game. This means that you need a bankroll and a bet level that can handle the fluctuations. Just like in a real cowboy movie, you need the patience of the calm and collected hero to take down the bad guy, and thus take home the big reward.Anyone who does not have a nostalgic moment whenever they hear the phrase “Wanted Dead or Alive”, must be too young to remember the good old Western classics. They just don’t make em’ like that anymore, and you could say the same about NetEnts cult classic cowboy slot. It’s still a great and modern slot, but it does not rely as much on the heavy 3D animations and effects, like most recent titles.Just like the old classic Western movies did not need CGI or massive special effects, so this game has a more subtle appeal. It’s all in the small details, and the deserted, strange mood of the town you enter into while playing. You take on the role as a bounty hunter, and the reels are filled with pistols, boots, cowboy hats, wanted posters and sheriff stars, all to get you worked up for that midnight duel.The game has 5 reels and 9 paylines, and in the background there is a thunderstorm brewing over the cool desert mountains. Have a double shot of Bourbon, and see if you can get that free spins game rolling, cause that’s where the big money can be won. Not least if you land some of those sticky wilds too, and don’t forget, all your winnings are doubled in this feature. Let’s have a closer look at exciting bonus feature this game has to offer.Everything you do in this game is followed by the sound of whip. This is cool at first, but it can get on your nerves in the long run. We looked all over the menus, but here is no way to turn this sound effect off and keep the atmospheric soundtrack at the same time. sc_description: Little Bighorn is an extreme volatility slot depiction of the Battle of Little Bighorn from NoLimit City, and it plays out on a 3-4-5-3-2 grid with 360 ways to win. The Scalp Wild triggers the xMount modifier, which turns US soldiers into multiplier wilds, and the scalp wild itself nudges fully in place on the middle reel. The main highlights are the Scalp and Spirit Call bonus rounds, and the max win is 25,676x your stake.NoLimit City has a good handle on the Wild West genre, that much they have proven beyond any doubt. This is the first time they’ve added Indians to the mix, and the result is an explosive, yet somewhat understated, installment built around some core wild features. There is less confusion and modifier chaos this time, which might be a relief to certain players.The premium character symbols pay between 1.5 and 3.75 x your stake for 5 of a kind wins, and you get regular wild symbols that can appear on any reel to substitute for pay symbols and help complete wins. The wild pays the same as the top-tier Sitting Bull symbol.The Scalp Wild can appear on the middle reel that’s 5 positions in height, and it triggers the xMount modifier. This transforms all US soldier symbols into wilds, and the scalp wild nudges fully in place to cover the entire reel. Each nudge scalps the US soldier symbols, which adds +1 to the multiplier of the transformed wilds.If you land 1 or 2 Totem Scatters in the base game, these expand to become full wild reels. During bonus rounds, the totem scatters also become expanding wilds, as well as awarding +1 extra spin. You get totem scatters on reels 2-4 in the Scalp Bonus Round.The No Mercy Scatter can land on reel 5 only, and this triggers the Spirit Call Respin feature. The No Mercy Scatter is moved to reel 1 before the respin, and it’s transformed into a wild symbol with one of the following modifier abilities:You need 3 totem scatters plus 1 no mercy scatter on the same base game spin to trigger the Spirit Call Bonus Round, and this gives you 10 free spins. It plays out similarly to the Scalp bonus round, but a No Mercy scatter is sticky on reel 1 for the entire feature. The grid also changes to a 2-3-4-5-3 setup. The No Mercy scatter turns into the wild Crazy Horse, Two Moon or Sitting Bull symbol per spin, giving you the corresponding modifier.The yellow star icon takes you into the Bonus Buy menu, but it’s not available in the UK and perhaps some other jurisdictions. The Scalp Freespins round costs 77x the stake, while the Spirit Call Freespins round sets you back 490x your stake. The RTP for each option is 96.19 % and 96.02 %, respectively. There is also a third option priced at 159.5x your stake, and it gives you a 20/80 % chance to get the Scalp or Spirit Call feature.The xBet increases your bonus round chances from 1/281 to 1/100 spins, and it costs 50 % more per spin. The xBet also increases the win cap probability in the base game, from 1 in 19 million to 1 in 8 million.You get a brief taste of the base game, before we purchase the Scalp Bonus Round at 0:35 into the 4:23-minute highlights video. We buy the Spirit Call feature at 1:45 into the video, and you can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.Being NoLimit City and all, we actually expected even more brutal visuals in this depiction of the infamous Battle of Little BigHorn. Sure, you get a scalping here and there, but overall Little Bighorn doesn’t come across as all that disturbing. The Morricone-inspired soundtrack creates an epic atmosphere, and the rustic presentation fits the bill perfectly.Featurewise, it’s easier to understand what’s going on than in many previous releases, as you’re not bombarded with the usual arsenal of xMechanic modifiers. The win cap probability increases to 1 in 115,000 in the bonus rounds, and it clocks in at a somewhat moderate (for NoLimit City at least) 25,676x your stake. We have seen better win stories from this developer, but overall Little Bighorn is an unusual and strong release in the Native American genre.ProsConsApache Way - is a Native American installment from Red Tiger, and you get a ritual of the sun streak respins round which comes with a 2,000x jackpot if you fill the grid. You can look forward to 3x3 sized mega symbols in the free spins round, and a max win potential of 2,571x your stake.Thunder Screech - is a American Indian slot from Play’n Go, and you can get up to 9 wilds added at random times. Thunder Wilds award the Strike Respins round, and you get thunder wilds on every free spin. The max win is 5,000x your stake.Spirit of the Beast - is a Relax Gaming installment in the Native American genre, and you can trigger the Spirit Summoner feature at random times. It gives you stacked premium symbol spins, and you get a stacked symbol collection system in the bonus round. The max win is 10,000x your stake.

attr_description: Evolution Gaming’s Balloon Race is a unique live slot that builds on the popularity of Crazy Coin Flip and Crazy Pachinko, using similar mechanics that players have come to love. Players progress through three thrilling phases, starting with the slot game, moving to a Top-Up slot phase to boost multipliers, and finally, joining a live race where colorful hot air balloons, driven by real-time ball draws, compete for massive rewards. Read our Balloon Race live slot review to discover more about this promising addition to Evolution’s acclaimed portfolio.When our team created Balloon Race, the aim was very much to appeal to traditional slot players. At the same time, drawing on our Group brands’ expertise across live casino, live game shows, and online slots, we also wanted to make Balloon Race very different - both visually and in terms of the player experience.  Balloon Race achieves everything we set out to do and more. But what stands out for me is how colorful, simple, and fun-to-play Balloon Race is. It’s an uplifting game in so many ways - not least because it offers players engaging entertainment with the potential to win accumulated multipliers!  Todd Haushalter Chief Product Officer, Evolution GamingThe Balloon Race online slot takes players high above the clouds, where vibrant hot air balloons fill the sky in a lighthearted and cheerful adventure. The visuals are bright and colorful, with a backdrop of serene skies and soft, fluffy clouds. Adding to the charm, a jolly live host floats alongside in a hot air balloon, bringing an engaging presence to the game. While they mostly observe during the initial stages though, the host truly steps into the action during the final phase, where they operate the ball draw machine. Overall, the design is very polished and immersive, making for a highly engaging experience for players looking to take part in this unique airborne competition.Balloon Race is not your conventional slot game. It’s an engaging experience divided into three distinct parts: the qualification slot, the optional Top-Up phase, and the thrilling final Balloon Race live bonus round. Each stage offers unique gameplay elements, and here’s a detailed breakdown:During the first, Qualification phase of the game, Balloon Race plays like a common slot game, featuring 5x3 reels with 10 fixed win lines. There are seven regular symbols, namely 10-A card ranks as well as bronze and silver medals. When 3 or more of the same kind land on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost along any of the active paylines, you get a win. The possible payouts for the symbols range from 1x to 15x your bet for five-of-a-kind combinations.Then, there are two more special symbols available, Scatters and Expanding Wilds. The former can contain random multiplier values, up to 10x each, while the latter, as the name implies, expand to cover their respective reel entirely, producing bigger winning opportunities.The objective during the Balloon Race qualification slot is to land a set of either of these three symbols, or a combination of them, to enter the next stage. Any multipliers collected from the Scatters are accumulated and stored until the third live bonus stage of the game, where they are added to final payout calculations.There are three different spin modes available for the qualification phase. The Normal, default one, and XXXtreme and Super XXXtreme modes, allowing players to speed up the process and qualify faster, as well as get a boost to the possible multipliers.Once you qualify and complete the initial stage, you can participate in the optional Top-Up phase while waiting for the main round to commence. The purpose of this phase is to rack up bigger multipliers for the live Balloon Race bonus, though, there’s no guarantee you will. Again, it’s up to you to decide whether to take part in the Top-Up stage or not.When the Top-Up phase is complete, and before the final round begins, a plane flies by and unleashes random multipliers for each of the four colored segments. These will be added to the existing, if there are any, Scatter multipliers you collected during the Qualification round. Ultimately, the result will be added to your Top-Up multipliers to determine the final prize values for the live Balloon Race bonus round.The Balloon Race bonus is a stage that doesn’t require players’ input and is led by the game host live, so you can sit back and watch the show. What’s going on here is the host operates the ball draw machine and controls the balloon race. The ball machine holds 80 balls, split into even four sets of 20 balls of each color - yellow, purple, green, and red respectively.At the end of the race, the final payout is determined by your initial bet used in the qualifying stage multiplied by the winning total multiplier value. Note that bets from the Top-Up round are not taken into account. attr_description: Red Tiger is known for experimenting a lot with the Classic style concept, and Forever 7s is a perfect example in that regard. These turn into symbols of random values up to x500 each, and all 3 values are added together.The base game alternates between 6 different color schemes, and you will only land the corresponding 7 symbols per color mode. These come with values up to x500 also, so it’s definitely possible to win 1,500x in all stages of the game. While some might find this low/mid-range installment a bit tedious, others will probably enjoy its simplistic charm and dynamic vitality.As you understand from the above, you will land nothing but 7 symbols in this game, but these come with different colors and multiplier values attached. The same color 7s will keep landing for a while, until the color changes yet again, and this way you cycle through random symbol types as you play.You can also switch into Mystery Symbols mode, and this feature comes with black/golden 7 symbols. Land 3 of these on the single payline, and each 7 will display a random win multiplier between x1 and x500. The 3 multipliers are then added together as the mystery win is summed up.The 3:42 minute highlights video starts out with a purple 7s win, and around 1:40 into the video you get to see the mystery 7s in action. This awarded such a big payout that it took more than 1 and a half minutes to sum up(!), and you can see it all for yourself by hitting the play button below.Red Tiger has a knack for doing interesting stuff with the classic slot concept, and Forever 7s is a clever little thing in many ways. Landing only 7 symbols is certainly fun if that’s your lucky number, and perhaps it will be after a few hundred spins on this thing. You’ll probably count 7s as you close your eyes to sleep that night, but all is forgiven if you crack the 1,500x potential.That might not sound too impressive, but keep in mind that this is a casual low to medium variance release. Harlecoin icons overlay regular symbols, and this boosts the symbol values when you win. Harlecoins overlay every symbol in the bonus round, where you can win up to 1,076x your stake.Golden Horns - is a classic 3-reeler with 1 payline, and Betsoft has packed a solid 25,344x your stake punch into this asian-themed release. Ox wilds come with random multipliers up to x88, and 3 ox wilds guarantees a minimum win of 576x your stake.

The Lucky Lad Flynn Wild symbol steps in for all pay symbols to help complete wins, and this leprechaun fisherman is also the game’s all-important Collect symbol.The fisherman Collect/Wild Symbol can appear on reel 5 in the base game, and he will reel in all cash fish symbols and/or jackpot symbols in view when he appears. This adds 1 to 5 cash fish symbols to the grid, and these are then collected by the fisherman collector wild.The Bonus Round triggers when you land 3, 4 or 5 scatters anywhere in view, and this awards 10, 15 or 20 free spins, respectively. Collect symbols can appear on all 5 reels during the feature, and they are collected in the trail. The Upsizer Menu is not available if you buy the bonus round, however.You get a brief taste of the base game, before we purchase 10 free spins around 30 seconds into the 4:34-minute highlights video. The overall max win is 1,440x your stake.Golden Catch - is Big Time Gaming’s highly playable and original take on the fishing slot genre, and this Megaways engine release reveals cash fish underneath reaction win symbols. These are collected by boats, and the boat multipliers increase per new boat in the bonus round. The max win is a solid 31,430x your stake.

The wilds leap to random positions each time, just to be clear.You will sometimes land a Feature Coin during Avalanche sequences, and this happens at random times to trigger a modifier that corresponds to the coin type you get. While not explicitly stated anywhere, it’s our experience that you tend to get higher multiplier wilds, as well as more frequent feature coin triggers, during the bonus round.Eligible players can purchase the bonus round directly from the in-game Buy Feature menu. This will set you back 100x the stake, and you get between 10 and 15 free spins from the triggering spin that follows.You get to see a feature coin modifier in the base game, before we purchase and trigger the bonus round at 0:27 into the 4:29-minute highlights video. We got 4 triggering scatters which gave us 11 free spins, and you can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.We have to say that 101 Candies slot didn’t really come across as a NetEnt release, or at least not the NetEnt we used to know before they were swooped up by Evolution Gaming more than 3 years ago. The pace is a bit too sluggish for our taste, and a turbo option would’ve been appreciated. Despite being a tad childish, the visuals are okay, but not really all that engaging either.The multiplier wild conveyor system is admittedly somewhat original, and it can lead to decent to solid payouts also in the base game. Everything heats up in the bonus round, as you seemingly get more frequent feature coins and higher wild multipliers, and the 3,580x potential is solid enough for a mid-range release like this. sc_description: NetEnt used to release up to several new slots per month back in the good ole’ days, but things have changed since they got acquired by Evolution Gaming. You still get the odd release here and there, and Buster’s Bones is a visually pleasing wild west installment revolving around cowboy dogs. The base game plays out on the ‘never-ending canyon’, while the bonus round takes you into a typical frontier saloon.The canines are charming with their cowboy hats and bandoliers, and as usual with this genre, wilds take center stage during features. The Buster Wild moves around to collect bones, turning these positions wild while also increasing its own wild multiplier. The same goes on persistently in the bonus round, with a Buster Wild Multiplier that only keeps building. The 973x potential will probably disappoint some players though, not least combined with medium to high volatility.You need at least 5 matching symbols adjacent vertically or horizontally anywhere on the grid to land a cluster win, and 3 dogs with green, blue, and purple wooden backgrounds are the top-tier symbols. Winning symbols are removed via the Avalanche feature, and replaced by new and/or existing symbols dropping down from above. This process repeats as long as you keep winning,Wild symbols come into play during the Buster’s Bones feature, and wilds step in for pay symbols to help complete and/or improve wins. You need a Buster Special Symbol in view to trigger the feature, as well as at least one Bone Special Symbol. Buster will then move around the grid to collect any bones in view, and this turns the relevant positions wild.Buster himself serves as a wild symbol as well, and a multiplier equal to the value of the collected bone symbols then becomes the win multiplier. When taking a break from the bone collection, the win multiplier is applied when the Buster Wild is part of a win. Buster and the multiplier disappear when the feature ends, but the feature can, of course, trigger again on a future spin.The Buster’s Bones feature can trigger organically, as described above, or it can come about via the ‘Random Features’ feature. You will then see bones and the Buster Wild tossed onto random positions on the grid, and this activates the Buster’s Bones feature. It plays out exactly like described above after that.The Bonus Round triggers when you land 2 free spins scatters and 1 Buster Wild in view, and this gives you 8 free spins. The Buster Wild moves around to collect bones, which turn the positions wild, while also building his own wild multiplier. The multiplier never resets for as long as the bonus round lasts, and you win +1 or +3 extra spins when you land 1 or 2 scatters on the same free spin, respectively.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can purchase the Bonus Round via the Buy Feature. This will set you back 60x your stake, and it gives you instant access to the free spins round.While most “hot” developers these days tend to churn out highly volatile beasts most of the time, NetEnt seems to aim for a different player segment now that their “glory days” are over. Buster’s Bones is a charming canine wild west release for sure, but this medium to high volatility installment can hardly compete with the heavy hitters in this genre. The 973x potential says it all, really, and this is hardly up there with Dead or Alive 2.By all means, it’s fun to see Buster the dog bounce around to collect bones, turn positions wild, and build his own wild multiplier. However, with measly returns like this you’re not going to attract mainstream attention outside of the starpower this developer can still muster. You get more of the Buster’s Bones feature in the bonus round, with a multiplier that never resets, but again, the win cap is an underwhelming 973x your stake. Diamond Chance

When it comes to slot machines, everyone looks forward to having a good time spinning the reels, anticipating new combinations and payouts. Diamond Chance offers just that, a straightforward and fun gaming experience that follows traditional rules and functions.

Setting up your bets is a breeze, and you’ll be rolling the reels in no time. The game features classic slot machine symbols, such as bars, sevens, diamonds, and cherries. The anticipation builds with each spin, knowing that any second you might hit a winning payline.

But what makes Diamond Chance stand out from other slot games is its Wild symbol. This valuable icon can replace nearby symbols and works to create new wins, but it also has an extra perk. If you land three Wild symbols on the same spin, they transform three of the reels into Wild symbols, guaranteeing a win!

We all know the odds of hitting the jackpot are slim, but Diamond Chance does a great job of balancing excitement and realism. The payouts are generous without being too disproportionate and provide excellent incentives to keep spinning.

In conclusion, Diamond Chance is an excellent pick for those looking for a reliable and entertaining slot game. So ready your lucky hat and come spin the reels with this diamond of a game today!

Symbols

Diamond Chance is a slot game that offers both basic and special symbols to help you win big. The basic symbols are letters decorated with what appear to be fancy golden crowns. It’s like the alphabet got a glamorous makeover and decided to hit the casino. The special symbols are where things get interesting though.

The Lucky 7 symbol is the one you’ll want to keep an eye out for as it provides the biggest payout. It’s like the slot machine version of the Holy Grail. The golden bell symbol is like a dinner bell, but instead of calling you to the table it calls you to big payouts. And finally, the dollar sign symbol is like a trail of dollar bills leading you to the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.

The expanding Wild symbol is like a magician who can replace nearby icons to help make wins. Which is great because we could all use a little magic in our lives. Just be careful not to get lost in its hypnotizing look. It’s like staring at a kaleidoscope for too long and suddenly you’re transported to another dimension. Trust me, I speak from experience.

RTP: A Chance Worth Taking

Let’s talk about RTP, or in other words, Return to Player. Diamond Chance boasts an RTP of 96%, which means that for every dollar spent, players can expect a return of 96 cents. Mathematically speaking, that’s a pretty good deal, and we all love a good deal, right?

With its classic yet elegant design and thrilling gameplay, it has everything it takes to keep players coming back for more. Just like the saying goes – diamonds are a girl’s best friend, and in this case, they might just be your wallet’s best friend too.

The delicate graphics are reminiscent of classic fruit machines, and the music aims to make the slot recognizable and reminiscent of a classic casino experience. The game does not incorporate any special animations or modern innovations, which adds to its retro feel.

Now, don’t get us wrong, there’s a charm to this retro feel that Diamond Chance exudes. It’s like playing on a vintage jukebox before the advent of Bluetooth speakers – it may not be the highest quality sound, but there’s a certain magic to hearing those crackling tunes. Similarly, the graphics may not be the most advanced, but they certainly give off a classic vibe that reminds us of the time when slot machines were first introduced.

Don’t be too shocked by how simple and classic the graphics and sound are – it’s part of the appeal of this slot game. After all, not every slot game needs to be about flashy visuals and ear-shattering sounds. Sometimes, all it takes is a sweet and simple tune, and some minimalistic graphics to get your slot game fix. So, if you’re looking for a game that takes you back to the classic era of slots, Diamond Chance is definitely worth a spin or two.

Diamond Chance is not just another casino slot game! It’s a sparkly experience that can potentially shine some star-quality payouts up to 1,000 times the player’s bet. That’s a lot of champagne bottles to pop for a lucky winner!

The game includes a Wild symbol that can replace nearby icons, which is like a flashy new sports coupe on the road. It’s impossible not to notice it, especially when it potentially increases the chances of winning. So, buckle up and let the game take you for a ride!

What is a classic slot game without the Lucky 7 symbol? The biggest payout comes from the Lucky 7, which has been a staple for players familiar with traditional slot machines. It’s like a loyal old friend that never disappoints and always delivers.

Overall, Diamond Chance is an enjoyable experience for those looking for a retro-style slot game with good chances of winning. It’s like being in a 70s disco, without the flashy outfits and cheesy music. It’s just pure fun and excitement!

You get Wild Re-Spins where semi-sticky wilds accumulate below the reels as their countdown reaches zero, and these expand on the final spin. You get indefinite respins until you land a win that doesn’t include any wilds, and wilds are semi-sticky during the Re-spins feature. Wilds come with numbers between 1 and 5 attached, and this indicates how many wins they need to be involved in before they drop down to the collector position below the main grid.Each win the wild is part of decreases its number by -1, and when it reaches zero it drops down to the sub-grid collector position. If you collect more than one wild in the same sub-grid position, the wild multiplier increases by +1 per additional collected wild. As the Re-spins feature ends, you get a final respin where all collected wilds expand to cover full reels. If multiple multiplier wilds are part of the same win their respective multipliers are multiplied together before being applied to the win.You need 3, 4, 5, or 6 badge scatters in view at the same time to trigger the Bonus Round, and this gives you 7, 10, 15, or 25 free spins, respectively. As the title already hints, the studio switched to a different iconic theme, so players here are taken to explore the American wilderness in search of cash prizes and jackpots.The previous Immortal Ways game was received quite well by the players, so it’s not surprising Ruby Play decided to start a sort of serial production. Aside from the Buffalo release, they’ve already got two more scheduled to come off the studio’s conveyor belt this year, namely Immortal Ways 88 Charms and Immortal Ways Piñata, featuring Chinese and Mexican themes respectively. However, all of these hardly differ from one another gameplay-wise, offering pretty much the same experience but in a different wrapping.As for the one under review, it takes you to some kind of a North American ravine, showcasing a beautiful desert landscape with hills and canyons drenched in the scorching sunlight. However, you don’t get to see much as most of the view is dominated by a large reel setup, quite an unorthodox one, with 4-5-5-5-5-4 rows and 10,000 winning ways.That is where 9 pay symbols appear, creating winning combinations from 3-of-a-kind and more from left to right. They start with classic A, K, and Q royals on the lower side, and then are six different American inhabitants. They are in ascending order snakes, eagles, deers, wolves, pumas, and grizzly bears. Animals can appear stacked on the reels. Yet, regular symbols offer quite low payout values, awarding from 0.16x to 0.40x the stake for six-of-a-kind combos, and bigger wins are achievable via the Immortal Array mechanics, explained below.The game can be played on any device and is optimized perfectly for smooth gameplay for both desktop and mobile. Bet levels vary from £0.25 at the lowest up to £75 at the highest, which should appeal to most, including both high-rollers and lower-stake punters.Immortal Ways Buffalo comes with a 96.29% RTP value, which is decent above the average level. Plus, the slot is powered by a medium-volatile math model, so wins should occur fairly often. In accordance with the 53.18% hit rate, this should happen roughly every two spins. However, don’t expect to win too big, as the maximum prize value is capped at 3,221x your bet.The grid of the Immortal Ways Buffalo slot is divided into two Immortal Arrays - reels 2 and 3 make up the left array, and reels 4 and 5 make up the right one. Within the arrays, there are special Coin symbols available. There are two different kinds of coins. Regular ones display random cash values from 0.8x to 14x the bet, and Wheel coins, as the name hints, award a random prize determined via the bonus wheel.When one or more Coins appear, all other coins in the same Immortal Array are locked for the next 3 spins. If another bonus symbol shows up within the three spins, the spin counter is reset back to 3. The coins are locked in position until the Array is filled entirely, which collects all shown values and pays the sum to the player, or when no new coins appear after the 3rd spin.Landing a Coin Wheel symbol anywhere within the Immortal Array triggers the Prize Wheel at the end of that spin, where one of the four different prizes can be awarded, as follows:The Coins, however, have one major downside. When locked, they prevent winning combinations from being made, occupying most of the reels and blocking the winning ways. This doesn’t apply to Scatter symbols though, which still remain active even if they get overlapped by a Coin. In other words, Scatters and Coins can occupy the same position at the same time.When at least 3 Scatter symbols appear simultaneously during the base game, players receive 8 Free Spins and proceed to special reels that start with empty Immortal Arrays. All coins that land during the feature are held for the remainder of the free spins or until they are collected. All Coins remaining in view at the end of the feature will be collected and paid. Finally, if another 3+ Scatters land during the free games, +8 extra spins are awarded.Ruby Play definitely has done a great job designing the Immortal Ways engine, and we always appreciate when slot companies come up with something new, exciting, and unique. It was really thrilling to try the Immortal Ways Diamonds slot when it hit the market, but the Buffalo follow-up fails to evoke similar emotions, sticking to the same formula and providing basically the same experience.The Immortal Ways series comes with the slogan ‘Action Packed Spins’, and there’s a lot happening indeed, but it would be better if it evolved. For now, however, this is not the case, as there are already four games released or about to be that utilize completely the same gameplay with nothing new to offer except for the skin. To conclude, Immortal Ways Buffalo is fun, but there’s no point in giving it a spin if you’ve already tried the previous title. Well, except if you are really crazy about buffaloes.
