Canny the Can and Mona the Mouse are arguably one of the most charming duos in the world of online slots, and they do not disappoint in Drop ‘Em either. The visuals haven’t changed much since the previous installment, Stack ‘Em, but a brand new Drop mechanic takes center stage in this release.It comes in the form of a Drop symbol that removes all symbols below as it drops, and the remaining top gaps (after the existing symbols have dropped down) are filled with a randomly chosen matching symbol. It’s akin to the mystery symbol feature in some ways, and it can lead to solid payouts in all stages due to the 7,776 win ways. The bonus rounds come with a symbol elimination system for the Drop feature, and you can win up to a solid 10,000x your stake.The premium symbols pay between 1.5 and 5 x your stake for 5 of a kind wins, and you can land Wild symbols anywhere to help complete and/or improve wins. Landing 5 wilds on the same win way awards 20x your stake, which makes the wild symbol the highest paying symbol by far.You need at least 1 Drop Symbol present to trigger the Drop mechanic, and it plays out after any initial wins. The drop symbols remove all symbols below themselves as they drop down and off the grid, and symbols above will then drop down to fill the gaps. New symbols will then drop to fill the remaining top gaps, and this can be either a matching pay symbol or wilds in the base game.You need 3 FS symbols in view to trigger the Drop Spins Bonus Round, and this gives you 10 free spins. Every pay symbol, as well as the wild, can be seen represented on the left-hand side, and one symbol will be selected to fill all empty positions when the Drop feature hits. Landing a FS symbol awards 1 to 3 extra spins, or an Upgrade symbol. The latter removes 1 to 10 pay symbols from the pool on the left, but the wild cannot be removed.The High Drop Spins Bonus Round triggers when you land 4 FS symbols on the same base game spin, and this gives you 10 free spins as well. However, now only premium symbols and the wild are found in the choice pool seen on the left. The FS symbol removes 1 to 5 symbols (bar the wild) from the pool, or they provide 1 to 3 extra spins.The Wild Drop Spins Bonus Round triggers from 5 FS symbols in view in the base game, and you get 10 free spins once again. Only the Wild symbol is present in the choice pool for this round, which means you always get wilds to fill the top gaps when the Drop feature hits. The FS symbol still provides 1 to 3 extra spins when it lands.The Buy Bonus Menu is available in some jurisdictions, but not in the UK for sure. It comes with the following 5 options this time:You get a brief taste of the base game, before we purchase the top-tier High Drop Spins bonus round at 0:42 into the 3:36-minute highlights video. We took it all the way to where only the high-value wild was was left in the choice pool, and this landed us at least one pretty solid win. You can check it all out for yourself by hitting the play button below.It’s always fun to be reunited with Canny the Can and his friend, Mona the Mouse, and Drop ‘Em is bound to lift your mood from the get-go. Just watching the antics of these two cartoonish characters is good fun in and of itself, and the gameplay provides solid entertainment on top of that. The Drop mechanic is a clever innovation indeed, but it will seldom make a huge dent in the base game. It can, of course, and not least due to the high number of win ways.We found it fascinating to purchase the Mega Drop featurespin, as it gives you a drop symbol on all 5 of the reels. This guarantees a win, and everything hangs on how high the drop symbols land, and what symbol is chosen. The 150x price tag isn’t a joke, however, but it was fun to try out in demo mode. Getting only wilds to fill the gaps in either of the bonus rounds is always the main goal, and it will always be the case in the rarely seen Wild Drop FS round. This can land you massive payouts up to 10,000x your stake, but beware the volatile beast that lurks beneath the charming exterior of this game.

attr_review_text:
Introduction to Toothrot Tilly

Toothrot Tilly is a casino slot from Pineapple Play for those with a bit of a sweet tooth. You might not be familiar with the studio, as this is Pineapple Play’s third-ever release, and it’s a name that’s quite new to the scene, debuting in late 2025 with the release of Coconut Chaos, and then followed up with Midnight Mirage. While these first two releases weren’t very special, we want to say that, this time around, they do deliver on a pretty interesting twist. Candy themes have been one of the simplest, and arguably one of the most basic themes in the industry for quite some time, only behind the old classics such as Fruit slots. But Pineapple Play takes this idea and makes it a bit stranger with an over-the-top battle between the titular sugar-loving Tilly and the Tooth Fairy herself. The gameplay loop then follows us cashing in on Wrapped Candy, Chocolates, and Rotten Wilds for Prizes and Multipliers on Cascade reels, until we hit the Free Spins, where the two characters start fighting in a Beam Battle, awarding us with tons of small bonuses as the tide of battle changes. Tag along as we check out what this new up-and-coming studio does with a typical candy-theme, delivering on good spins and a max win of 10,000X the bet.

Pineapple Play’s third-ever release delivers on a candy-theme filled with wrapped prizes and sweet bonuses.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Toothrot Tilly is a video slot from Pineapple Play with 5 Reels, a 3-4-5-4-3 Row Setup, and uses Scatter Pay Mechanics, needing a minimum of 5+ of the same symbols anywhere on the reels to form a win. You can choose between making a Min.bet of 0.1 and a Max.bet of 100. Toothrot Tilly comes with a slightly higher-than-average RTP of 96.34%, medium volatility, and a solid max win of 10,000X the bet.

Set inside a candy store after dark, Toothrot Tilly finds her way inside to gobble up just about anything she can set her eyes on, with the Tooth Fairy showing up to stop her. The game definitely doesn’t take itself seriously, as can be seen when the bonus game triggers and the two characters start a magical battle. You can play the game on most notepads, mobiles, and desktops.

The lower-paying symbols are various gummy teddy bears in various colors, including green, orange, purple, pink, and yellow. Creating a win with 13+ of the same symbols will pay out 5X to 20X the bet. The higher-paying symbols are various sweets and characters, including green macarons, blue candy-floss, purple cake, the tooth fairy, and Tilly. Landing a win with 13+ of the same symbols pays out 44X to 120X the bet. Then we have quite a few Special Symbols, ranging from Wilds, Rotten Wilds, Scatters, Wrapped Candy, and Wrapped Chocolate Symbols, and you can learn more about these in the Feature section.

Special Features & Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Toothrot Tilly?

You can win up to 10,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot Toothrot Tilly?

The features are Wild Symbols, Cascades, Rotten Wild Symbols, Wrapped Symbols, Molar Reel Bonuses, Cavity Clash, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Wild Symbols

Wild Symbols help form winning combinations by being able to substitute for all paying symbols, and don’t substitute for any Special Symbols such as Scatters, Wrapped, or Rotten Wild Symbols. Only 1 Wild Symbol may be visible on the grid at any one time, and it is removed after participating in a win.

Cascades

After landing a Scatter Pay winning combination, the winning symbols are removed from the playing grid, allowing new symbols to fall down and potentially create new wins. During the Cascades, all wins will be added to a Total Win counter, which will payout at the end of a spin, and the Cascades will continue until no more wins can be created.

Rotten Wild Symbols

The Rotten Wild Symbols can only appear after landing at least three winning combinations during a single spin or Cascade. The Special Symbol will act as a regular Wild, substituting for paying symbols, and also offers a random Multiplier value of 2X-40X.

Wrapped Symbols

There are two types of Wrapped Symbols, Wrapped Candy, which comes with random cash values ranging from 2X to 250X, and Wrapped Chocolate, which contains Multipliers of 2X to 40X. These can only be unwrapped and rewarded through the Molar Reel bonuses Sticky Fingers or Fairy Flicks, and will instantly be added to the Total Win Bar after being unwrapped.

Molar Reel Bonuses

The Molar Reel is a special box outside of the playing grid that spins alongside the reels, and can randomly award one of three bonuses to be triggered for that spin. They are as follows:

Sticky Fingers = When triggered, all visible Wrapped Candy and Wrapped Chocolate are removed from the grid, unwrapping and awarding their prizes, as well as causing a cascade.

Fairy Flick = When triggered, the Fairy Flick will choose one of two sections, removing all Symbols except Scatter, Wild, and Rotten Wild Symbols from the section, causing a cascade.

Sugar Swirl = When triggered, all low-paying symbols visible on the grid are converted into the highest paying low-paying symbol visible on the grid.

Cavity Clash

By landing 3 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Cavity Clash Free Spins feature with 10 spins. During the bonus game, a Beam Battle between Tilly and the Tooth Fairy will be present, and by landing golden-framed character symbols, the beam will move for the respective character. A Next Spin Bar will also appear, showing what guaranteed bonus effects will happen on the next spin, depending on which position the Beam is on, and they are as follows.

1 Space Towards Tilly = Guarantees one or more Wrapped Candy Symbols to land.

2 Space Towards Tilly = Removes Green, Orange, and Purple low-paying symbols from the reels.

3 Space Towards Tilly = Guarantees one or more Wrapped Chocolate Symbols to land, and one of the 3 Molar Reel bonuses to trigger.

4 Space Towards Tilly = Removes all low-paying symbols for the next spin, and Fairy Flick or Sticky Fingers is guaranteed to activate.

1 Space Towards The Tooth Fairy = Guarantees one or more Wrapped Chocolate Symbols to land.

2 Space Towards The Tooth Fairy = Guarantees to trigger the Fairy Flick bonus.

3 Space Towards The Tooth Fairy = Guarantees a Wild Symbol will land.

4 Space Towards The Tooth Fairy = Guarantees a Rotten Wild Symbol will land.

Reaching 4 spaces toward either Tilly or the Tooth Fairy for the first time will award +2 extra spins, giving you the possibility of getting a maximum of +4 extra spins during a single bonus game.

Feature Buy

Through the Feature Buy, you can instantly trigger the various features and bonuses for a price based on the current bet.

3X = Triggers the BonusHunt FeatureSpins, making each spin 5 times more likely to trigger the Cavity Clash bonus game.

50X = Triggers the Tilly’s Temptation: FeatureSpins, making one of the three Molar Reel Bonuses guaranteed to trigger on each spin.

100X = Awards the Cavity Clash bonus game.

Final Thoughts on Toothrot Tilly

While Pineapple Play’s first two releases weren’t anything that really left a lasting impression on us, Toothrot Tilly does a better job at showing off their strengths, and it makes it even more apparent that the studio is partnered with Hacksaw Gaming through their Open RGS. We really enjoyed the silly, over-the-top theme and setting, however, it’s not like that’s everything, and it can carry this game to greatness. The studio delivered something different, both thematically and gameplay-wise, as they try to push familiar features slightly, which has its pros and cons.

The gameplay loop, at a glance, seems like something we’ve seen many times before, being boiled down to a Cascade game filled with Cash Prizes and Multipliers, however, as we said before, Pineapple Play did try something different through its Wrapped Symbols and the Molar Reel bonuses. Through the use of the Total Win Bar, any Cascade can quickly stack up its wins, even in the base game, as Wrapped Symbols can slowly fall in over the course of a spin, making you wait for the Molar Reel bonus to activate, which means some pretty anticipating and engaging spins as you wait to unwrap your prizes. However, coupled with the many bonuses in the Cavity Clash bonus game and keeping track of the Rotten Wilds counter, we do think the game can feel a bit mechanically overwhelming. While we personally don’t have an issue with it, as we enjoy all types of slot games, we can see it not jiving with all sorts of players, as it can take some time to really wrap your head around it. All in all, Toothrot Tilly is a fun, new release from an upcoming studio that tries to deliver on something new, and does so in a pretty neat package, but with its ups and downs that can easily split an audience.

Toothrot Tilly is Pineapple Play’s third-ever release, delivering on a strange twist on a common theme and fun spins through Wrapped Prizes and tons of bonuses.

Stack ‘Em Slot Review

This Stack ‘Em review offers a crash course in Hacksaw Gaming’s quirky cartoon-themed slot.

The 5×6 game is actually a sequel to Stick ‘Em, the first-ever online slot released by this developer. back in 2019. Once again, Canny the Can is the star of the show, along with his new friend Mona the Mouse.

With several engaging bonus features, this highly-volatile slot holds a maximum potential payout of 10,000x. Keep reading to learn how you could stack up your share of the prizes.

Software Provider Hacksaw Gaming

Release Date May 2021

RTP 96.20%

Volatility High

Max Win 10,000x

Reels x Rows 5 x 6

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.20 – $20

Number of Paylines Cluster Pays

Themes Retro, Cartoon

Basic Details of the Stack ‘Em Slot

Stack ‘Em Details, RTP and Volatility

Launching the highly-volatile Stack ‘Em slot reveals a grid of five reels and six rows. This isn’t a common layout in real money slots, but it’s just the start of this game’s unique and quirky features.

A cluster-paying mechanic requires you to build groups of identical symbols to win, rather than using paylines. There’s also a multiplier feature that causes losing symbols to fall off the grid. We’ll discuss this fully later in our review.

In this sequel, Hacksaw Gaming has bumped up the maximum payout to 10,000x, while the RTP is a marginally higher 96.20%. It’ll cost you between $0.20 and $20 to spin the reels.

Four snake symbols and a wild create a win during the Stack ‘Em base game. A 2x multiplier is applied to the $6.25 reward.

Theme & Graphics in Stack ‘Em

Stick ‘Em, the 2019 predecessor of this Stack ‘Em slot, introduced us to the story of Canny the Can. This yellow character with a bowler hat has a smile plastered across his face, despite being thrown in the garbage. We also learn that he’s now teamed up with a mouse named Mona, seen to the left of the reels.

The two friends dance to the catchy jazz beat that plays in the background. Don’t be shocked to find yourself bobbing your head to it as well. Along with the vintage cartoon style of the characters, the soundtrack reminds you of an old-fashioned Disney animation.

Canny comes from the trash, and all sorts of things end up in there. Perhaps that’s why the game’s symbols are a mismatch of objects, including a snake, a skull, a leaf and even a dead bird.

Stack ‘Em Slot Features

Hacksaw Gaming has really shown off its creativity with this slot’s theme and visuals. But what about its features and mechanics? Find out next in our Stack ‘Em review.

Regular Symbols

There are ten regular symbols in Stack ‘Em. Five of these are the low-paying letters: A, G, E, R and T. As if to emphasize the seemingly random theme, each letter is written in a different old-school font. A cluster of five awards 0.10x, with 25 or more of the same kind paying a maximum of 25x.

The game’s high-value symbols are a thumbs-up gesture, snake, skull, a dead bird with a knife lodged in its chest and a leaf. You’ll earn 0.25x for five of each, except for the thumb, which pays double. For a cluster of 25, the returns are 100x and 200x.

Wilds

A symbol bearing the word “WILD” in bold orange lettering can substitute for any regular symbol to help you form clusters. If you look closely, you’ll also notice a sketch of a child’s profile drawn in blue.

Scatters

Remember the mouse we mentioned earlier in this Stack ‘Em review? She serves as the slot’s scatter. Behind her are the letters “FS” in green. Why? Because three or more of these activate the free spins bonus.

Multipliers

After every base game win, multipliers appear below the reels. The value of each corresponds to the number of winning symbols seen on that reel. With its 5×6 grid, the total multiplier value can reach up to x30.

In addition, any symbols not involved in the win are wiped from the grid. Winning symbols remain, falling to the bottom, while new ones fall from above.

Free Spins

Three or more scatters will trigger the free spins bonus. You’ll move to a different location and receive five free spins, represented by hearts above the grid.

A multiplier tab also appears. Every win earned increases its value by the number of symbols involved. When the X symbol appears, all winning clusters connected with it are multiplied by the value on top.

Land the special question mark symbol for a mystery prize, including additional free spins and increased multipliers of up to 50x.

Buy Bonus

For 129x your bet, you can instantly trigger free spins. The Buy Bonus icon is at the bottom-left of the screen.

An X symbol pops off the grid during free spins to reveal a plus sign and the number 1, increasing the multiplier by 1.

How to Play Stack ‘Em Online

Stack ‘Em is very easy to play. Use the up and down arrows beside the large circular spin button to adjust your bet size. Then, form clusters of five or more identical symbols to earn prizes as indicated in the paytable.

Try the Stack ‘Em Demo for Free before playing for real money

Practice all you’ve learned in our review by playing the Stack ‘Em demo for free here on this page. It’s the best way to assess the features we’ve discussed so far, before heading to our recommended real money casinos to play for cash.

Stack ‘Em Review – Our Final Verdict

Stack ‘Em is quite the slot. It may be difficult to ascertain a clear theme, but the entertainment value is obvious. We were especially impressed by the stellar graphics, interesting features and a healthy 10,000x potential win. A slightly improved RTP rate of 96.20% was also appreciated

Canny the Can is the same happy chap we saw back in 2019, though the Stack ‘Em experience is different from the original slot. The multipliers, for instance, are a very welcome addition.

However, one small gripe: the bonus of just five free spins is a little disappointing. Stick ‘Em awarded as many as 15 free spins, and most slots provide more than just five bonus plays. Still, the fact that we’re splitting hairs to this extent should tell you that we really enjoyed this game.

Yeah, sounds pretty similar to the developer's megahit, but now the action revolves around building a tower instead of operating an aircraft. And that’s not the only major change. The core crash mechanics remain the same, but they operate in a different and unique way, and there’s now also a completely different approach to cashing out, which might be a true game-changer. The game starts with a crane holding building blocks that swing back and forth, and players are tasked to find the right moment to drop the blocks accurately, stacking them on one another. Each block needs to be aligned with the one below it, or the tower will be unstable and may ultimately topple over.Tower X follows a similar concept, though, it doesn't require players' input and is automated. You place a bet, before the round starts, and then the construction begins. Blocks drop automatically one by one, stacking higher and higher, increasing the multiplier and your winnings respectively.These blocks come in different types, each offering a different range of prize values. Each block will have a fixed value from the predetermined range, adding to the total win multiplier of the round when it drops. You’ll encounter five different kinds of blocks during the gameplay, as follows:What’s another twist? Knowing when to cash out before the multiplier curve breaks and the round ends unexpectedly has always been the primary objective in crash games. Usually, the game ends randomly, and if you haven’t cashed out in time, your bet and potential winnings will be lost. That means you are guaranteed to win the final reached multiplier value. The catch is that opting in for a round costs 100x of your chosen stake. Basically, you select a base bet, anything between €0.01 and €5, and you pay 100x of that amount to enter the game. So, in order to profit, the multiplier has to build up over 100x.In the Tower X online game, the maximum win is capped at 5,000x your bet, with the RTP value set at 96% - standard figures for the industry. Unlike some crash games where skill or reaction time can influence outcomes, Tower X eliminates that aspect entirely. Since the gameplay is fully automated, requiring no player input, all results are determined purely by random number generation, ensuring fairness and simplicity for all players.The interface is user-friendly and thoughtfully designed. To the left, you’ll see the game history, displaying multipliers achieved in previous rounds to help you stay in the loop with the game’s dynamics. To the right of the screen, you'll find several tabs allowing you to keep track of useful information and statistics. You can view bets placed by other players in the current round, check the history of your gameplay and wagers, and explore the leaderboard showcasing the biggest wins of the day, week, and month.Additionally, Tower X includes an in-game chat feature, allowing you to interact with other players in real-time. You can celebrate your wins together, share strategies, or just yap about anything you want with fellow gamblers, which adds a sense of community.ProsConsWhile crash games already offer a thrilling and distinct experience, Smartsoft Gaming has managed to take that uniqueness and elevate it even further. The automated stacking mechanic, the absence of a manual cash-out button, and the nostalgic nod to Tower Bloxx all work together to deliver gameplay that stands out within this niche. It’s simple, yet is packed with enough twists to keep players engaged and coming back for more.I really appreciate how Tower X combines familiar crash mechanics with a fresh concept. The auto cash-out feature removes the pressure of split-second decisions and FOMO, making it feel more approachable while still delivering pulse-pumping excitement.Overall, Tower X is a well-executed and innovative addition to the crash genre, and I believe it would appeal to both seasoned crash game players and those new to the scene.

sc_description: Backseat Gaming's Chicken Man slot throws you right into the heart of the action, with the 5x5 grid smack in the middle of the financial center of a large city. Towering office buildings loom on either side, setting the scene for some unusual superhero action. And who's our hero? A ripped rooster who looks ready for a cock fight, although he might be more at home in a fried chicken commercial. But hey, we're not here to judge his fashion choices, we're here to win some cash.You can spin the reels with bets ranging from €0.10 to €100, catering to all player types. Wins come your way when you land 3-5 matching symbols across any of the 19 paylines, running from left to right. Keep an eye out for the money bag symbol, as that's the top payer. Following close behind are the red gem, the golden trophy, and the globe. Land 5-of-a-kind wins, and you're looking at payouts between 2x and 50x your stake, including the lower-value royals.Now, let's talk about the all-important Golden Egg Wild. This beauty not only substitutes for any pay symbol to help you complete wins, but it also pays 100x for 5 on a payline. In the base game, it's your main hope for landing decent wins, but it truly comes to its right in the bonus games. Both features center around collecting these golden eggs, with each wild doubling the multiplier of the position it lands on before being collected. This multiplier action keeps building as long as you keep landing wilds, but only the climactic final free spin pays.All the collected wilds are then randomly placed on the grid and the position multipliers boost any wins they're part of. The top-tier Super Eggsplosion Bonus awards a dedicated position multiplier spin up front, for even more lucrative payouts. The Chicken Man game boasts an above-average top-tier RTP of 96.31 %, but beware that some casinos might offer lower RTP versions. With a high hit rate of 42 %, you can expect frequent wins despite the high volatility, and the max win is a solid 12,500x your stake.While the Golden Egg Wilds help you out also in the base game, there are no other main game features in Chicken Man Backseat Gaming. Instead, you have 2 wild collection and doubling position multiplier bonus rounds to look forward to. Let’s take a closer look!The Eggvenger's Assemble Bonus is awarded when you land 3 Safe scatter symbols in view, and only wild symbols and blanks will land in the initial collection phase of the feature. The spin counter resets to 3 each time you land a new wild, and wilds are collected in another counter while leaving behind an x2 multiplier on the grid. These position multipliers double each time a new wild lands, and the collection phase ends when you land 3 consecutive spins with only blanks.On the final free spin, after the collection phase has ended, all collected wild symbols are placed on random positions on the grid as regular pay symbols fill the remaining positions. The position multipliers boost any wins they partake in, with the multipliers being added together if more than one is part of the same win.You need 3 Bank scatter symbols in view to trigger the Super Eggsplosion Bonus, and it’s very similar to the Eggvenger's Assemble Bonus. However, this round starts with an upfront super spin, awarding nothing but blanks and position multipliers between x2 and x10. Then, the wild collection phase plays out, adding and/or upgrading position multipliers, before the final payout free spin plays out.Eligible players will find the Bonus Buy button down to the left, and it offers 3 different options in Chicken Man slot:ProsConsIt's quite funny how Backseat Gaming is such a fitting name for this Hacksaw partner. Their releases often feel like an apprentice trying to imitate the masterful creations of their mentor, but they still have some ground to cover. While Hacksaw games are renowned for their thematic consistency, Chicken Man feels a bit incongruent in this department.First off, our hero looks more like a Rooster Man, though "Chicken Man" admittedly has a better ring to it. But if they're going for humor, why does he look so serious? And why is he standing in the middle of the financial district? How do the wealth symbols on the reels tie into this superhero narrative? Is he robbing the bank, depositing a giant golden egg, or protecting it from villains? It's all a bit unclear. Having him face off against other animal superheroes in a cockfighting arena would’ve perhaps been more fitting.While our feathered friend does flex his muscles occasionally, overall, he comes across as a bit too static. He could've been more interactive, perhaps throwing golden egg wilds onto the grid in the base game, with each wild adding multiplier frames for a streak respin feature. This is where Hacksaw truly excels, balancing their games with explosive base game features that offer both a taste of the bonus rounds and the potential for face-melting payouts. Sadly, Chicken Man Backseat Gaming offers no base game features or modifiers at all, which makes for a rather dull experience.That said, the bonus games are pretty original. It's not often we see features where only the final spin pays. Talk about putting all your golden eggs in one basket. The collection phase is undeniably exciting, building anticipation for a potentially massive payout. The more wilds and lucrative multiplier positions you accumulate, the higher the tension soars. However, be prepared for some anti-climactic endings, as this is a highly volatile game. The bonus round is a real hit-or-miss affair, but when it hits, it can be to the tune of 12,500x your stake.Overall, Chicken Man is definitely worth a try, especially if you enjoy this type of Hail Mary bonus concept, similar to what you find in Wild Chapo. With a few tweaks and the addition of some engaging base game features, it could have been a real contender. But as it stands, it's a decent game with the potential for big wins, even if it doesn't quite reach the heights of the masterpieces Hacksaw routinely delivers.

You can play Johnny vs Chicken on all mobile devices, desktops, and notepads. You create a winning combination by landing 3 or more of the same symbol types on adjacent reels starting at the leftmost reel.

The lower-paying symbols are 9, 10, J, Q, K, and A. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 1X and 1.5X. The higher-paying symbols are a cactus, tequila, slot machine, chicken, and Johnny. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 2X and 8X.

The game’s Wild Symbol has the design of a gold bar with the text “W,” and creating a win with 3, 4, or 5 Wild Symbols pays 1X, 4X, or 8X the bet, respectively. The Scatter Symbol is two guns with the text “Scatter.” Landing 3 on reels 1, 3, and 5 will trigger the Bonus Game. Special Features & Slot Mechanics

The max win is 5,000X the bet.

VS Symbol & Expanding Wild

Whenever this symbol type lands on the reels and is part of a winning combination, it expands an entire reel and becomes an Expanding Wild Symbol.

Inside the Expanding Wild, a duel between two multipliers takes place. The possible multiplier values are 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 20X, 25X, 50X, 100X, and 500X. The multiplier that wins the duel is applied to the winning combination that includes the Expanding Wild. If multiple Wild Symbols are part of the same win, their multipliers are added together.

If you’re a fan of slot games, you’ll want to check out Book of Time from Hawksaw Gaming. But that’s not all! Book of Time also offers two types of reel accelerators for those wanting to up the ante: the Turbo and Super Turbo features. And for those who prefer to sit back and relax, automatic spins are also available. Keep in mind, though, that the game’s high volatility means that the payouts may not be as frequent, but when they do come, they can be incredibly generous. All in all, Book of Time is a thrilling and exciting game for those who love slot games. With Canny the Can at your side, the possibilities of traveling through time and winning big are endless. So place your bets, cross your fingers, and let’s go on this adventure together!

Max Win And Volatility

Are you ready to win big? Book of Time is the game for you! With a maximum win of 10,000 times the bet amount, this game gives you the chance to go home with some serious money in your pocket. Just be sure not to spend it all in one place, unless you’re planning on buying an island or something.

Book of Time’s graphics are striking and immediately capture the player’s attention. They’re so clear and detailed that you’ll feel like you’re really living the story with our friendly companion. attr_description: The Hold the Jackpot™ series from Wazdan has been going strong for a while already, and the main attraction gets company in Mighty Wild™: Panther. The theme is a bit unusual for this developer as well, but it’s safe to say that Wazdan has nailed the jungle animal trope in what amounts to a highly refreshing game. You cannot win anything in the base game, which is something you might be used to if you follow this developer, but there are 2 bonus games to trigger in this release.The Chance Level ante bet feature can help you out in that regard, and it comes with 3 levels that can increase your chances by up to 6 times. You can choose your preferred volatility level and spin pace from 3 levels as well, and Cash Infinity™ symbols can help trigger the Hold the Jackpot bonus. It comes with collector, mystery, and mystery jackpot symbols, while the Wild Rampage bonus comes with mystery and jackpot symbols. The max win is 750x your stake either way, and non-UK players can purchase either of the features with 5 levels of volatility.In addition to being able to choose your spin pace and volatility from 3 different settings, you can also choose between 3 Chance Levels. These are ante bets of 2x, 4x, or 6x your stake, and your Hold the Jackpot and Wild Rampage bonus chances are increased by the same amount. You cannot win anything in the base game, so there are no symbol values or paytable in this game.You need at least 6 Hold the Jackpot bonus symbols in view to trigger the Hold the Jackpot bonus game, and Cash Infinity symbols can help you out in that regard. They become sticky until the end of the next Hold the Jackpot bonus you trigger, and they come with cash prize values between 5 and 10 x your stake.The Hold the Jackpot bonus game plays out on 15 reels, and the triggering symbols are sticky. Only blanks or new bonus symbols can appear, and you start with 3 respins. The tally resets for each new sticky bonus symbol you land, and regular cash symbols pay between 1 and 5 x your stake. The Mini, Minor, and Major bonus symbols pay 10x, 20x, 50x your stake, respectively, and Collector symbols accumulate all prizes in view and apply a multiplier of x1 to x10 to the total value.You can also land Mystery Symbols and Jackpot Mystery symbols, and these are revealed when the feature ends. The mystery symbols will reveal any bonus symbol bar the Cash Infinity symbol, while the mystery jackpot symbols will reveal 1 of the 3 jackpots we’ve already mentioned above. The sum total of your winnings is paid when you run out of respins. If you manage to fill the grid with symbols, however, you win the 750x Grand Jackpot instead.The Wild Rampage Bonus Game triggers when you land at least 6 Wild Rampage Bonus Symbols in view, and you start with 3 respins here as well. The triggering symbols are sticky, and only new sticky wild rampage symbols or blanks will land during the feature. Each new wild rampage symbol that appears resets the respins tally to 3 again.You can land Panther Jackpot symbols that pay 10x, 20x, and 50x your stake, respectively, and Panther Mystery symbols will reveal a random Wild Rampage bonus symbol at the end of the feature. If you manage to fill all 15 positions with a wild rampage bonus symbol of any kind, you win the Grand Jackpot worth 750x your stake. The regular panther symbols pay between 2 and 40 x your stake for 2 to 5 on either of the 10 paylines.The Bonus Buy menu is available in some jurisdictions, but not in the UK for sure. You can choose between the Hold the Jackpot feature and the Wild Rampage feature, and both come with 5 levels of volatility. The price ranges between 50 and 300 x your stake for both features, and the Double Extreme versions come with 3 mystery symbols including 1 jackpot mystery symbol for the Hold the Jackpot feature.You get a brief taste of the base game, before we purchase the Double Extreme version of the Hold the Jackpot feature at 0:20 into the 2:18-minute highlights video. We came close to filling the whole grid with bonus symbols, and you can see it all for yourself by hitting the play button below.We haven’t really seen too many jungle animal slots from Wazdan before, so the audiovisuals of this game were definitely refreshing. The Chance Level ante bet system is a relatively new innovation, and it’s great to have 3 different options to increase your bonus game chances. Of course, you get 3 options also when it comes to spin pace and volatility, as usual, and the Hold the Jackpot feature comes with the usual selection of bonus symbols.The base game is all about triggering either of the bonus games, as you cannot win anything outside of the features. What’s brand new about this game is the inclusion of a second bonus round, and the Wild Rampage feature is somewhat similar to the Hold the Jackpot bonus. It comes with jackpot and mystery symbols, but no collector or jackpot mystery symbols like you can get in the Hold the Jackpot feature. Either way, the max win is 750x your stake, and it’s won by filling the grid with symbols in either of the bonus games.

And if you’re lucky enough to land a Wild symbol, it will pay out as much as the most rewarding symbol and can replace all other symbols except for the Scatter.

Speaking of the Scatter, the Leprechaun symbol is the one to watch for. It can land on reels 2, 3, and 4, and will give you a minimum of 8 Free Spins. And if you really want to increase your chances of hitting a big win, you can purchase the Bonus game by clicking on the cart button. All in all, Charms & Treasures is a fun and exciting slot game with plenty of potential for payouts. And with a maximum win of 1,414 times the value of your bet, it could be your lucky day!

Introduction to Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast

Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast is a casino slot from BGaming offering the familiar 3-Pot mechanic. We’ve seen plenty of recent releases with this mechanic, offering several Bonus Games, usually triggered randomly and with the chance of activating several at once. With games such as Genie Jackpots Combo Frenzy and Mummy’s Jewels 100 in mind, this is a familiar gaming experience without any surprises. Each Bonus Game provides a decent win potential, especially the Jackpot Spins, carrying payouts up to 5,000X the bet. There is nothing wrong with Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast, with a colorful and fun design, but it lacks the innovation of a highly rated game. Continue reading for more information.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast is a video slot by BGaming that features 5 reels, 3 rows, and 20 paylines. You can select bet sizes ranging from 0.2 to 260, with a default RTP of 96.57%. This game has medium volatility and a hit frequency of 30.3%, offering potential wins of up to 5,000X your bet. On average, it takes 105 spins to activate the bonus game.

The game’s design is based on a prehistoric theme, featuring volcanoes and dense jungle. The 5x3 game grid is in the middle of the screen, with Jackpots below the reels and the 3 volcanoes above the grid, each representing a Bonus Game. If you want to boost the gaming experience for a cost, activate the Feature Buy button on the left side. All other buttons, including the Spin and Bet Size, can be found below the reels. You can play Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast on all mobile devices, desktops, and notepads. You create a winning combination by landing 3 or more of the same symbol types on adjacent reels starting at the leftmost reel.

The lower-paying symbols are 10, J, Q, K, and A. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays 0.8X. The higher-paying symbols are cherries, watermelon, horseshoe, golden bell, and 777. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 1.2X and 3X.

The game’s Wild Symbol has the text “Wild” and, depending on whether you create a win with 3, 4, or 5 Wild Symbols awards a direct payout of 1X, 5X, or 15X the bet, respectively. There is no traditional Scatter Symbol here; instead, the Rocket Symbol can randomly trigger one of the game’s Bonus Games when it's revealed by the Mystery Symbol. During the Bonus Game, Instant Win Symbols can land with values ranging from 1X to 1,000X the bet, which can be collected by the Collector Symbol. Let’s find out what kind of features this game has to offer.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot of Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast?

The max win is 5,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot of Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast?

The features of this slot game are Wild Symbol, Rocket & Mystery Symbol, Bonus Games, and Feature Buy.

Wild Symbol

The Wild Symbol substitutes all symbols except for Mystery, Instant Win, Rocket, and Collector Symbols and helps you create winning combinations.

Rocket & Mystery Symbol

There are 3 different Rocket Symbols in this game: red, green, and purple. This special symbol type is an overlay symbol, and whenever it appears in view, it gets collected in the corresponding Bonus Game Volcano above the reels, with a random chance to trigger it.

The Rocket Symbol can only be revealed by the Mystery Symbol, which can also reveal regular paying symbols and Wild Symbols. The Mystery Symbol reveals the same symbol type. During the Bonus Game, Instant Win Symbols can also be revealed by the Mystery Symbol.

Bonus Games

This feature can be randomly triggered whenever a Rocket Symbol is collected in a volcano above the reels, activating the respective Bonus Game. Multiple Bonus Games can be awarded at once. The Bonus Games are:

Bonus Spins

This feature can be randomly triggered by the Red Rocket Symbol during the Base Game, awarding 12 Bonus Spins. During the feature, any Mystery Symbols that appear are nudged and expanded over the entire reel. It stays expanded until the feature ends.

Hold & Win Spins

This feature can be randomly triggered by the Green Rocket Symbol during the Base Game, awarding 12 spins. Only blanks, Instant Win, and Collector Symbols can land on the reels.

Instant Win Symbols can land with values of 1X, 2X, 3X, 5X, 10X, 20X, 50X, 100X, 250X, 500X, or 1,000X the bet. The Collector Symbol will collect all Instant Win Symbols in view and award +1, +2, or +3 additional spins. The Instant Win Symbols are locked in position until they are collected by the Collector Symbol.

If all 15 reel positions get filled, the last Instant Win Symbol to land is transformed into a Special Collector Symbol and awards +3 additional spins. This special symbol type will collect all Instant Win Symbols and Collector Symbols in view.

Jackpot Spins

This feature can be randomly triggered by the Purple Rocket Symbol during the Base Game, awarding 12 jackpot spins. Here, the Mystery Symbol can reveal the Mini, Minor, Major, Mega, and Max Jackpot, which can potentially award 10X, 25X, 75X, 1,000X, and 5,000X the bet, respectively.

During the feature, the aim is to collect the respective Jackpot Overlay Rockets. You need to collect 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 Jackpot Rockets to be awarded the Mini, Minor, Major, Mega, and Max Jackpot. All Jackpots can be awarded several times.

Bonus Game

Feature Buy

If you want to advance directly to the Bonus Game for a cost, use the Feature Buy options:

100X = Trigger single, double, or triple Bonus Games at random.

200X = Trigger the combined triple Bonus Game.

Final Thoughts on Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast

This game provides a colorful design and familiar mechanics, offering some decent win potential. In terms of design, we appreciate the effective animations and vivid colors, creating pleasant visuals.

As mentioned in the Introduction, this is another edition of the recently popular 3-Pot Mechanic, offering a chance to trigger up to 3 Bonus Games at once. Here, the provider has included all the correct elements of a 3-Pot game, which is a good variety without making it complicated. Obviously, we prefer to trigger all Bonus Games at once, but if we must choose, it’s the Jackpot Spin, which offers the max win of 5,000X the bet by hitting the Max Jackpot.

In conclusion, with a good mix of cartoonish visuals and pleasant animations, this game offers a strong design. In terms of gameplay, it lacks innovation, and we’ve seen it all before, but with that said, it should work fine if you are fond of the 3-Pot Mechanic.

Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast is a slot with good design and a decent alternative if you are a fan of the 3-Pot Mechanic.

Wilds can appear either as 1x1 symbols on any reels or as 1x4 stacked symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4, and the latter plays into the features, covered below.On any base game spin, the Most Wanted feature can trigger at random. However, the multiplier value resets between the spins.In the Super Free Spins though, the Sheriff’s Badge multiplier is sticky and does not reset. Players can activate the Super feature by unlocking all Wanted symbols in the regular free spins or by landing 2 Super Scatters and 1 regular Scatter symbol during the base game.Finally, players have an opportunity to trigger both of the features immediately via the Bonus Buy menu. Activating the normal free spins costs 70x the total stake, while the Super bonus comes at a cost of 299x the bet.To sum up, Wild Woof is a highly entertaining slot, with lots of features to keep players in the right mood during the gameplay. The wild symbols also step in for pay symbols to help complete wins, like wilds usually do.The Mystery Joker Jackpot Game triggers when you fill the screen with nothing but Mystery Joker Jackpot symbols. These are the Minor, Major, Joker, and Grand Jackpot symbols, and they pay 15x-100x, 100x-300x, 300x-600x, or 1,000x your stake, respectively.If you land 6 Mystery Mega Joker symbols that fill 2 reels, you get the option to buy a Respins feature. The Mystery Joker reels are held in place, and you can pay 20x your stake per respin of the remaining non-Joker reel. attr_description: Hacksaw takes you back to Ancient Egypt with Wings of Horus slot, a spooky sequel to their popular Hand Of Anubis. This time, two mummy-like pharaohs, each clutching a menacing cobra, flank the 5x6 grid, replacing the Anubis figures from the previous game. The monochromatic black and white visuals, a stylistic choice carried over from the predecessor, effectively enhance the game's eerie atmosphere, while the chanting soundtrack further intensifies the mood.Golden colors draw your attention to the premium symbols, which depict various Egyptian icons. Lower value symbols spell out H-O-R-U-S, and completing the word across a row awards a 500x instant prize. Standard wins are achieved by landing 3 to 5 matching symbols on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost reel. Offering 7,776 ways to win, Hacksaw has ditched the cluster pays win system for this follow-up. Premium symbols award 0.8x to 2x your stake for 5-of-a-kind, while low-value symbols pay 0.3x to 0.5x for the same.While the cascading wins mechanic from Hand of Anubis is also absent, Wings of Horus boasts a 33 % hit rate, meaning you can expect a win roughly every 3 spins on average. Wild symbols do not appear organically in the base game, but the Orb symbol transformation feature can turn multiple symbols wild or upgrade them to a higher value. Wilds help complete winning combinations by substituting for pay symbols and award 3x your stake for 5-of-a-kind.Wings of Horus caters to all players with a betting range from €0.1 to €100 per spin. The highlight is the bonus round, which comes in 2 tiers. Both versions build anticipation toward the final free spin, where up to 5 Orb symbols can be released to trigger a wave of symbol upgrades. Each bonus round win contributes towards the maximum of 5 orbs, increasing your chances of cracking the 15,000x max win. Although highly volatile, Wings of Horus is slightly less brutal than its predecessor, with a volatility rating of 4 out of 5 on Hacksaw's scale.The Orb symbols take center stage in all stages of Wings of Horus Hacksaw, with their climactic release on the final free spin of both bonus round tiers. Let’s take a closer look at how it all works!There are 2 types of Orb symbols in this game, and the blue Orb of the Moon symbol turns itself and all instances of a randomly selected symbol into a higher-value symbol or wilds. The red Orb of the Sun symbol does the same, but for two randomly selected symbols instead of just one.Spelling out H-O-R-U-S with low-value symbols on the same row awards a 500x your stake instant payout.Landing 3 FS scatters in view triggers the Revenge Of The Pharaoh Bonus Round, awarding 10 free spins. It comes with a Golden Progression Meter that increases per win, and filling this golden meter levels up the Purple Orb Meter which starts at level 1. On the final spin, the number of Purple Orbs achieved is added to the grid, turning into either Sun or Moon orbs. You can get up to 5 orbs this way, and you win +2 or +3 extra spins from 2 or 3 FS scatters in view.The Rise of the Falcon Bonus Round triggers from 4 FS scatters on the same base game spin, awarding 10 free spins. The only difference is that the Purple Orbs Meter starts at level 2, meaning at least 2 orbs are going to be unleashed on the final free spin.Eligible players will find the Bonus and Feature Buy menu via the small purple button down to the left. It comes with the following options in Wings of Horus slot:ProsConsWhile Wings of Horus game is a decent attempt to follow in the footsteps of its predecessor, Hand of Anubis, it doesn’t quite capture the original game's gritty essence. The Anubis characters and the soundtrack from the first game were more menacing and engaging. The mummy pharaohs in this sequel, with their dark, vacant eyes, lack personality. Although the atmosphere is somewhat creepy, the background music grew repetitive, and I found myself turning it off after a while, though I kept the sound effects.The symbols are visually similar to those in Hand of Anubis, though the gold accents are less prominent. This subtle use of color still effectively distinguishes the premium symbols from the lower-paying ones, which tend to blend into the monochromatic scheme. However, the Orb symbol upgrade system doesn't feel as exciting or impactful as the Soul Orbs Wild Multiplier feature in the predecessor. While Orbs land relatively frequently to upgrade symbol types, they rarely produce anything significant.Hacksaw is known for balanced games, where explosive wins can occur out of the blue in all stages. This seems less likely in Wings of Horus Hacksaw, due to the absence of the usual multiplier action. While 7,776 win ways and symbol upgrades offer the theoretical potential for big wins, the Orb transformations lack the tension and excitement I've come to expect from this developer. The 500x instant prize for spelling HORUS, while an okay addition, comes across as a cheap add-on to compensate for the lack of true base game thrills.The bonus round also fails to impress, with the final free spin feeling anticlimactic in most rounds during my testing. It's challenging to accumulate more than 2 or 3 Orbs, and their impact is often underwhelming. It would be one thing if they only produced wilds in the bonus round, but that’s sadly not the case. The 15,000x potential is solid enough, but it just doesn't feel as attainable as is usually the case. Overall, Wings of Horus is an okay sequel, but I would stick with Hand of Anubis if I had to choose between the two.

The 97.00% RTP stands out immediately in the BGaming catalogue. Most studios ship their hold-and-win titles at 96% or slightly below. Getting an extra percentage point on a medium-high volatility game changes the expected loss per session in a way you actually notice over time.

The 6x5 scatter-pays grid means wins form from clusters of matching symbols anywhere on the board, not on fixed paylines. Cascading wins remove winning symbols and drop new ones from above, chaining sequences where the momentum builds spin by spin. Pearl symbols carrying multipliers land throughout, adding to the total when a cluster completes in the same sequence.

One thing I always check before a session: whether the operator is running the correct RTP variant. BGaming publishes the 97.00% figure and I found it consistent at BC.Game and Rainbet during my testing. Open the game info panel before you spin and confirm the number. If it reads lower, switch operators.

How the two bonus modes work

Four or more scatter symbols on the 6x5 grid trigger the bonus. At that point you choose: Coin Respin or Sharks and Ladders. That choice carries real weight because the two modes have very different distributions. The choice also means you can never accidentally land in the wrong bonus for your mood or bankroll.

Coin Respin: the hold-and-win mode

The Coin Respin starts with 3 lives. Only dead symbols and sticky coins land during the sequence. Every time a coin lands, it locks in position and the lives reset to 3. The round ends when lives drain without a new coin landing, or when all positions fill with coins. Final payout sums all locked coin values.

Coins come in three tiers. Bronze carries the smallest values, Silver sits mid-range, Gold the highest. BGaming has not published exact per-tier ranges. The distribution behaves as you would expect: Bronze lands frequently for modest returns, Gold lands rarely and changes the round when it does. I played this at winz.io, which runs BGaming titles at the standard RTP.

My average return across a dozen Coin Respin activations came in at roughly 30x to 40x the stake. Three rounds came in under 10x. Two ran above 80x when a Gold coin locked early and gave the sequence room to accumulate. The mechanic is familiar. It plays cleanly on the 6x5 grid, where the larger surface area gives coins more room before the lives drain.

Sharks and Ladders: the board game mode

This one surprised me the first time I saw it. The slot switches from reels entirely and shows a Snakes and Ladders board. A small shark character advances across the path based on dice rolls, collecting pearl multipliers at each square it lands on. Some squares contain ladders that jump the shark forward, shortening the path to the end. Some squares cost extra rolls or reset progress.

Reaching the end of the board unlocks a prize wheel. It spins for a random prize between 100x and 5,000x. That is the only way to hit the maximum win in this game. The wheel is not guaranteed — it requires completing the full board path, and that depends on dice rolls going your way.

That is the honest read: this feature is two layers of variance. The dice rolls determine whether you finish the board. If you do, the wheel determines your prize.

On a good run the pearls add up and the wheel lands at the high end. On a bad run the board stalls and the session comes to nothing fast. I had one run return 340x at US$ 0.20 a spin, US$ 68. Two others never completed the board.

My view: Coin Respin is the right buy when I want a more contained range of outcomes. The sticky-coin mechanic delivers something most of the time if Gold coins co-operate.

That board bonus burns money fast on bad runs, but it is the only path to the full 5,000x. One-shot punt, not a repeatable strategy.

What does the base game feel like?

Scatter-pays on a 6x5 grid with cascading wins means the base game has more going on than a standard hold-and-win entry from another studio. My testing methodology covers how I track sessions and set limits before opening any game.

Individual spins either run a cascade that chains a few wins, or they dead spin. Medium-high volatility means the dead spins come in clusters. I tracked roughly 40 spins between bonus triggers in one session, which is typical for this volatility band.

The pearl multipliers landing during base-game cascades add texture. They do not drive outsized wins on their own, but they push decent cascades into returns that feel above average for the stake. A cascade that might pay 5x without a multiplier can land closer to 12x to 15x with a pearl in the mix. That keeps the base game from being purely dead time between bonuses.

The underwater theme is cartoon in execution. Bright colours, animated fish, a small shark mascot. It is not the most detailed art BGaming has shipped. It works for this conceit, though. The visual register is consistent with the dice-roll board mechanic. Realistic ocean aesthetics would have felt odd against a Snakes and Ladders board.

How does it compare to other BGaming hold-and-win titles?

BGaming has built several hold-and-win entries. The defining feature here is the dual-bonus choice. Most titles in the genre trigger one mechanic and you take it. The option to choose converts the bonus activation from a passive event into a small decision that depends on your balance and session goal.

The 97.00% RTP is the highest I have seen on a BGaming hold-and-win release. For comparison, plenty of hold-and-win slots across the industry run at 96.00% or below. That gap widens over long sessions and multiple bonus buys. If you are buying bonuses regularly across many sessions, the extra percentage point adds up to real money retained.

Like in other Cash’n Fruits releases, here we see a simple red-colored background and a bunch of familiar classic symbols, as well as hear the same sounds whilst spinning the reels. Introduction to Raidmark

Raidmark is a casino slot from Ace Roll that lets us join in on the biggest Viking raid of the century. The studio Ace Roll is a newcomer to the scene, being partnered with Hacksaw Gaming ’s OpenRGS and debuting in 2025. Previously, we’ve checked out their release, Mirage City, an EDM-themed slot game with tons of Multipliers, Respins, and Free Spins. Comparing that to Raidmark, and we’re in a completely different Millennium, being themed around Vikings. Gameplay-wise, Raidmark is a bit simpler in tone, being largely centered around its different Expanding Wilds with Multipliers that range up to 200X. Ace Roll has then taken inspiration from Hacksaw Gaming, introducing two different Free Spins bonus games which can keep the Expanding Wilds around for just a few more spins, helping you stack up wins and maybe reach the max win of 10,000X the bet.

Join the warship as we travel to new, fruitful lands, ripe for pillaging, alongside your fellow Viking Multiplier Wild Symbols. If you want to try the game for yourself, be sure to give the Raidmark demo a try.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Raidmark is a video slot from Ace Roll with 5 Reels, 4 Rows, and 14 Paylines. You can choose between making a Min.bet of 0.1 and a Max.bet of 100. Raidmark comes with a slightly higher-than-average RTP of 96.27%, high volatility, and a solid max win of 10,000X the bet.

In the base game, we find ourselves on a march in foreign lands, aiming for the kingdom on the horizon. Later in the bonus games, pillaging begins, first with the local village, and later, we find ourselves in the throne room, filled with chests of gold. You can play the game on most desktops, notepads, and mobiles.

The lower-paying symbols are 10, J, Q, K, and A. Creating a win with 5 of the same symbols will pay out 0.5X to 1X the bet. The higher-paying symbols are various weapons and armor, including axes, a hammer, a shield, a helmet, and a horn. Landing a win with 5 of the same symbols pays out 1.5X to 5X the bet. Then we have the two standard Special Symbols, namely the Expanding Wilds with Multipliers and Free Spins Scatter Symbols, but more on them in the next section.

Special Features & Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Raidmark?

You can win up to 10,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot Raidmark?

The features are Expanding Wilds, Onward Bonus Game, The Mark of Raid Bonus Game, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Expanding Wilds

Wild Symbols appear as 3 types of Vikings and substitute for all symbols except Scatter Symbols to help create winning combinations. Whenever a Wild Symbol is part of a winning combination, it will expand, revealing a Multiplier value, which depends on which Viking appeared. The Vikings are as follows:

Rookie Viking = Can appear with Multipliers ranging from 2X to 10X.

Raider Viking = Can appear with Multipliers ranging from 15X to 50X.

Veteran Viking = Can appear with Multipliers ranging from 100X to 200X.

Onward Bonus Game

By landing 3 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Onward Bonus Game with 10 spins, plus an additional random amount ranging from 1 to 12, determined by a dice roll. This bonus game keeps all features from the base game.

The Mark of Raid Bonus Game

By landing 4 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Mark of Raid Bonus Game with 10 spins, plus an additional random amount ranging from 1 to 12, determined by a dice roll. During the bonus game, each time a Wild Symbol lands, it will always expand, and after each spin, a random outcome determines whether each Expanded Wild Symbol remains on the grid or disappears for the next spin.

Feature Buy

Through the Feature Buy option, you can trigger various features and bonuses for a price based on the current bet.

3X = Triggers the BonusHunt FeatureSpins, making each spin 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game.

50X = Triggers the Disembark FeatureSpins, guaranteeing 2 Expanding Wild Symbols drop. But, no Scatter Symbols can land during the spin.

100X = Awards the Onward Bonus Game.

200X = Awards the Mark of Raid Bonus Game.

Final Thoughts on Raidmark

Raidmark completely switches the tone from Ace Roll’s previous releases, now instead coming with a darker and more gritty tone. We always enjoy some raiding and pillaging in our slots, and Raidmark leans into its Viking theme well, with a nice soundtrack and character-based Wild Symbols, which are also the main core feature of the game. It feels like the studio is still only testing the waters with graphics, animations, and visual style, which makes Raidmark maybe not look as good as it could and, even sometimes, feel a bit dated.

Outdated games can still be relevant if only their gameplay can catch an audience, and while we, and most players, love Expanding Wilds with Multipliers, it seems like Ace Roll is a bit too dependent on them. Any spin that they land on and trigger always feels great, as the paytable isn’t the best, so having additional Multipliers, especially those big 200X ones, is more than welcome. While there are two types of Free Spins, one of them doesn’t bring any new bonuses, and is literally only free spins, while the second one only has a chance to keep Expanded Wilds around for one additional spin. We expected something a bit more, maybe Sticky Wilds, or maybe something like a Total Win Multiplier, since the gameplay loop boils down to spinning for Wilds, which isn’t very fun in longer play sessions, as everything becomes a bit too repetitive.

Raidmark is a Viking-themed slot all about its Expanded Multiplier Symbols, as the rest of the game’s bonus games are a bit too shallow to really impact the spins in a meaningful way.

attr_description: While the 2 previous installments in Pragmatic Play’s PowerNudge range came with refreshingly original and well-made themes, the productive developer is back in familiar territory with Sweet PowerNudge. Not the most imaginary title either, and clearly a tip of the hat to their smash hit, Sweet Bonanza. The feature seems to trigger more frequently, and last longer, in the bonus round though, with the added benefit of an always active multiplier reel. It can build up impressive nudging win multipliers if you’re lucky, for payouts up to 5,000x your stake.The Ante Bet costs 25 % more per spin, and it doubles your bonus round chances. You win by landing between 5 and 15+ matching symbols in a cluster, and the top-tier cluster payouts are worth 10 to 100 x your stake. There are no wild symbols in this game, but hang on, as there are plenty of other features to cover.The PowerNudge feature takes center stage in all stages of the game, and it triggers each time you land a cluster win. If new reels get involved in a win, they start nudging as well, and repeat wins count as a new win.The rightmost reel is a Multiplier Reel that comes with multiplier values of x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, and x10. It’s not usually active in the base game, but it can be activated at random times. It nudges together with winning reels when active, and the multiplier value in the middle position gets added to the total win multiplier above the reel. The total win multiplier is applied to every win per nudge, and everything resets on the next spin.You need to collect at least 4 scatters within the same spin sequence to trigger the Bonus Round, and additional scatters above the minimum of 4 are carried over into the feature. This may help trigger extra spins. You start with 7 free spins, and collecting 4 scatters awards +3 extra spins (the collection meter doesn’t reset between free spins).The Multiplier Reel is always active throughout the whole bonus round, but the total win multiplier still resets to x1 between free spins. This Fruit Party review details a vibrant May 2020 release by the ever-popular slot developer Pragmatic Play. With a 96.47% RTP and a maximum potential win of 5,000x, there’s much to love about this highly volatile, fruit-themed game.

Basic Details of the Fruit Party Slot

Fruit Party Details, RTP and Volatility

To begin our Fruit Party review, we’ll quickly run through its key attributes. The action takes place on a 7×7 grid, but there are no traditional paylines here. Instead, you’ll need to form clusters of at least five matching symbols.

Spin the reels from as little as $0.20, but the maximum possible bet is $100 per play. A top payout of 5,000x is achievable in this highly volatile slot, which is rated 5/5 on the developer’s own variance scale.

The standard RTP is 96.47%, but some new online casinos appear to offer lower rates of 95.48% and 94.45%. Always keep your eyes peeled for the best possible value.

A win of $0.80 is seen beneath the reels. The breakdown – a cluster of 8x hearts and 5x grapes – is visible to the left.

Theme & Graphics in Fruit Party

Fruit is probably the most commonly-used theme of all in the slots world, but Pragmatic Play seems to love it more than most. This is certainly a colorful game, as many of this developer’s slots are, featuring vibrant symbols on the 7×7 grid. The reels sit in front of a lush, green, cartoonish countryside scene.

Despite the slot’s name, the music is actually pretty laid back. Imagine drinking fruit-based cocktails on a beach at sunset, but more like somewhere in the Caribbean than a party island. We really enjoyed it, but it’s more relaxing than we expected.

Overall, the game has strong Sweet Bonanza vibes. But we can immediately think of at least ten slots from this developer that appear similar to Fruit Party. That’s not necessarily a bad thing, especially if you’re a loyal fan of Pragmatic Play slots. Such players will undoubtedly enjoy the familiar look-and-feel.

Fruit Party Slot Features

In the upcoming section of this Fruit Party review, we’ll break down the game’s special symbols, features and bonus round.

Regular Symbols

There are just seven regular symbols in this slot, five of which are fruits. You’ll need to form a cluster of at least five in order to earn a prize. The best-paying symbol is the strawberry, which returns 1x your bet for five. However, rewards rise as high as 150x for a group of 15 or more.

Next in line is the orange, followed by the apple, bunch of grapes and plum. The maximum return for these is 100x, 90x, 80x and 60x, respectively. Match exactly five for rewards of 0.75x, 0.5x, 0.4x and 0.3x.

The two lowest-paying symbols are the star and heart. Prizes for these range from 0.25x to 40x and 0.2x to 20x.

Wilds and Scatters

Pragmatic Play’s Fruit Party slot uses a cluster pays mechanic, which explains why there’s no wild symbol. There is, however, a gold-colored fruit which acts as a scatter. Collect three of these to trigger the bonus game.

Tumbles

After each win, the symbols involved are removed from the reels, making space for new ones to tumble in from above. This can potentially lead to further wins from the same spin.

Random Multipliers

During the base game, random multipliers of 2x can be added to any symbols involved in a win. If that happens, the standard payout will be enhanced accordingly.

If more than one multiplier is involved, they are summed. For instance, two 2x multipliers combine to award 4x the regular payout. The highest possible multiplier award is 256x.

Free Spins

Collect three scatters to start the bonus feature with ten free spins. For each additional triggering scatter, an extra spin is awarded. The maximum is 14, which you’ll receive in exchange for seven scatters.

The random multiplier feature also applies during free spins, though it’s possible to receive 4x as well as 2x. In fact, the chance of receiving a multiplier is actually higher during the free spins feature than in the base game.

Buy Free Spins

You may buy your way straight into the free spins bonus round if you wish. Simply use the option to the left of the reels and pay a fee of 100x the bet.

A purple background is visible, indicating the bonus feature is underway. Two free spins remain, shown beneath the grid.

How to Play Fruit Party Online

As explained earlier in our Fruit Party review, there are no paylines in this game. Instead, the aim is to group together at least five matching symbols. To count towards the cluster, these symbols must touch, either horizontally or vertically, but not diagonally.

To spin the reels of Pragmatic Play’s Fruit Party slot, you’ll first need to set your wager using the plus and minus buttons. You can then either tap the double arrow icon to spin, or configure up to 1,000 automatic plays using the button beneath.

Try the Fruit Party Demo for Free before playing for real money

Before heading straight to real money casinos, it’s always a sensible strategy to play slots in demonstration mode first. This way, you can get to grips with the rules, features and volatility before staking any cash. Find out if this is the right game for you by trying our free Fruit Party game here on this page.

Fruit Party Review – Our Final Verdict

We’re big fans of Pragmatic Play, but we’d be lying if we said they don’t produce a lot of similar-looking games with recycled features. If you’re an experienced slots player, you’ll instantly recognise most of what’s on offer here. In fact, at first glance, you could be forgiven for mistaking Fruit Party as one of a dozen other possible slots by this developer.

Putting that aside, this game is certainly a lot of fun to play. Whether you’re new to slots or not, you’ll love the excitement offered by the random multipliers and the now-standard tumble feature. Pragmatic Play also deploys a consistent and user-friendly interface, which makes their games very easy to pick up and play.

In terms of rewards, there’s nothing incredible here, but everything is more than acceptable. Perhaps the 5,000x maximum possible win is a tad low for such a highly volatile slot, but that’s splitting hairs. Overall, this is a solid, if unspectacular release, that will keep you entertained time and again.

attr_review_text:
Introduction to Cosmic Clusters!

Cosmic Clusters! is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play with a space theme. Humans have over half a century of experience in space exploration, but the industry hasn’t grown as quickly as many people thought after the first astronauts set foot on the Moon in the 60s. The industry used to be a mix of cooperation and competition between nations, especially between the USA and Russia, with NASA and Roscosmos. However, even private companies, such as Elon Musk’s SpaceX, are now focusing on space travel.

This game presents an astronaut looking for valuable space gemstones. You make wins by landing symbols in a cluster, and every win results in a tumble that can lead to more wins. The loyal astronaut, who’s the game’s Wild Symbol, shows up in a random position on every tumble to increase your chances of scoring multiple wins.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, and Payouts

Cosmic Clusters! is a video slot from Pragmatic Play with 6 reels and 6 rows. There are no regular paylines, but wins are made by landing 5 or more symbols in a cluster. The Min.bet is 0.2, and the Max.bet of 240 can be increased to 600 by using the Ante Bet. The default RTP is 96.45%, but other versions of 95.52% and 94.53% are also available. The game has medium volatility and a max win of 5,000x the bet. The hit frequency is 24.51%, and the Free Spins trigger 1 time in 294 spins.

Cosmic Clusters! takes us to a purple space. Comets, meteors, and gemstones are soaring through the air, and bigger planets are hovering in the back. In the lower-left corner, a golden circle spins, and above it is the game’s logo. To the right of the 6 reels is an astronaut in a white costume soaring. To make a win, you need to land at least 5 matching symbols in a cluster, connected either horizontally or vertically. The game is available on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers.

The lower-paying symbols in Cosmic Clusters! are green, pink, blue, and purple gemstones. They pay between 6x and 9x the bet for wins of 36 symbols. The higher-paying symbols are red gemstones, alien ships, satellites, green aliens, and bunches of gemstones. They will give you between 12x and 50x the bet for wins of 36 symbols. The Wild Symbol substitutes all symbols except the Scatter Symbol.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Cosmic Clusters!?

You can win up to 5,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Cosmic Clusters!?

The features are Tumble Feature, Wild Symbol, Random Wild Feature, Money Symbols, Free Spins, Ante Bet, and Feature Buy.

Cosmic Win

Tumble Feature

Winning symbols will disappear whenever you score a win. The remaining symbols fall down, and new symbols are added from above. If you can make a new win when the grid is refilled, those winning symbols will also vanish and make way for new ones. A tumble continues until you’re not making any more winning combinations.

Wild Symbol

The Wild Symbol is an astronaut who substitutes for all regular-paying symbols in making winning combinations. It doesn’t substitute the Scatter Symbol.

Random Wild Feature

On every tumble, a Wild Symbol is added to a random empty position before the reels are refilled.

Money Symbols

There are three types of Money Symbols: bronze, silver, and gold. They are worth between 0.5x and 1,000x the bet. Landing 5 or more Money Symbols in a cluster will award you the cash values of all symbols.

Free Spins

Landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 Scatter Symbols anywhere on the reels awards 12, 15, 18, or 21 Free Spins. All Money Symbols that are not part of a winning cluster fall down to the bottom of the screen and stay there until a winning combination is formed.

Landing 2 or more Scatter Symbols awards 2 extra spins.

Ante Bet

You can increase the chances of triggering the Free Spins 2.5 times by using the Ante Bet 1, which will increase your base bet by 50%. Activating Ante Bet 2, which increases your base bet 2.5 times, boosts your chances of activating the Free Spins five times.

Feature Buy

You can trigger the Free Spins directly from the base game by paying 100x the bet. For 300x the bet, you get the Super Free Spins, where all Money Symbols will be silver or gold. If you want to go all in, you can purchase the Epic Free Spins for 1,000x the bet and play the feature with only golden Money Symbols.

Final Thoughts on Cosmic Clusters!

It feels like the creators of Cosmic Clusters! watched a few space documentaries and decided to add some gemstones to the dark, colorless space. The result is actually way more entertaining than it sounds. The colorful space is combined with cluster pays, tumbling wins, random Wilds, and Money Symbols that can occasionally make you feel like you've just discovered a valuable asteroid.

The cluster mechanic works great for this type of game, with enjoyable tumbles where the loyal astronaut shows up to help you. The Money Symbols add excitement even during spins that seem ordinary at first glance, while the Free Spins feature is clearly the main attraction, with the possibility of collecting extra spins and locking Money Symbols at the bottom of the screen.

The RTP of 96.45% is also solid, and the max win of 5,000x the bet is on the lower side for a game of 2026, but it’s definitely acceptable considering the medium volatility. For other space-themed slots, don’t miss Hacksaw Gaming’s Munchy Milo or Relax Gaming’s Space Attacks Dream Drop.

Cosmic Clusters! from Pragmatic Play is a fun cluster-pay slot with solid features and smooth gameplay. It may not be the next giant leap for slot gaming, but it's a pleasant journey through space that most players can enjoy without needing astronaut training.

attr_description: We’re unsure why Pragmatic Play has decided to fill a money-themed game set in a vault with typical and generic fruit slot symbols. All winning symbols lock in place for a respin. Each reel increases its respective row count by a number equal to the number of locked symbols on the reel, and each reel maxes out at 8 rows.A maxed out 6x8 grid gives you 262,144 win ways, and the respins go on as long as you add to the original winning combination, or create new winning combos. Your total win is summed up when you land a non-winning respin, or when you fill the entire grid with nothing but winning symbols. Everything resets to the default 6x4 grid with 4,096 win ways between spins.Both wilds and scatters lock in place with the regular symbols during respins, and you need at least 3 scatters in view in the same sequence to trigger the Bonus Round. You get 8 free spins as a minimum, but each new triggering scatter above 3 awards +4 extra spins on top of that. You also win +4 extra spins when you land 2+ scatters in a free spins sequence, and +4 on top of that for every extra scatter above the minimum of 2.The triggering spin sequence determines the size of your starting grid in the bonus round, and the Increasing Ways do not reset between free spins. What’s more, a progressive win multiplier comes into play, and it starts at x1 for the first locked win. It then increases by +1 per respin that follows, with no upper limit. The Tumble Feature is what does away with traditional paylines. With this, symbols can match anywhere on the grid. When they do, they then disappear, and new symbols fall onto the grid. If these lead to more matches, then this repeats until there are no more winning matches.
