Twilight Princess Details, RTP and Volatility

This Pragmatic Play release is a manga-themed 5×5 slot with a maximum potential win of 7,500x. It appears to draw inspiration from a number of similarly-themed online slots, including Starlight Princess by the same developer.

The highly volatile slot has a theoretical RTP of 96.08%, which drops slightly to 96.01% if you use the Buy Free Spins feature. Bet sizes range from $0.20 to $240, offering something for high rollers and casual gamers alike.

A Cluster Pays mechanic is used to dish out rewards. This means you’ll need to collect a cluster of five or more identical symbols to earn a win.

Theme & Graphics in Twilight Princess

Pragmatic Play’s Twilight Princess slot is set high in the sky, in a fantasy kingdom where the titular character rules. She is seen levitating to the right of the predominantly purple reel grid, wielding a magical staff with which she increases your rewards.

With a heavy dose of pastel colors, the graphics evoke a sense of calm. Its symbols complement the theme, with precious stones, a crown, a bell, a flower and the Twilight Princess herself all appearing on the reels.

A jolly and upbeat tune plays as you spin, which couldn’t sound more like a Japanese arcade game if it tried. The music’s intensity increases during the free spins bonus, while the princess shouts magic spells intermittently to boost your wins.

A cluster of five heart-shaped gems pays a reward of $1.50, seen beneath the reels. The game’s logo is shown top-left.

Twilight Princess Slot Features

You’ll find all of the usual Pragmatic Play features present in their Twilight Princess slot. This means a steady supply of wilds, scatters and free spins to help you earn the 7,500x max win.

Regular Symbols

Five brightly-colored low-paying gems are found on the reels. Creating a cluster of five or more earns you a prize. The green gems are the lowest in value, with five of them good for 0.25x payout, rising to the maximum 7.5x for 20 to 25. Pink hearts pay the most of these gems, with 12.5x for a group of 20 to 25.

The game’s premium symbols are a winged shield, a lotus flower, a golden bell, a crown, and the princess herself. Naturally, she is the highest-paying of all, worth 50x for a cluster of 20 to 25 symbol

Wilds

Look out for the pink orb with ribbons and a golden “W” design, as this is the slot’s wild symbol. It can appear anywhere on the grid, replacing all other symbols except for the scatter.

The wild also features a random multiplier of x2, x3, x5 or x10. This is applied to every win containing a wild and, if more than one multiplier is involved, their values are added together. In addition, there’s a 50x payout up for grabs if you can fill all 25 spaces with wilds.

Scatters

The filming yellow orb is the scatter, which may appear on all five reels. With three, four or five of this symbol, you’ll earn 2x, 15x, and 100x your bet. Three or more landing simultaneously will also trigger the free spins bonus.

Free Spins

When activating the Twilight Princess bonus feature, you’ll initially win ten free spins. However, you can retrigger the feature with two, three, four or five scatters. These earn you five, ten, 20 and 30 extra spins, respectively. Scatters can land as overlays on top of any regular symbol.

All wild symbols appearing on the grid during this round become sticky, remaining in place until the game ends.

Five sticky wilds with multipliers are on the reels during a free spins round. Only one free spin remains, seen to the left.

Buy Free Spins

The last feature worth mentioning in this Twilight Princess review is the Buy Free Spins option. Here, you can pay your way directly into the bonus game, without waiting for it to trigger organically with scatter. All it requires is a fee of 100x your current bet.

You can configure up to 1,000 automatic spins by tapping the “Autoplay” button below this.

If you form a cluster of five or more identical symbols, your win amount is displayed at the foot of the screen. Access this from the “i” symbol in the bottom-left corner.

If you’ve made it this far into our Twilight Princess review, you’ll likely be eager to give it a try. Do so now with our free Twilight Princess demo, before heading off to play for real money. Like all free slots, this demo game allows you to get to grips with the rules in a safe but entertaining environment.

Twilight Princess Review – Our Final Verdict

While there is nothing particularly outstanding about the Twilight Princess slot, the gameplay is certainly rewarding. It all starts with the impressive quality of the game’s visuals. The familiar Pragmatic Play layout is intuitive and colorful, while the animations and soundtrack greatly enhance the experience.

The game really looks and feels a lot like Starlight Princess, but also Gates of Olympus. If you’re a fan of such titles, this release will definitely appeal, even though the RTP is slightly lower. At least Twilight Princess offers a greater maximum payout than those two, fixed at 7,500x.

Much of the Twilight Princess gameplay has been seen before and does sort of feel like a reskin. That doesn’t have to be a bad thing, though. After all, the two aforementioned titles proved very popular with the slots community. Overall, this is a solid slot that will undoubtedly appeal to fans of a certain genre.

Sadly, John Hunter and the Book of Tut falls into the latter category. It’s not a bad game by any means, but it does not bring the book series an inch forward in terms of innovation, twists or originality.On a positive note, if you like the original Book of Ra, John Hunter and the Book of Tut stays very true to its legendary source of inspiration. The big difference is that the visuals are more modern, and the RTP is a lot higher (at least at most casinos, but beware of the flexible RTP ranges). This is hardly John Hunter's first rodeo, and he should be quite familiar with the tombs of ancient egypt by now. So are we, by the way, and we think this game would have benefited from a more original theme, and perhaps also a 2 scatter respins feature, to give you a break sometimes when it comes to triggering the all-important bonus round.As you might have guessed already, John Hunter himself is the highest paying symbol in this game, and there are also 3 other egyptian related symbols of higher value here. The regular royal symbols have been dressed up with some egyptian ornaments, but they still pay low compared to the premium symbols. You need between 3 and 5 matching symbols on in a combination to win, and here we present you with the paytable for John Hunter and the Book of Tut slot:Being a true to form book slot, we all know what it boils down to here, and that is the free spins bonus round. Still, you will benefit from the book wild symbol also in the base game. This symbol pays pretty well in its own respect, as you win 200x, 20x and 2x when you land 5, 4 and 3 on a payline. The book wild will also step in for all regular symbols to help you form winning combos.In this respect, it acts just like any wild symbol does in most games, but the book serves double duty as a scatter symbol also. This means that you will get the payout mentioned above when you land 3 to 5 anywhere on the reels, and this is also how you trigger the game’s all-important free spins bonus round.Free spins in John Hunter and the Book of TutAs we’ve already mentioned, you need to land 3, 4 or 5 book scatter symbols anywhere on the same spin to trigger the free spins feature. This gives you 10 spins no matter how many scatters you land. You will then be taken to a new screen, where the pages of the book reveal different random symbols as you scroll through them.Eventually, one of the regular symbols will be chosen as the special symbol. This will be the symbol that expands to cover the entire reel whenever you land it during the bonus round. The good news is that this chosen expanding symbol does not need to line up on adjacent reels to pay. You can land it on reels 1, 3 and 5, for example, and it will still give you a payout as if it landed on reels 1, 2 and 3. Please note that the chosen symbol will only “bother” to expand if this means that it will become part of a winning combination.In case you think 10 free spins is not enough, you can retrigger the feature and get 10 new spins when you land at least 3 book scatters during the feature. This means that you can easily glean how much each symbol pays per total stake, and you also find good info about the game rules and other useful things in the info screen.The next thing to do is decide on your bet level, and you can easily change your stake with the plus and minus buttons on either side of the spin button. The hamburger menu, which is located above the volume control in the left hand corner, takes you to the game settings. Here you can turn on quickspins (which we recommend), and you can also turn on or off the music and/or sound effects.If you want to lean back and relax while the reels are spinning, you can click the autoplay button below the spin button. Here you can choose between 10 and 100 autospins, and you can stop the autospins if your bankroll is reduced by a chosen amount. Introduction to Sweet Bonanza Pop

Sweet Bonanza Pop is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play with a very familiar sugary theme. Or actually, the game is created by Pragmatic Play Pop, a studio which used to be called Fat Panda. It specializes in mobile slots, and you will soon understand why it’s the perfect studio for this release. Sweet Bonanza Pop is a video slot from Pragmatic Play with 3 reels, 5 rows, and no paylines. Wins are instead made by landing 5 or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid. The game’s Min.bet is 0.1, and the Max.bet is 250. The default RTP sits at a generous 97.05%, but the game is also released in versions of 96.58%, 95.59%, and 94.56%. The hit frequency is 30.12%, and you can expect medium volatility. Although the grid is small, you can take home a max win of 25,000x the bet.

Sweet Bonanza Pop has a colourful candyland background with pink clouds, large sweets and a pastel sky surrounding the narrow vertical game screen. The reels are neatly positioned in a standing position in the centre, looking like it’s made specifically for mobile phones, but you can also play the game on tablets and desktops. A win is achieved by getting 5 or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid, after which the winning symbols vanish and are replaced by new ones. The same process can repeat several times during a single spin, keeping the action running smoothly.

The lower-paying symbols in Sweet Bonanza Pop are bananas, grapes, and plums, which pay between 2x and 6x the bet for 9 matching symbols. The higher-paying symbols are the round candy pieces, square candy pieces, and heart-shaped candy pieces, paying between 10x and 50x the bet for 9 symbols. Special Features & Slot Mechanics

You can win up to 25,000x the bet.

Introduction to Moon Princess Extreme

Moon Princess Extreme is a casino slot from Play'n GO, where the power of three teenage spellcasters grows beyond what you've ever seen before in the series. The Moon Princess saga probably doesn't need much introduction if you engage in some reel spinning even occasionally. It was arguably the first anime-themed slot when it launched in 2017, and even if it wasn't, it definitely became the most popular. Its fame spawned multiple sequels, such as Moon Princess Stargazing and Moon Princess Trinity, that experimented with various tweaks and features layered on top of the familiar setup. This new instalment, however, goes back to the basics to turn the dial up on one core element - the win multiplier. It can now grow up to a staggering x1,000, especially during free spins, where it becomes persistent.

With the new multiplier cap, the game offers a massive max win of 50,000x the bet. If you'd like to test its power without risking your real money, you can do that in the free demo mode available at the top of the page.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

Moon Princess Extreme is a video slot from Play'n GO with 5 reels, 5 rows, and a modified cluster-pays system that awards wins for matching at least 3 symbols in a straight line. The betting range consists of multiple options, ranging from a Min. bet of 0.1 up to a Max. bet of 100. The game's math operates on a default RTP of 96.20%, indicating stable, long-term returns. However, several lower variants have also been released, including 94.20%, 91.20%, 87.20%, and 84.20%. Therefore, be sure to verify your version before playing. You can expect high wins to happen less frequently but be more valuable on average due to high volatility, while the max win can reach 50,000x the bet.

As in most previous instalments of the series, Moon Princess Extreme places you in an unspecified location with a strong cosmic feel delivered by a cloudy sky dotted with stars in the background. The dark, hazy scene behind the grid provides a strong contrast for the glossy symbols on the reels and gold trims embellishing most of the UI elements. The upbeat, rock soundtrack that accompanied the original has changed to a slower, more dreamy tune to emphasise the ethereal atmosphere. Princesses customarily accompany you on the desktop version of the game, standing watch next to the grid and swapping places whenever you trigger their powers. The overall design is highly polished and responsive, meaning it adapts instantly to any device you play on, whether it's a desktop, a smartphone, or a tablet.

Creating winning combinations requires landing at least 3 matching symbols in a straight horizontal or vertical line anywhere on the grid. Among the low-paying symbols, there are emblems in the shape of a green disc, a blue star, a pink heart, and a gold bell, awarding 0.5x the bet for a complete line of 5. The high-paying group includes images of the three princesses, Love, Storm, and Star, which yield payouts of 1.5x the bet for a 5-of-a-kind hit. You can also mix and match the premium symbols, in which case they award 1x the bet for a set of 5. Wilds appear as a moon with golden ornaments, and they substitute for all regular symbols, while paying 2.5x the bet for a full line.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Moon Princess Extreme?

You can win up to 50,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Moon Princess Extreme?

The features are Cascading, Wilds & Multiplier, Girl Power, Trinity, and Free Spins.

Free Spins

Cascading

The game features a cascading system, which causes every winning combination to leave the grid and the remaining symbols to drop to vacant positions. Contrary to the classic version of this mechanism, no new symbols are added to complete the view, as clearing the grid in the base game leads to triggering free spins.

Wilds & Multiplier

Every 3-of-a-kind win leaves behind a wild in its middle position. Additionally, every win increases the win multiplier on the meter by one step. At the beginning of a round, the multiplier can also increase by a random number of steps. The value resets to x1 when the next paid spin begins.

Girl Power

Any non-winning spin can trigger the Girl Power of the princess currently visible next to the grid. When she applies her modifier to the grid, the next princess takes her place.

Star = adds 1 or 2 Wilds in random positions.

Storm = destroys two sets of symbols.

Love = transforms one set of symbols into another type.

Girl Power - Storm

Trinity

Every win consisting of princess symbols charges the Trinity Meter. You need to highlight all three of its segments to trigger the feature. Scoring 3, 4, or 5-of-a-kind wins charges 1, 2, or 3 portions, respectively. When the meter is full, and all cascading ends, a fresh spin is awarded with all three princesses activating their powers one after another in a continuous sequence.

If you manage to clear all regular symbols from the grid during the Trinity feature (Wilds can remain), you trigger Free Spins. There, you have a choice between three distinct modes, each with one princess active at all times.

Love = 4 initial spins and 4 on retrigger.

Star = 5 initial spins and 3 on retrigger.

Storm = 8 initial spins and 2 on retrigger.

Throughout the round, the win multiplier does not reset between spins and can grow up to x1,000. Each completion of the Trinity meter awards a retrigger with a batch of extra spins, up to a maximum of 100. Clearing the grid during the bonus round awards an instant prize of 20x the bet multiplied by the active multiplier.

Final Thoughts on Moon Princess Extreme

Since 2017, the Moon Princess saga has morphed into all kinds of variations that tweaked the original mechanics in one way or another. The results were definitely intriguing, but it didn't seem like any of the sequels overshadowed the original despite offering higher max wins, like Moon Princess Origins and its 20,000x cap. Perhaps that's why Play'n GO decided to go back to the basics and improve only one element that influences the value of wins the most - the multiplier. Moon Princess Extreme takes everything from the initial format and infuses it with higher values. Well, that's actually not true for every single element of the game, as base payouts have dropped quite a bit, but that's the price for colossal increases in other areas, like the mentioned multiplier and the total number of free spins in one playthrough, which now can reach a round 100. All these changes also lead to the highest max win so far in the series, tapping out at 50,000x the bet, at least on paper. Will it be enough to draw the players to this new instalment in hopes of hitting it big? Time will tell.

Together with boosting the original mechanics, the studio has also overhauled the theme quite a bit. More detail, gloss, and polish are visible all around, making all the symbols and meters around the grid pop pretty intensely against the misty night sky in the background. Thanks to these refinements, the overall design feels a bit more whimsical and dreamy than before, with the slow, twinkling soundtrack contributing significantly to the atmosphere. For some players, it may appear a bit less energetic if you put it against the first Moon Princess, but then again, some kind of audiovisual evolution was expected, given the almost decade-long gap between the two titles.

Moon Princess Extreme is the most daring entry of the series yet, with a max win of 50,000x coming from the original gameplay empowered with much higher multipliers.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot 4 Fantastic Vikings Go Ice Fishing?

You can win up to 10,240x the bet.

What features are available in the slot 4 Fantastic Vikings Go Ice Fishing?

The features are Money Ways, Mighty Kraken, Fighting Respins, and Feature Buy.

Fighting Respins

Money Ways

Fish symbols carry cash prizes up to 50x the bet. Depending on the reel they land on, there's a different maximum value they can achieve.

Reel 1 = up to 1.8x.

Reel 2 = 0.6x - 3x.

Reel 3 = 1.5x - 5x.

Mighty Kraken

Randomly, a giant 2x2 Ice Blox holding 4 single cash prizes can land on the grid and trigger the Mighty Kraken feature. The monster will break up the block and rearrange cash prizes on the grid to form or improve a successful combination.

Vikings visible above the reels collect coins that land on their respective columns. Reel 6 (Gunnar) = collects all cash prizes on the grid.

Whenever a reel is full of cash prizes, a Shark will appear to merge them into one position and apply an x2 multiplier to the total value.

Feature Buy

20x = Mighty Kraken Spin, guaranteeing one 2x2 Ice Blox.

125x = Trigger Fighting Respins with a chance of random Vikings becoming Berzerk.

The original 4 Fantastic Vikings Go Fishing slot was a genuinely interesting merger between Yggdrasil's iconic 'Vikings Go' series, which began with the Vikings Go Wild release in 2015, and 4ThePlayer's 4 Fantastic Fish slot, which operated on Money Ways and cash-collecting respins. In the sequel, you'll experience much of the same vibe, albeit in a more rough environment, as the Vikings decided to point their compasses north and explore the coldest parts of their region in search of the next catch. And while the setting feels quite different thanks to that, we must point out that the majority of art has been reused from the original, including most of the symbols and animations. There are some subtle changes to accommodate the freezing climate and a couple of new mechanics, but that's about it. Despite that, it's still a rich, vibrant, and eye-pleasing scene that's super easy to sink into and enjoy for a good while.

Not that much has changed on the technical side, either. The main appeal still revolves around connecting cash prizes into ways during the base game, be it organically or with the help of the Kraken, and locking them in place during Fighting Respins. Like before, the Vikings winning their fights on the corresponding reels will award unique modifiers, from multipliers and collectors to added values and guaranteed catches. There's also one extra hero added to the line-up, who will throw in a bunch of extra respins, but without affecting the overall reset value. A pretty significant addition, considering you want a round like this to go on for as long as possible. In summary, the wintery sequel plays almost identically as its older sibling, but does make the effort to diversify the experience a bit.

4 Fantastic Vikings Go Ice Fishing builds quite timidly on the original game's mechanics, but it doesn't hold it back from being an entertaining and engaging slot.

Boat Bonanza Slot Review

Join us in our Boat Bonanza review, as we bait the hook ahead of an exciting angling adventure.

Perhaps hoping to replicate the success of the popular Big Bass series, this Play’n GO game is the first in a fishing-themed trilogy. Released in October 2022, the 5×3 slot offers a sturdy 96.21% RTP.

Set sail with us on our Boat Bonanza review, and prepare to haul in a maximum win of 5,000x.

Software Provider Play’n GO

Release Date October 2022

RTP 96.21%

Volatility High

Max Win 5,000x

Reels x Rows 5 x 3

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.20 – $50

Number of Paylines 12

Themes Fishing

Basic Details of the Boat Bonanza Slot

Boat Bonanza Details, RTP and Volatility

Play’n GO opts for a conventional grid of five reels and three rows, albeit with only 12 paylines. One version of the game offers an RTP of 96.21%, statistically above the average for slots. However, some new online casinos feature lower rates of 94.25%, 91.25%, 87.24% and 84.22%.

You can spin the reels for as little as $0.20 per play, with the maximum bet size potentially rising to $50. In return, the Boat Bonanza slot offers a maximum potential payout of 5,000x your wager. Mind you, the game is highly volatile, so patience may be required ahead of a big catch.

Five Catch Symbols bearing cash values and a scatter appear on the reels. The boats are inactive above reels two and five.

Theme & Graphics in Boat Bonanza

On the subject of slot themes, Boat Bonanza revolves around a fishing expedition. The game begins with a simple animation, before whisking you out to sea. Here lies the 5×3 reel grid, just beneath the water’s surface, marked by thin, demarcating lines.

In addition, the symbols and bonus features further accentuate the theme. For instance, the special fish and lobster symbols, known as Catch Symbols, which boost your rewards. Other base game icons include important components of an angling expedition, such as lobster cages and fishing reels.

Boat Bonanza looks very much like Big Bass Bonanza in its presentation and style. However, this particular slot boasts sharper graphics and more lively imagery than the Reel Kingdom and Pragmatic Play classic. Finally, if you’re a fan of sea shanties, you might find the slot’s soundtrack entertaining.

Boat Bonanza Slot Features

Next up in our Boat Bonanza review, we’ll take a “deep dive” into the slot’s various gameplay elements and bonus features.

Regular Symbols

Playing card icons 10 through A are the lower-paying symbols here. All of these return 0.5x your wager for three, 2.5x for four and 10x for five on a payline.

Up next are four higher-paying fishing-themed icons. In the ascending order of payouts, these are a lobster cage, fishing reel, seagull and a buoy. The highest-paying icon returns 200x for five-of-its-kind, but it’s also the only symbol that pays for two on a line.

Wilds

A common symbol in classic and new slots alike, Boat Bonanza does not feature a wild. Instead, there are Catch Symbols, which offer even more exciting rewards.

Scatters

The slot’s scatter symbol is a trawler. Land at least three of these anywhere on the reels to trigger the free spins feature.

Catch Symbols

Look for two grayed-out boat icons above the reels. At random, one of the boats may become active above any of the reels, triggering a Catch Symbol beneath it.

There are four Catch Symbols, which are a golden lobster, plus three fish in different colors. Each of these appears on a rectangular background with a shade of yellow or orange.

Catch Symbol prizes range from cash, multipliers and a fixed reward of 1,000x your bet.

Mega Catch

If both boats become active above one reel, the Mega Catch feature is triggered. Here, all Catch Symbols on the reels are collected and their respective prizes awarded.

Free Spins

Hitting three, four or five scatters rewards you with ten, 15 or 20 free spins, respectively.

The two boats are active through the feature, starting with a x1 multiplier. Landing Catch Symbols on active boat reels will earn you multiplier boosters or extra free spins. An active boat can increase its multiplier to a maximum of x5, with up to 39 free spins available.

Players can also earn respins when Catch Symbols bearing cash values are collected. During respins, only Catch Symbols appear on the reels, which this continues until no further symbols appear.

The Mega Catch feature is active during a free spins round. Both boats are active on the third reel with a x4 multiplier.

How to Play Boat Bonanza Online

Toggle your bet size using the plus and minus icons beneath the reels. Afterwards, hit “SPIN” to get the game started.

Land at least three symbols on a payline, from left to right, to earn a payout. The only exception is the buoy, which returns 0.5x for two.

Don’t forget the “AUTO” button, which allows you to play hands-free for up to 100 spins. For faster spins, hit the lightning bolt icon in the bottom-left corner.

Try the Boat Bonanza Demo for Free before playing for real money

As tempting as it is to play at one of our top-rated real money casinos, we recommend trying the free Boat Bonanza demo first. Available here on this page, it allows you to put all you’ve learnt into practice, risking your own money.

Boat Bonanza Review – Our Final Verdict

It’s fair to say that the market for fishing-themed slots is oversaturated. All that Boat Bonanza and its sequels have managed to do is struggle in a jam-packed genre.

Unfortunately, there’s a lot of cloning going on, too. For instance, the Catch Symbols are strikingly similar to the money symbols of Pragmatic Play’s Bigger Bass Bonanza, another slot with 12 paylines.

That’s okay if you’re differentiating in other areas, but the 5,000x maximum potential payout isn’t exactly stunning. The RTP is lower than most of the Big Bass games, while the level of volatility is the same.

There are some positives to Boat Bonanza, however. The interface is easy to use, the minimum bet size is fair and the Mega Catch feature is a little bit different.

If you’ve never seen any other fishing-themed slots, you’ll probably enjoy this game. But the veterans will likely see right through it.

Introduction to Rat Royale

Rat Royale is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play where rodents rule the world. We’ve previously been invited to other rat kingdoms, such as the Junkyard Kings series and Rat King. This time, we are presented with a darker theme, where the Rat King rules with an iron fist, presenting an eye-catching and edgy take on the rat theme. In terms of gameplay, it offers an appealing approach revolving around Wild Rat Multipliers with special effects. Rat Royale successfully strikes a balance between effective and uncomplicated gameplay, making it easy to continue spinning the reels without it becoming repetitive. It doesn’t have the innovative touch of the studio’s best releases, but it should appeal to those who enjoy Wild Multipliers and a darker slot environment.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Rat Royale is a video slot by Pragmatic Play that features 5 reels, 5 rows, and 259 ways to win. You can select bet sizes ranging from 0.2 to 240, with a default RTP of 96.52%. However, casino operators can choose 95.5% or 94.53%. On average, it takes 1 in 174.25 spins to trigger the Bonus Game, and the base game hit frequency is 24.39%. Rat Royale has medium volatility and a max win of 15,000X the bet. The max win hit frequency is 1 in 55,248,619, and wins bigger than 10,000X, 5,000X, or 1,000X the bet average 1 in 18,518,519, 3,125,000, or 49,521 spins, respectively.

The game’s design is based on a dystopian theme in which rats have taken control. Here, we’re invited to the Rat King’s layer, with him sitting on the right side of the 5x5 game grid among golds, skulls, and coins. If you want to boost the gaming experience for a cost, activate the Feature Buy button. All other buttons, including the Spin and Bet Size, can be found below the reels. You can play Rat Royale on all mobile devices, desktops, and notepads. You create a winning combination by landing 3 or more of the same symbol types on adjacent reels starting at the leftmost reel.

The lower-paying symbols are 10, J, Q, K, and A. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 0.3X and 0.6X. The higher-paying symbols are blue, green, purple, and red rats. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 0.75X and 3X.

The game’s Wild Symbol has the design of a “W” and can land with a multiplier value from 1X to 100X. It can also land as the Rat King Wild on reel 3, with a value of up to 500X. Creating a win with 5 Wild Symbols pays 3X the bet. The Scatter Symbol has the text “Scatter” and landing 3 or more will trigger the Bonus Game. Let’s find out what kind of features this game has to offer.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot of Rat Royale?

The max win is 15,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot of Rat Royale?

The features of this slot game are Wild Symbol, Free Spins, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Wild Symbol

The Wild Symbol substitutes all symbols except the Scatter Symbol and helps you create winning combinations. Creating a win with 5 Wild Symbols pays 3X the bet.

The normal Wild Symbol can land with a multiplier value of 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 8X, 10X, 12X, 15X, 25X, 50X, or 100X. The multiplier value is applied to all wins its part of. If several Wild Multipliers are part of the same win, their values are added together before being applied.

The Rat King Wilds can only appear on reel 3, and work as a regular Wild Symbol. They can carry a multiplier value of 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 8X, 10X, 12X, 15X, 20X, 25X, 50X, 100X, 200X, or 500X. They work with the same mechanics as the regular Wild Multiplier.

The following Rat King Wild Symbols can appear on the reels:

Red Gem Rat King Wild = If one or more winning combinations are created, it expands and fills the entire reel. It adds a +1X multiplier to all Red Rat Symbols on the reels.

Purple Gem Rat King Wild = The multipliers of all normal Wild Symbols on the reels are added to this symbol’s multiplier.

Green Gem Rat King Wild = Adds its current multiplier to the multiplier of all normal Wild Symbols on the reels.

Blue Gem Rat King Wild = Each Rat Blue Symbol on the reels becomes a normal Wild Multiplier Symbol.

This Bonus Game can be triggered by landing 3 or more Scatter Symbols on the reels during the Base Game. Depending on whether you land 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols, you activate the Blood Ritual, Blood Pact, or Blood Lust, respectively. All Free Spins features start with 10 Free Spins. Landing 3 or more Scatter Symbols during all features grants +5 additional Free Spins.

Blood Ritual = Plays like the base game, but all Wild Symbols that land on the reels are guaranteed to have a multiplier value of at least 2X.

Blood Pact = A Rat King Wild Symbol is always present in the middle position of reel 3. Each Free Spin, it gets a random gem, changing its Rat King Wild effect. Multipliers added to their multiplier values are persistent throughout the feature.

Blood Lust = A fully expanded Rat Kind Wild Symbol is always present on the middle reel. Each Free Spin, it gets a random gem, changing its Rat King Wild effect. Multipliers added to their multiplier values are persistent throughout the feature.

Feature Buy

100X = Trigger the Free Spins with an RTP of 96.54%.

500X = Trigger the Super Free Spins with the Blood Lust variant guaranteed. Played with an RTP of 96.52%.

Final Thoughts on Rat Royale

Pragmatic Play delivers an edgy take on the rat theme, featuring an unusually dark tone and sharp design. We love a good backstory, as it adds substance and personality to the slot experience. Here, we are invited to a rat kingdom where the Rat King makes the rules, creating an appealing movie-like vibe, complemented by a fitting soundtrack.

So what about the gameplay? Rat Royale is another entry in Pragmatic Play’s deep multiplier portfolio, including games like Sugar Rush and Gates of Olympus. Here, the studio connects the theme to the gameplay by making the Rat King Wilds the game’s main selling point. However, the normal Wild Multiplier can’t be ignored, as it can appear with a multiplier value ranging from 1X to 100X. The Rat King Wild can only land on the middle reel with a corresponding effect, such as boosting multiplier values and expanding Wilds. As usual, the game peaks during the Bonus Game, which is divided into 3 versions, with Blood Lust as the most powerful. Easter Island

Easter Island is an egg-citing five-reel, 25 paylines slot game that will crack you up! The game is a basket of fun with a variety of bonus features that will definitely satisfy your needs as a slot player. The game offers a hopping mad time with standard options like any other slot video game, such as the Auto Play button for the laziest of bunnies, and the Max Bet option for the riskiest of players.

When it comes to gameplay, Easter Island is an egg-ceptional slot game that is easy to understand, even for those who are new to slot gaming. The game has a user-friendly interface, egg-cellent graphics and sound effects that are perfect for the Easter season. The reels are filled with Easter-themed symbols, including decorated eggs, bunnies and flowers that will put a hop in your step and a smile on your face.

Graphics

If you’re looking for unrealistically detailed graphics that make you feel like you’re staring into a portal to another world, then Easter Island may not be for you. But let’s be real, if you’re playing online slots for that level of realism, you may want to consider taking a break and going for a walk outside.

That being said, the graphics of Easter Island are still enjoyable and pleasant to look at. The bright green field and palm trees in the background make you feel like you’re taking a much-needed vacation, while the sound effects make you feel like you’re actually on the island (minus the sunburn and sand).

Overall, the graphics are simple, but effective in creating a peaceful atmosphere for the player. It’s not every day that you can take a mini-vacation right from your couch!

Symbols

If you’re a fan of Easter and bunnies, you’re in for a treat with Easter Island slot game!

The bunnies in this game are more than just cute and fluffy creatures that hop around the reels. They have a special ability to replace every other symbol on the reels, except the scattered Easter bird! The Easter bird symbol is what triggers the bonus feature of this game. Hopefully, you won’t have to look too hard for it as it’s more elusive than the Easter bunny himself.

Aside from the bunnies and the Easter bird, you’ll find an array of colorful Easter-themed symbols on the reels. The happy symbols include pink flowers, a bucket of eggs, and palm trees. Beware though, not all symbols in Easter Island are created equal, and you’ll definitely want to avoid the skull and the broken Easter egg symbols.

Bonus Features

Let’s talk about the best part of this slot game: the bonus features! Although there are only two bonus features in Easter Island, they are definitely worth playing for. Trust us, this game isn’t called Easter Island for nothing – there are plenty of eggs to crack open.

The Prize Pick bonus feature gives players the chance to pick from a selection of eggs to reveal a prize inside. Now, we know what you’re thinking – this sounds like playing chicken with your luck, right? But fear not, because the rewards in these eggs are worth it! Just be sure not to pick the rotten egg…

Next up, we have the Free Spins bonus round. In order to trigger this feature, you’ll need to land three or more of the Easter Island scatter symbols on the reels. The number of free spins you get depends on how many scatters you land. Remember to watch out for those expanding wilds during the free spins – they can really boost your winnings!

And for all you high-risk players out there, don’t worry – there’s a gamble option too. Are you feeling lucky? Then go ahead and take that chance. Just be sure to keep your chicken wings crossed and your hopes high!

Paylines

Are you ready to hop your way to riches with Easter Island? This 5-reel slot game comes packed with 25 egg-citing paylines! That’s right, you’ll have 25 chances to hatch a winning combination and score big. Keep in mind, the more you bet, the higher the potential payout can be.

In order to make a winning combination, you’ll need to land at least two or three matching symbols depending on the value. But don’t worry, it’s not as hard as finding a needle in a haystack! With fun and friendly Easter Island themed symbols like Moai heads and happy little birds, it’s a hoppin’ good time!

These little rascals can help you crack open some massive payouts. So keep your eyes peeled for the wild bird and the Easter Island surprise box. They just might be the key to unlocking some amazing bonuses and free spins.

Our Recommendations

Looking for a fun and engaging slot game? Look no further than Easter Island! With its simple features and easy gameplay, it is perfect for novice and experienced players alike. The graphics and sound will transport you to a tropical paradise, making you feel like you’re soaking up the sun on Easter Island itself.

You never know when you could trigger a winning combination and hit the jackpot!

If you’re a fan of Easter-themed slots, we also recommend giving Easter Eggs from Play ‘N Go a spin. It has a similar fun and festive vibe, and who doesn’t love an Easter egg hunt?

Overall, we highly recommend Easter Island for a chance to win lucrative rewards and experience the joys of spring in a fun and exciting way.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab a fruity drink, put on your best grass skirt, and start spinning those reels!

Whether you’re a seasoned player or a novice, the fast-paced slots action will keep you on the edge of your seat.

A hand on the left side of the grid maintains a disc indicating the assigned multiplier, which is a nice little touch that keeps you informed on your potential payout. Oh, and let’s not forget the soundtrack – it’s absolutely epic and adds to the overall immersion of the game.

attr_description: We were quite impressed by the first installment in this Pragmatic Play series, Rise of Giza PowerNudge. Not only because of the innovative Powernudge mechanic, but also because of the unusual steampunkish ancient Egypt theme. The Powernudge mechanic provides a break from the base game grind on a regular basis, and the nudging has cleverly been incorporated into the Money Respins bonus round. The 4,000x potential hasn’t changed, and overall we quite enjoyed this sequel.You win by landing 3-5 symbols on adjacent reels from left to right, but the winning combo can start on any reel. The symbols pay between 1 to 20 x your stake, and all wins trigger the Powernudge feature. All winning symbols nudge one position down after the initial payout, as the non-winning positions respin. This mechanic goes on as long as you have winning symbols present on the grid.The Ante Bet feature can be switched on/off between base game spins, and it increases your bet size by 25 %. Turning the ante bet on adds more mystery money symbols to the reel strips, which doubles your bonus game chances. The RTP drops slightly, to 96.44 % with the top-tier setting, if you play with the ante bet turned on.The Golden Lion Mystery Money symbols can land on all 5 reels, and you need 6 in view at the same time to trigger the Money Respins bonus round. The triggering symbols become sticky on an otherwise cleared grid, and you get a line-up of multipliers starting at x1 above each of the reels. The Mystery Money symbols reveal 1 of 3 symbols as follows:When the Money Mystery Symbols reveal cash values, the multiplier above the relevant reels will apply to boost the value before it’s added to your total. The symbols turn into Mystery symbols again after that, and nudge down one position before they once again turn into cash or multiplier symbols. The remaining positions respin at the same time, potentially awarding more mystery symbols, and the feature goes on as long as there are mystery symbols present.The Money Respins feature can be purchased via the in-game feature, but this option is not available in all jurisdictions (and not in the UK for sure). The bonus buy will set you back 100x your stake, and it comes with an RTP of 96.47 % (which equals the top-tier overall RTP of this game).You get a brief taste of the base game powernudge feature, before we purchase the Money Respins feature. It starts around 40 seconds into the 4:38-minute highlights video, and it plays out for the remainder of the video. We racked up pretty solid multipliers towards the end, which landed us decent back-to-back wins, and you can check it all out by hitting the play button below.Holding down the space button gives you an excellent turbo spin pace. It’s only broken up by the core Powernudge mechanic, in which things slow down a bit. This is not a problem however, since you get to plow through dead spins and pay attention when potentially larger repeat/improved wins can appear. A fill screen win awards 200x your stake at best though, but with repeat nudging wins it amounts to an okay base game potential.Of course, you get top-up wins most of the time, and the big difference compared to the previous Rise of Giza PowerNudge, is the bonus round. Making use of the Powernudge mechanic in a hold-and-win style feature is a clever innovation, not unlike the mechanic itself, and the whole thing builds towards a climactic finish as the reel-multipliers keep building. sc_description: We were quite impressed by the first installment in this Pragmatic Play series, Rise of Giza PowerNudge. Not only because of the innovative Powernudge mechanic, but also because of the unusual steampunkish ancient Egypt theme. Goblin Heist Powernudge features an evil thieving goblin set in a fantasy world, but the base game plays out in a very similar fashion thanks to the nudging respins provided by the core mechanic.The visual presentation is overall engaging, with plenty of animated antics on the reels, and the mischievous goblin stands with an evil grin and a lit dynamite fuse in his backpack on the right-hand side. The Powernudge mechanic provides a break from the base game grind on a regular basis, and the nudging has cleverly been incorporated into the Money Respins bonus round. The 4,000x potential hasn’t changed, and overall we quite enjoyed this sequel.You win by landing 3-5 symbols on adjacent reels from left to right, but the winning combo can start on any reel. The symbols pay between 1 to 20 x your stake, and all wins trigger the Powernudge feature. All winning symbols nudge one position down after the initial payout, as the non-winning positions respin. This mechanic goes on as long as you have winning symbols present on the grid.The Ante Bet feature can be switched on/off between base game spins, and it increases your bet size by 25 %. Turning the ante bet on adds more mystery money symbols to the reel strips, which doubles your bonus game chances. The RTP drops slightly, to 96.44 % with the top-tier setting, if you play with the ante bet turned on.The Golden Lion Mystery Money symbols can land on all 5 reels, and you need 6 in view at the same time to trigger the Money Respins bonus round. The triggering symbols become sticky on an otherwise cleared grid, and you get a line-up of multipliers starting at x1 above each of the reels. The Mystery Money symbols reveal 1 of 3 symbols as follows:When the Money Mystery Symbols reveal cash values, the multiplier above the relevant reels will apply to boost the value before it’s added to your total. The symbols turn into Mystery symbols again after that, and nudge down one position before they once again turn into cash or multiplier symbols. The remaining positions respin at the same time, potentially awarding more mystery symbols, and the feature goes on as long as there are mystery symbols present.The Money Respins feature can be purchased via the in-game feature, but this option is not available in all jurisdictions (and not in the UK for sure). The bonus buy will set you back 100x your stake, and it comes with an RTP of 96.47 % (which equals the top-tier overall RTP of this game).You get a brief taste of the base game powernudge feature, before we purchase the Money Respins feature. It starts around 40 seconds into the 4:38-minute highlights video, and it plays out for the remainder of the video. We racked up pretty solid multipliers towards the end, which landed us decent back-to-back wins, and you can check it all out by hitting the play button below.Holding down the space button gives you an excellent turbo spin pace. It’s only broken up by the core Powernudge mechanic, in which things slow down a bit. This is not a problem however, since you get to plow through dead spins and pay attention when potentially larger repeat/improved wins can appear. A fill screen win awards 200x your stake at best though, but with repeat nudging wins it amounts to an okay base game potential.Of course, you get top-up wins most of the time, and the big difference compared to the previous Rise of Giza PowerNudge, is the bonus round. Making use of the Powernudge mechanic in a hold-and-win style feature is a clever innovation, not unlike the mechanic itself, and the whole thing builds towards a climactic finish as the reel-multipliers keep building. The 4,000x potential is the same as before, and overall this is a pretty solid follow-up release.ProsConsRise of Giza PowerNudge - is the futuristic-style ancient Egypt installment where Pramgaitc Play first introduced the Powernudge feature, and it comes with a very similar base game. A progressive multiplier increases by +1 per spin/nudge in the free spins round, and you can win up to 4,000x your stake.Evil Goblins - comes with perhaps even more mischievous goblins than the game at hand, but they look kind of similar. The goblins hang out on top of the reels, awarding different features, and the xBomb triggers cascades while increasing the multiplier and expanding the grid. You can win up to 31,969x your stake, which is more likely in the 2-level bonus round.Goblins and Gemstones - is a Kalamba installment featuring far more sophisticated goblins that actually run a bank of sorts. The base game is all about gemstone collection, which eventually triggers the bonus round. The feature can trigger via scatters also, and you can then choose from 3 modifier modes for payouts up to 38,890x your stake.

attr_description: You can be forgiven for not knowing much about Amusnet Interactive, and we can tell you that this studio doesn’t really belong to the cream of the crop. It is capable of releasing some decent slots, though, so let’s now examine the one called Blue Heart. Its playing field has 5 reels, 4 rows and 100 paylines, and it’s worth pointing out that the number of paylines isn’t fixed.The theme of Blue Heart is all about precious gems, though you’ll also get to meet two characters on the slot’s reels. It’s supposed to be your usual glamor slot, but, unfortunately, the delivery falls a bit flat, and the game’s visuals are nothing to write home about.As for the slot’s math model, it comes with a low-medium volatility level, and the most you can win in one go is 1,000x your bet. That, of course, is without taking the game’s progressive jackpots into consideration. The least that you can play for is then £0.01 per spin, while high rollers can risk as much as £1,000 per game round at select casinos. Finally, the theoretical RTP of Blue Heart is 96.03%.There are 10 pay symbols in Blue Heart, and it’s possible to divide them into 4 low pays, 4 mid pays, and 2 high pays. For low pays, there are your usual card ranks, and those pay up to 1.25x your bet per combination. Then, there are various precious gems and stones, which pay up to 4x your bet per combo. Finally, there are two character symbols, which pay 6x your bet for a full set.Aside from those, there are also Diamond Wilds and Jewellery Scatters. Diamond Wilds can substitute for other symbols in combos, and they also come with high payout values of their own. Jewellery Scatters, on the other hand, trigger free spins.For that to happen, you have to land 3 Jewellery Scatters in one go. You’ll then activate the Free Spins feature, which comes with 10 free spins and possible retriggers.Next, there’s the Jackpot Cards feature, which can trigger at random after any paid spin, and which is how you can win the slot’s progressive jackpots. Once you trigger the feature, you’ll get to keep picking from cards until you collect 3 with a matching suit. Then, you’ll grab the corresponding progressive jackpot and return back to the base game!And, to round things off, there’s also the Gamble feature that you can use to – hopefully – boost your wins. It’s your usual card-guessing affair, though, and it doesn’t really add anything of substance to the actual gameplay.At the end of the day, it’s hard to be excited about Blue Heart. While it’s always nice to be able to win 4 progressive jackpots, the game’s presentation is rather unappealing, and it all just feels unpolished and rough overall. Blue Heart is not a particularly bad game, but there are many better ones out there.

sc_description: A year and a half after the release of the first installments of what seems to be becoming a series, Peter & Sons is ready with a sequel - Barbarossa Revenge DoubleMax slot. An online slot powered by the GATI platform and backed by the top-tier provider Yggdrasil who generously has provided the game’s mechanics.Barbarossa or Red Beard was a real historical figure who died in 1546 after he played a key role in the Ottoman Empire to seize control over the Mediterranean in the 16th century. His real name was Khidr, and he started as an ordinary pirate but soon became famous for his brutality and excellent maritime knowledge.The Barbarossa Revenge DoubleMax is a pure buccaneer casino game with marvelous graphics, striking animations, and sound effects. It comes as a sequel to the extremely successful Barbarossa DoubleMax, featuring the same DoubleMax mechanics or as the provider has named the engine - Double Rush Multiplier feature.This mechanic doubles the win multiplier on each cascade, as usual, but this time, it's enhanced with a couple of twists. I will explain them along with the bonus minigame, Bonus Buy, and Golden Bet in one of the following sections. For now, let's see what Peter & Sons has prepared in visual and technical appearance.The setting suggests a naval battle with many ships sailing and sinking, and the player's view is from Captain Barbossa's ship. A cannon is on the left loading cannonballs with increasing multipliers to shoot at the grid, which consists of 5 reels and 3 rows. It seems to be the battleground and offers 243 ways to win.The ship’s watch bell on the right is the Golden Bet switch, while the Buy Feature tab is on the left. The Multiplier Trail beneath the reels shows what multiplier values are on their way, while the screens and control tools are in the toolbar at the bottom of your screen. Barbarossa Revenge is an HTML5 slot compatible with Android and iOS.The wild symbol in the game appears only as a result of a DoubleMax cascade. It pays no cash but substitutes for all symbols except the Gold Skull scatters. Symbols pay for 3, 4, or 5 on a winning way, starting from the leftmost reel and continuing to the right.They don't pay large sums, but the constantly upgrading multipliers and the potential for bulk payouts compensate fairly. Captain Barbarossa brings the heftiest prizes of 0.50x, 0.80x, and 1x the bet. His crew consists of 2 male and 2 female pirates who pay up to 0.80x and 0.50x the stake.The low-valued symbols are ship equipment and deliver lower rewards. Sextants and Pistols pay 0.10x to 0.30x, while Telescope, Cannonballs, and Magnifying Glass on a Map award from 0.05x to 0.25x the bet. The betting range is rather limited but provides enough stake levels for developing a decent strategy - €0.20 to €50 per spin.The Barbarossa Revenge DoubleMax comes with a ranging RTP and super high levels of volatility according to the provider's memo. The highest payout rate is 96.45% and the alternatives are 96.40%, 96.30%, 95%, 94%, 90.50%, 86%, and potentially others. The Hit Frequency rate is 25.03%, but it may also vary according to the RTP variant.It's unnecessary to say that you should go for the highest payout versions of any online slot. The others are simply not worth your time and money and will most probably lead to a loss. The Barbarossa Revenge max win is 50% bigger than the first game - 30,000x the bet up to €1,500,000.Barbarossa Revenge DoubleMax game is packed with a potentially lavish Free Spins bonus that will lead you to the depths of the sea. There, the infamous Captain and his crew will appear in far creepier forms, which is another "Bravo" for the artwork quality. The slot mechanics will also act differently to help you take another step toward the ghostly loot.DoubleMax is an innovative mechanic introduced by Yggdrasil but used by many partnering studios. Symbols forming winning combinations disappear, causing cascades of new blocks landing on their positions. Moreover, on one, randomly selected spot, a wild symbol is guaranteed to appear.The cascading sequence will continue until no new combos are formed. On each cascade, the win multiplier doubles with no upper limit: x1, x2, x4, x8, etc. Thus, a lucky spin could have a truly devastating outcome, and I've seen multipliers exceed x1,024 easily.Golden Multiplier or the Cannon Cashout feature is a special multiplier cannonball that, when executed on the board, guarantees a win. You can see it in the form of a larger, glowing cannonball on the Multiplier Trail beneath the grid. It will carry the respective DoubleUp multiplier and will affect the payout as usual.The Multiplier Jumps feature is another random twist, but this time it's taken from the original slot's script. It's indicated as a cracked cannonball on the chain beneath the reels. Whenever such is loaded into the cannon and used, it will cause the multiplier to jump up one position. This feature may trigger up to 3 times in a row, causing a massive multiplier to build up faster.Scatters trigger the bonus and 3 in view award 7 free spins, while each scatter on top adds 2 extra free spins. All base game features are active during the minigame and activate more frequently, according to the provider. Moreover, the DoubleMax multiplier does not reset between the free spins and can skyrocket with a bit of luck.The Buy Feature tool, if available, will help you trigger the Free Spins bonus immediately. You can choose from 2 available options at the displayed prices, but keep in mind that profits are not guaranteed. The RTP rate remains the same as the base game, as well as the featured volatility.If you are not willing to buy the bonus but wish to boost your chances for its random activation, you can enable the Golden Bet. It will increase the base bet by 1.50x without changing the regular payouts. In return, you will have a 2x chance to trigger the Free Spins minigame.ProsConsBarbarossa Revenge DoubleMax Peter & Sons is an excellent upgrade of a game that is still quite popular. With several small adjustments, Peter & Sons managed to increase the volatility and the max win with a massive 50%! Furthermore, they successfully kept the heart of the game and made it even darker and more epic, breathing extraterrestrial life to an actual person who was appointed Grand Admiral of the Ottoman Navy.Multipliers are always wanted, and this is one of the features that can never drop in the boring section. Moreover, the DoubleMax mechanics have the potential to challenge other superb iGaming innovations like Megaways or Cluster Pays. Wilds, cascades, guaranteed wins, and even jump multipliers, it can hardly be better!But, I feel responsible for bringing quality alternatives to your attention, so I picked a couple of titles from the vast Pirates category. Cannonball Cash was released earlier in 2024 by the top-tier provider Red Tiger. It comes with stunning visuals, a 243-way system, a Ladder Bonus, Free Spins with sticky wilds, and much more.At the same time, Dead Man's Gold isn't a new slot, and it's part of the incredible series powered by ELK Studios. It comes with an innovative layout and payout system generating up to 262,144 ways to win. Avalanches add rows, while the numerous features and modifiers can instantly deliver the 25,000x max win.Each of these games can compete with the Barbarossa Revenge DoubleMax and win or lose, depending on the player's profile. They feature different mechanics and feature-triggering sequences, so if you like the buccaneer type of slot, you can find plenty of choices in  SlotCatalog's treasury!

attr_description: In the fairy tales, the frog changes into a princess after a kiss from her one true love. In Frog Story, the frog might just transform into gold if luck is on your side. This EGT video slot game blends traditional elements from famous children stories with a few surprises to keep players entertained and longing for a few more spins.The action is set in a forest, with lush vegetation and intricate tree roots merging in the middle of the path. You can catch a glimpse of a clear stream bordered by flowers, all bathed in soft sunlight. As you probably have gathered now, the settings are quite idyllic and peaceful. You will die to explore this enchanted forest a little further.As usual in EGT creations, there is no background music playing but instead several sound effects triggered by the spinning of the reels and after each win.In terms of gameplay, Frog Story is a no brainer. You have five reels and 20 fixed paylines to bet on, with no possibility to deactivate some paylines. That leaves you with only one parameter to modify: the actual size of your wager. Use the shortcuts at the bottom of the game screen to choose between a 20, 40, 100, 200 or 400-coin wager. The reels will start spinning automatically once your choice is made.After each win, general consisting of a combination of identical of a payline, you will have the possibility to gamble your new coins by clicking the corresponding button when it appears. The mini game that ensues is a simple guessing challenge, where you have to guess the colour of a hidden card. Every correct answer will double your gold stash, but the game will be over with one single mistake – and your gold will be gone forever as well.Another option is to use the orange Autoplay button on the left hand side of the screen in order to let the reels spin loose on a constant bet for as long as you like. Sit back and watch the wins pile up! And keep in mind that each win gives you a chance to trigger the Jackpot Cards Bonus game as well, the only gateway to Frog Story’s progressive jackpots. There are four of them, displayed in the running counters at the top of the screen. One the game has started, start picking facedown cards until you find three of the same suit. You will collect the corresponding gigantic jackpot instantaneously.One more original point of gameplay is Toppling Reels feature. After each win, the symbols concerned vanish and new ones come trickling down from above. Should a new winning combination appear then, its value will be multiplied by two. Each time the Toppling Reels feature creates a new combo, the multiplier will be increased by one.Let’s have a look at the paytable of Frog Story now. It begins with a few classic symbols: the Jack, Queen, King and Ace in colourful calligraphy. They do not pay much, but they can pave the way to bigger wins thanks to the Toppling Reels feature anyhow.They are followed by a mysterious Treasure Chest, a set of magic Potions, the Princess and Prince and finally the old and wise wizard. Each symbol is full of details and starts moving when forming a winning combination, making the game very lively and entertaining.You will find two more symbols on the paytable. The first one of them is the Castle, which acts as a Scatter symbol. Regardless of its position on the reels, it will award tremendous prizes: 500 times your original bet for a five-scatter combination.Lastly, the famous Frog is there to be our Wild card for the game. As such, it is able to substitute any other symbol besides the Scatter card. It appears on the 2nd, 3rd and 4th reels and when it does so it automatically expands to the whole reels, triggering even more extra combinations!

Joker’s Jewels Slot Review

In this Joker’s Jewels review, you’ll discover a simple but entertaining Pragmatic Play slot that adopts a retro theme. Released in March 2018, this 5×3 game offers just five paylines on which to match gemstones, as well as jester-related paraphernalia.

A solid return to player rate of 96.50% awaits, as does a maximum potential payout of 1,040x. But is this game fit to entertain us, as a joker would have done for his king? Keep reading to find out.

Software Provider Pragmatic Play

Release Date March 2018

RTP 96.50%

Volatility Medium-High

Max Win 1,040x

Reels x Rows 5 x 3

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.05 – $25

Number of Paylines 5

Themes Joker

Basic Details of the Joker’s Jewels Slot

Joker’s Jewels Details, RTP and Volatility

Before we launch into our detailed Joker’s Jewels review, let’s first assess the vital statistics. The game makes use of a classic 5×3 grid with just five fixed paylines. It’s definitely a slot for the casual gamer, with a maximum bet of just $25. What’s more, you can spin for as little as $0.05 per play.

You’ll find a quite respectable RTP of 96.50% at pretty much all real money casinos that offer this slot. One or two feature lower values of 95.00% and 94.00%, but most of the time, you’ll get the advertised rate.

This solid RTP pairs nicely with a well-balanced volatility level, which is rated 3.5/5 by Pragmatic Play, the slot’s developer.

A $10 prize is seen below the 5×3 grid, formed by four pairs of jester shoes on reels 1 to 4. The paytable is above the grid.

Theme & Graphics in Joker’s Jewels

There are plenty of joker-themed slots out there, the inspiration for which presumably comes from a deck of cards. After all, many online slots also use the familiar rankings of ace, king, queen and jack as symbols. However, that’s not the case here.

Instead, as the slot’s name might suggest, gemstones are preferred as the lower-paying symbols, while higher-paying icons are connected to the joker. To further underline the theme, a jovial and entertaining soundtrack plays as you spin the reels.

Despite the game’s age, not to mention its old-fashioned aesthetic, it doesn’t look bad at all. It is quite obviously a Pragmatic Play slot, with the developer’s trademark style clearly visible throughout. For instance, the usual control panel is retained, meaning loyal fans will pick the game up extremely quickly.

Joker’s Jewels Slot Features

In the next part of our Joker’s Jewels review, we’ll discuss the features and mechanics of this slot. However, that shouldn’t take long, as it’s a fairly simple game.

Regular Symbols

Seven regular symbols can be found in Joker’s Jewels. As you might guess from the title, these are either linked to jewelry, or to the court jester. The highest-paying symbol is the titular joker, who returns 1,000x your line bet for five on a payline. You’ll also secure prizes of 200x and 20x when you match four or three jokers.

Three other joker-related symbols can be seen on the reels, which are his lute, juggling pins and a pair of brightly-colored shoes. Expect returns of 40x, 10x and 4x your line bet from the footwear, while the other two both pay 200x, 40x and 10x.

A ruby red gemstone offers the same payouts as the shoes, with two other jewels also returning 40x for five on a payline. However, these pay slightly smaller rewards of 8x and 4x for landing four and three. Finally, the spherical dark-blue gem also offers a return of 1x your line bet for just two matches.

Bonus Symbol

A regal-looking crown bearing the word “Bonus” is the game’s only other symbol. This is a scatter, so it doesn’t have to land on a fixed payline for you to win. Collect three for a return of 10x the total bet, with larger prizes of 50x and 250x if you can hit four or five.

However, don’t expect a bonus game to trigger when you collect these scatters. Joker’s Jewels doesn’t offer any sort of feature, and this symbol is just a slightly different way to collect prizes the old-fashioned way.

Wilds

Pragmatic Play really chose to build the simplest of online slots with Joker’s Jewels. Not only does this game lack a bonus round, it doesn’t even offer a wild symbol to help you form wins.

The Autoplay menu is visible. Turbo Spin is enabled, as is the Skip Screens option. 1,000 auto spins are currently selected.

How to Play Joker’s Jewels Online

The Joker’s Jewels slot is incredibly easy to play. After configuring your preferred bet size using the plus and minus icons in the bottom-right corner, there are two ways to spin the reels. You can either tap the circular arrows, or instead, set as many as 1,000 automatic spins using the Autoplay feature below.

Land a minimum of three matching symbols on any of the game’s five paylines to secure a prize. The one exception here is the dark blue orb, as you only require two. Combinations must start from the leftmost reel, except for the bonus symbol, which pays anywhere.

Prizes noted in the paytable are paid based on your line bet, rather than the total stake. However, wins involving the bonus symbol are paid according to your total bet.

Try the Joker’s Jewels Demo for Free before playing for real money

Playing free slots is always a smart thing to do. Instead of diving right in and risking your hard-earned cash, test things out first with our Joker’s Jewels demo. That way, you’ll fully understand how the game works before you play properly.

Joker’s Jewels Review – Our Final Verdict

There’s not a great deal to say about Joker’s Jewels. Even accounting for its 2018 release date, this is an extraordinarily basic creation that doesn’t even feature a wild symbol, let alone bonus games. We guess the goal was to produce a classic-looking slot that appeals to nostalgic players longing for “the good old days”.

Pragmatic Play has definitely achieved that particular aim, anyway. This simple slot is easy to pick up, with no complex mechanics and very low betting limits. The sounds are extremely retro, too. But, aside from a solid RTP of 96.50%, the old-school vibe is literally all Joker’s Jewels has going for it.

A maximum potential payout of 1,040x is all you can expect, which is small for a medium-high volatility game. Worse still, there are no bonus features at all, not even a free spins round. Plus, if you’re anything like us, you’ll find the music gets quite irritating pretty quickly. We are not amused!

attr_review_text:
Introduction to Cheetah Wild

Cheetah Wild is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play that takes us out on a safari. Savannah- and Safari-themed releases have been among the longest-running themes in the industry, and it’s no surprise that a studio such as Pragmatic Play, known for nonstop releases and for being around for years, is no stranger to the vast animal kingdom, as seen with releases like Animal Magic 1000, The Ultimate 5, African Elephant, and many more. In comparison, Cheetah Wild isn’t all too different, as it has a relatively standard setting, except for the fact that we have a cheetah pacing around above the playing grid as we spin. When it comes to gameplay, it isn’t all too difficult, as the game is centered around Money Symbols, which form paylines with Collect Symbols to cash out. Paired with this is a Free Spins feature with a progressive level mechanic, which will convert high-paying symbols into even more Money Symbols. The game feels familiar but fresh in its own sense, as there’s nothing really original about these ideas, but they work well together and may keep you engaged on your hunt for the max win of 5,000X the bet.

Pragmatic Play takes us back to the savannah to join the pack and hunt Money Symbols.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Cheetah Wild is a video slot from Pragmatic Play with 5 Reels, 4 Rows, and 1,024 Ways to win. You can choose between making a Min.bet of 0.2 and a Max.bet of 240. Cheetah Wild comes with a higher-than-average RTP of 96.5%, a hit frequency of 31.44%, low volatility, and an okay max win of 5,000X the bet. However, do take note that the max win hit probability is 1 in 3,703,704 spins, the Free Spins hit frequency is 1 in 89.36 spins, and the game comes in multiple versions with lower RTPs of 95.51% and 94.51%.

As mentioned earlier, Cheetah Wild is set on the savannah, with a rather standard backdrop of a few trees and gazelles sprinting by. On top of the wooden playing grid is our titular Cheetah, who is actually made in 3D, and will pace back and forth. You can play the game on most notepads, mobiles, and desktops.

The lower-paying symbols are 9, 10, J, Q, K, and A. Creating a win with 5 of the same symbols will pay out 1.5X to 2.25X the bet. The higher-paying symbols are various savannah animals, including gazelles, zebras, rhinos, and elephants. Landing a win with 5 of the same symbols pays out 2.5X to 4X the bet. We also have a few Special Symbols, including Wilds, Money, Collect, and Scatter, which we cover in the Feature section.

Special Features & Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Cheetah Wild?

You can win up to 5,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot Cheetah Wild?

The features are Wild Symbols, Money and Collect Symbols, Free Spins, Ante Bet, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Wild Symbols

Wild Symbols help form winning combinations by being able to substitute for all symbols except Scatter, Collect, and Level Up Symbols, but can only appear on reels 2, 3, and 4. Wilds can also appear with a random Multiplier of either 2X or 3X.

Money and Collect Symbols

Money Symbols can appear on reels 2-5 and will have a random value between 0.25X and 100X the bet. However, Money Symbols can only be paid out if landed in a payline with a Collect Symbol on reel 1. Wild Symbols can help create a payline when they land adjacent to other Money or Collect Symbols, and any Multiplier they carry will be applied to the collected amounts.

By landing 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Free Spins feature with 8, 15, or 20 spins, respectively. The bonus game plays with the Progressive Level Up feature, which can only be increased by landing Level Up Symbols. For each level, a new set of high-paying symbols will be replaced by Money Symbols. You start at level 1, and the levels go as follows:

Level 2 = Reached by landing 4 Level Up Symbols, replaced all Elephant paying symbols with Money Symbols.

Level 3 = Reached by landing 7 Level Up Symbols, replaced all Rhino paying symbols with Money Symbols.

Level 4 = Reached by landing 13 Level Up Symbols, replaced all Zebra paying symbols with Money Symbols.

Level 5 = Reached by landing 15 Level Up Symbols, replaced all Gazelle paying symbols with Money Symbols.

You can retrigger the bonus game by landing 2, 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols, awarding you with 5, 8, 15, or 20 additional spins.

Feature Buy

Ante Bet

By turning on Ante Bet, you increase your chances of landing Money Symbols with higher Cash values, and any Free Spins rounds will have more Wilds with a higher chance of Wilds with 3X Multipliers. However, this comes at the price of increasing your current bet by 2.5X the bet.

Through the Feature Buy, you can instantly enter a bonus game for a price based on the current bet.

100X = Awards the standard Free Spins with 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols.

500X = Awards the Super Free Spins with 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols. On top of this, the Super Free Spins start with 9-15 Level Up Symbols already collected, thus starting from a random level, with a minimum of level 3.

Final Thoughts on Cheetah Wild

Cheetah Wild isn’t a very impressive game, but that doesn’t mean that we think it’s bad, and, in fact, we would call it a pretty solid slot experience. However, this does come with the caveat that it isn’t a very original game, as its theme, setting, features, and gameplay loop have all been done before for almost the last two decades, meaning that it doesn’t really stand out in the crowd outside of the fact that it’s a modern release. But even so, if you’re a fan of these older themes and settings, Cheetah Wild does have a pretty good visual presentation, which may be sorely lacking in its older peers.

Gameplay-wise, while the complexity or the originality may not be anything to write home about, Pragmatic Play does deliver on a familiar Money and Collect formula. One thing that may stand out is the way that Money Symbols payout, as they need to form paylines, which Wilds can even help with, which is a fun little extra layer, but we can also see how it is a double-edged sword that could lead to a few frustrating spins where you’re just one symbol away from reaching a big cash out. On top of this, the game also comes with low volatility, meaning the spins aren’t all too explosive, but they do have their moments when landing alongside the Multiplier Wilds, which are the stars of the show. This all culminates in a Progressive Free Spins feature, which can feel a bit like a coin toss, as it can easily end before you’ve even leveled up once. All in all, Cheetah Wild is an okay slot experience, as it doesn’t do much to really stand out, and can at times feel a bit forgettable, but has nothing bad inherently, outside of maybe its low volatility, which can be a bit subjective.

Cheetah Wild is a slot that brings back an old classic theme and setting, paired with a rather okay Cash Collect payline mechanic and a Free Spins feature with Progressive Levels.

This will repeat as long as you keep winning, and the bonus round throws an unlimited, non-resetting progressive win multiplier into the mix. This can certainly lead to some tense moments towards the end of the feature, but the excitement is held back to a certain degree by the 4,000x win cap.There is no wild symbol in this game, and the star of the show is definitely the PowerNudge feature. You will see all reels involved in a winning combo nudge down 1 position after the win has been paid. This means that new symbols will appear at the top, and the nudge might lead to indefinite consecutive payouts.As you might understand from the above, landing winning combos at the very top row is what you’re rooting for in this game. This will award repeat and/or improved wins all the way down to the bottom, and the PowerNudge feature does not end until no more winning combos are present on the screen.Tiny scarab overlay icons can appear on any given symbol, and these are collected during nudge sequences. If you’ve collected at least 3 in the meter on the right-hand side during the same nudging sequence, the Bonus Round is triggered.You win 8 free spins from the minimum of 3 scarab scatters collected, and you also get +2 extra spins on top of that for every extra scatter you collect above 3.
