Pragmatic Play has plenty of ancient Egypt installments under their belt from before, as do many other developers, but Eye of Cleopatra stands out a bit from the crowd in several ways. First of all, the polished visual presentation is pleasant, albeit not exceptional, but the Random Wild Pattern device you see to the right is a somewhat interesting innovation.It springs to life at random times in the base game, which usually leads to a win, and it’s always active in the bonus round. You need wilds present for more wilds to be generated however, and this can make or break your feature. What’s lacking is some kind of multiplier to allow for larger single spin payouts, as you’ll need plenty of 200x single spin max wins to close in on the 4,000x potential. Overall though, this is an above average trip to the land of the pharaohs.The Ante Bet feature does not affect the game’s RTP, but it does double your bonus round chances. The price you pay is 25 % more per spin, and the 5 premium symbols pay 1.25 to 10 x your stake for 5 of a kind wins. The wild symbol pays the same, and it also steps in for all regular pay symbols to help complete winning combinations.On the right-hand side is a device that almost looks like a revolver cylinder at first glance. It consists of a golden circular Eye icon in the middle, surrounded by 8 empty circular positions. The empty positions may light up blue at random times, and if wilds are present when this happens the adjacent symbols turn wild as well. The adjacent symbols that turn wild correspond to the pattern of lights that turn blue in the device, and if all lights are blue it means all adjacent symbols turn wild.The Bonus Round (hit rate of 1 in 224) triggers when you land 3, 4 or 5 scatters anywhere in view, and this takes you to the free spins choice screen. You get to choose between 4 options of number of spins and possible wild transforming light patterns, and here’s an overview:The chosen number of lights will be active on every free spin, but the pattern varies per spin unless you choose the 8 lights option. You can retrigger the bonus round by landing 3 scatters on the same free spin, and you get the same number of free spins as you got initially.You get to see the base game grind for a while, including a single wild pattern device trigger, before we land 3 scatters around 1:23 into the 3-minute highlights video. We went with the mystery option, which actually gave us a decent start, and you can see it all for yourself by hitting the play button below.Another trip to ancient Egypt wasn’t something that immediately triggered waves of joy inside us, but the pleasant visual presentation grew on us pretty quickly. The spin pace is excellent with the turbo switched on, which always helps, and you can hold down the space button to plow through plenty of base game spins in no-time. The Random Wild Patterns modifier awards decent top-up wins on a regular basis, but no more than 200x your stake at best.The soundtrack is a cliché Ancient Egypt style tune, and it will accompany you while you wait to trigger the all-important bonus round. The volatility increases the less free spins you go with, and the 8 spins option seems like a fairly balanced choice unless you want to take your chances with the mystery option. A jackpot up to 1,000x can be landed in the streak respins style Fire Ball feature, and the overall max win sits around 2,000x your stake.Pyramyth - in typical Thunderkick fashion, you get an original twist to both the theme and the features, and this futuristic ancient Egypt slot comes with wild multipliers up to x32. These become roaming in the bonus round, and you get a sticky winning symbol respin per bonus round win. The max win is a solid 10,000x your stake.

Introduction to 10000X Gold 2

10000X Gold 2 is a casino slot from 4ThePlayer, building on the mechanics of a classic casino-themed release from 2025. In 10000X Gold, an energetic, gold-abundant gameplay took us on a ride packed with stacked X symbols, awarding lucrative multipliers and increasing jackpots up to 5,000x the bet. The sequel comes with even more power, bringing new double-X symbols capable of shooting up the multiplier to new heights, and the jackpots have grown as well, now tapping out at 20,000x the bet. Like in the original, Wilds will also lend a helping hand during free spins by expanding to cover entire reels and awarding additional multipliers up to x12.

Feel the energising jolt of 10000X Gold 2 in the demo mode available at the top of this page, where you can try out all the features risk-free.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

10000X Gold 2 is a video slot from 4ThePlayer with 5 reels, 4 rows, and 1,024 ways to win, providing many opportunities to form winning combinations. You can choose your stake from a range of options, starting from a Min.bet of 0.2 up to a Max.bet of 20. The game offers a default RTP of 94.00%, which is significantly lower than the industry average, which typically ranges from 96.00% to 96.50%. Additionally, a lower variant of 90.5% is also available, so be sure to check your version before playing. The mathematical profile focuses on less frequent but more sizable wins due to high volatility, while the max win is capped at 20,000x the bet. The base game hit frequency sits at the rate of 26.14%.

10000X Gold 2 is a lively mix of classic casino imagery wrapped in modern design, making the game feel like it truly belongs in the 21st century. The entire setting buzzes with energy carried by occasional lightning running through random elements on the screen, with a lively disco soundtrack that elevates that feeling even higher. Purple and gold dominate the game's colour palette, filling up the angled, pulsating lines in the background and charging the grid's frame as well as many of the symbols with a luxurious glare. The design is also fully responsive, adapting seamlessly to any modern device, so you can play it on any desktop, smartphone, or tablet.

The paytable holds 2 sets of distinct symbols responsible for delivering payouts whenever 3 matching ones (or 2, in the case of the top-paying X icons) land on adjacent reels, beginning from the leftmost one. Among the low-value symbols, you'll recognise classic royals like 10, J, Q, K, and A, awarding from 0.15x the bet for matching 6 on a winning way. Prizes for matching 6 identical premium symbols appearing as a bell, gold bars, a dollar sign, a pair of dice, a stack of chips, and a gold X range from 0.2x to 0.25x the bet. Together with the regular symbols, reels will also drop Wilds in the form of a shining star, substituting for other paying icons, and Scatters showing as a large red gemstone with the words 'free spins' written across.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot 10000X Gold 2?

You can win up to 10,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot 10000X Gold 2?

The features are Boosting Fortunes, Stack Xpand, Free Spins, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Boosting Fortunes

The game features 5 Fortune Prizes, whose values you can see displayed next to the grid. Coin badges may be attached to regular symbols, and they'll be collected by the Fortune Prize box of a matching colour whenever the symbol lands on the grid. Each collected Coin increases its Fortune Prize by between 0.05x and 0.5x the active bet. The starting and max values are as follows:

Mini = starts at 8x, max 80x the bet.

Midi = starts at 12x, max 120x the bet.

Super = starts at 100x, max 1,000x the bet.

Mini = starts at 300x, max 3,000x the bet.

Mini = starts at 1,000x, max 10,000x the bet.

Every collected Coin also gives a chance for activating the Fortune Bonus, during which you'll be asked to reveal tokens until you match 3 identical ones, rewarding you with the corresponding prize. Once won, the Fortune Prize resets to its starting value.

Stack Xpand

Whenever you land four X symbols stacked on the same reel, they will transform into a single vertical X symbol with a multiplier of x5, x6, x7, x8, or x10. If two or more full stacks are on adjacent reels, their multipliers multiply each other.

Scatters are your key to triggering the bonus round, with 3, 4, or 5 landing anywhere on the grid awarding 8, 15, or 25 free spins, respectively. Throughout the round, scoring 2 Scatters at the same time adds 4 extra spins to the total count. New Double-X symbols become active during free spins, making it possible to achieve higher multipliers whenever you trigger the Stack Xpand feature. Since each DoubleX symbol is counted as two regular X symbols, the multipliers for a full stack on a reel are x10, x12, x14, x16, or x20. Additionally, Wild symbols can now expand along the entire reel, forming a stack that also awards a multiplier of x6, x7, x8, x10, or x12. Wilds also significantly boost Fortune Prizes above the reel they land on.

Feature Buy

If you like to speed up the action and proceed straight to the bonus round or activate powerful base game features instantly, you can do so by paying a fixed price that scales with your active bet.

50x = trigger Free Spins with a random number of Scatters.

100x = trigger Stack Xpand with a random number of stacks that guarantee a win.

Final Thoughts on 10000X Gold 2

10000X Gold 2 feels like a sequel that's a natural course of action for the studio if the original achieved a reasonably positive performance, which 10000X Gold most likely did. Introduction to Viking Runecraft 1000

Viking Runecraft 1000 is a casino slot from Play'n GO and a return of an intense mythological classic from 2017. This new version, however, has little in common with the original Viking Runecraft, which featured an engaging progression system and an impressive array of explosive modifiers. With almost a decade between the two releases, you can expect the new instalment to offer much more polished and detailed graphics, although wrapped around a simplified gameplay that relies on Multiplier symbols. The studio is clearly trying to capitalise on the trending scatter-pays format, popularised by games like Gates of Olympus by Pragmatic Play, while strengthening the initial impression with its established brand. Be mindful of that going in, as there's little to no charm left of the old-school Viking Runecraft, but the sharp visuals and the new straightforward setup can make the experience much more streamlined in the scope of the current iGaming landscape.

If you prefer to test the game's mechanics before jumping in with real money, you can do so in the risk-free demo available at the top of the page.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

Viking Runecraft 1000 is a video slot from Play'n GO with 6 reels, 5 rows, and a scatter-pays system, requiring 8+ matching symbols to land anywhere in view. You can choose your stake from a range of options, starting from a Min. bet of 0.1 up to a Max. bet of 50. The game's math operates on a default RTP of 96.20%, indicating stable, long-term returns. However, several lower variants have also been released, including 94.2%, 91.2%, 87.2%, and 84.2%. Therefore, be sure to verify your version before playing. You can expect more return value to be pushed toward occasional big hits rather than smaller wins due to high volatility, while the max win can reach 60,000x the bet.

The main scene of Viking Runecraft 1000 presents a natural scene filled with raw rock formations held in a tight embrace of omnipresent frost, capturing the harsh Northern environment. Cold colours dominate the palette in the background, emphasising the wintry atmosphere. The god Thor, wielding his mighty hammer, stands next to the grid, ready to summon the power of thunder and charge the reels with lucrative multipliers. Sharp, detailed graphics and cycling effects keep the scene alive, while the responsive setup makes the game available on most modern devices, from desktops to smartphones and tablets.

Creating winning combinations requires landing at least 8 matching symbols anywhere on the grid. Among the low-paying symbols, you'll recognise an axe, a pendant, a Viking helmet, and a hammer, awarding from 0.9x to 1.2x the bet for a set of 12 or more instances. The mid-paying group includes three emblems with Nordic runes, which bring payouts ranging between 1.8x and 2.5x the bet when gathering at least 12 units in view. Premium symbols depict three Norse gods, which pay from 3.5x to 9x the bet for 12 or more in view. Reels will also hold Multiplier symbols represented by a round bronze, silver, or gold badge, and Scatters in the form of a golden gate.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Viking Runecraft 1000?

You can win up to 60,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Viking Runecraft 1000?

The features are Cascading, Multipliers, Free Spins, and Go Ultra.

Free Spins

Cascading

Within the cascading mechanism, you'll have a chance to score multiple consecutive wins within a single game round. Every initial combination is removed from the grid, causing the remaining symbols to drop and new ones to populate the board. This can potentially lead to more hits, thus extending the sequence until no new combinations can be formed.

Multipliers

Multipliers can land in any position on the grid, with a value from the following range: x2, x3, x4, x5, x7, x8, x10, x12, x15, x20, x25, x50, x100, x500, and x1,000. All Multipliers are summed up once the cascading is finished, and their total value multiplies the final win from the spin.

Multipliers can randomly upgrade during cascades, increasing their current value by one level. There's also a chance of triggering a Volatile Upgrade after a Multiplier has been upgraded at least once, which can bring the Multiplier to a random higher level.

Gathering 3 or more Scatters anywhere on the grid at the end of a base game spin triggers 12 Free Spins. Another set of 3 or more Scatters during the bonus awards 3 additional spins, up to a maximum of 36 total. Throughout the round, all activated Multipliers are added to the progressive total multiplier meter. Any wins that use at least one Multiplier from the grid are multiplied by its value and by the total multiplier.

Go Ultra

Activating the Go Ultra ante bet increases your base stake by 50%. In exchange, all Multipliers that land are guaranteed to upgrade by 1 or more levels.

Final Thoughts on Viking Runecraft 1000

After Rise of Olympus 1000, Play'n GO takes another swing at trying to break through the swarm of scatter-paying slots with one of its recognisable brands. And while Viking Runecraft may not have been as elaborate a series as, say, the Moon Princess saga, the name has been floating around in a few instalments, such as Viking Runecraft 100 and Viking Runecraft Apocalypse. Still, the original is arguably the most significant one, which may still sit in the memory of many seasoned players. But, as we mentioned at the beginning of the article, this new follow-up shares nearly no DNA with the 2017 classic, except for the common Norse theme and the title. Like with most Play'n GO slots, the artwork is top-notch, offering lots of detail and polish around the symbols, as well as a solid range of animations and effects to embellish the more important events on the reels. At the same time, it's still a relatively generic Norse setting, abounding in predictable imagery, involving runes, gods, weapons, and a harsh, barren Northern landscape.

Mechanically, there's hardly any novelty here, and the entire configuration seems like a clone of Rise of Olympus 1000. The upgrading of Multipliers may feel like a step up from the usual format offered by this type of game, but ultimately, it often means that you will just see them drop with lower initial values, just so that they can grow during a spin. There's undeniable potential in the feature, which the max win figure of 60,000x seems to align with, although it would take a lot of massive values consistently added to the progressive meter to achieve it. Still, it looks good on paper and is bound to tease some players looking for higher-than-usual potential prizes. Overall, the game doesn't offer anything new and simply exploits the familiar name to churn out another soulless clone.

Viking Runecraft 1000 is a slot which stands out only with its title, trying to utilise the fame of its predecessor, while not offering anything beyond an overused scatter-pays setup with multipliers.

Introduction to Lucky Fortune Tree

Lucky Fortune Tree is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play, originally released under the Fat Panda studio name, now known as Pragmatic Play POP. Welcome to this straightforward release featuring a classic 3x3 game grid and 5 paylines. The backdrop displays a lush green valley and a prosperity tree filled with gold coins. It may be too simple for some, but if you want an uncomplicated and user-friendly experience, let’s find out what the Lucky Fortune Tree demo has to offer!

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Lucky Fortune Tree is a video slot by Pragmatic Play POP that features 3 reels, 3 rows, and 5 paylines. Players can select bet sizes ranging from 0.1 to 240, with a default RTP of 96.50%. All buttons, including the Spin and Bet Size can be found below the reels. You can play Lucky Fortune Tree on all mobile devices, desktops, and tablets. You create a winning combination by landing 3 of the same symbol types on adjacent reels starting at the leftmost reel.

The lower-paying symbols are yellow, blue, and green gems. Landing 3 of the same symbol type pays between 0.5X and 1X. The higher-paying symbols are a purple scroll, green bells, and a red lantern. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 2X and 10X.

The game’s Cash Symbol is a golden coin with values ranging from 0.5X to 1,000X the bet, which can be collected by the red Collect Symbols landing only on reel 3. The Collect Symbol can land on the reels with multiplier values up to 8X. There is no traditional Scatter Symbol here; instead, the Bonus Game can be randomly triggered by landing a Collect Symbol on reel 3. Let’s find out what kind of features this game has to offer!

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

The max win is 8,000X the bet.

Respins Feature

This feature can be triggered when Cash and Collect Symbols land simultaneously on the reels. The Collect Symbol can only land on reel 3 and will collect any Cash Symbol in view. The Cash Symbol can appear with values of 0.5X, 1X, 1.5X, 2X, 3X, 5X, 8X, 10X, 15X, 25X, 50X, 250X, or 1,000X the bet. The Collect Symbol stays locked on the reels until the end of the feature when it lands, collecting the values of all Cash Symbols that land. The feature ends when no more respins are left, and you are awarded the collected values of all Collect Symbols in view.

Although this is a surprisingly simplistic release from Pragmatic Play POP, we still appreciate the generous Cash Symbols, which carry values of up to 1,000X the bet. We also need to mention the multiplier value of the Collect Symbol, which was the reason behind some significant wins during testing of the game.

In conclusion, this game has a nice vibe and easy-going attitude. We presume this game aims to tap into the growing iGaming market in Asia, and it may find success due to its user-friendly approach and lucrative features, such as the Collect Symbol Multiplier. Ra's Reckoning ditches the traditional payline structure for cluster pays, and honestly, it changes everything about how you approach the game. Monster Superlanche is a simple enough game, but the combination of features can be deadly in all stages.The charming critters drop down on a 6x5 grid inside a cave system, and winning symbols accumulate per tumble as the non-winners explode. Filling reels award multipliers up to x100, and these combine to boost the total win. The multiplier only keeps building in the bonus round, which can lead to payouts up to 5,000x your stake. The pace is excellent all the way, and the Ante Bet doubles your feature chances for a reasonable price.You can turn on the Ante Bet between base game spins, and it will cost you 25 % more per spin. The benefit is that your bonus round chances are doubled, from 1 in 292 spins to 1 in 146 spins. The top-tier RTP is slightly reduced, however, from 96.03 to 95.98 %.You win by landing 8 to 30 matching symbols anywhere in view, and they pay from 0.2-1.5x to 10-150x your stake. There are no wild symbols to help you out in this game. The Tumble mechanic is active on each win though, but not the way it usually works.Instead, all non-winning symbols are removed, and the winning symbols drop to the bottom of the grid. A new batch of symbols drop down to fill the gaps, and the process repeats if you improve the win with more of the same symbol type. Scatter symbols are also stored between tumbles, and you get the total symbols win when no more symbols land to improve it.Each reel displays a Random Multiplier per spin, and filling a reel with winning symbols at the end of the tumble awards the corresponding multiplier. The multiplier will boost the total win from that round, and if multiple multipliers are achieved they are added together before the boost. The possible multiplier values per reel are as follows: x2-x10, x15, x20, x25, x30, x40, x50, x75, or x100.You need at least 4 scatters in view in the same tumble sequence to trigger the Bonus Round, and you get 8, 12, or 20 free spins from 4, 5, or 6 scatters, respectively. Any multiplier boost you get during the bonus round is also added to the global win multiplier, and the global win multiplier accumulates without resetting. It’s always the global multiplier that’s applied to new wins, and you get 3, 8, 12, or 20 extra spins from 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters, respectively.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can take advantage of the Bonus Buy option. This option is not available if the Ante Bet is turned on, however, and it will set you back 100x the stake. We got the minimum of 4 triggering scatters, and this gave us 8 initial free spins. You can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.Monster Superlanche has everything needed to become a “monster hit”, at least in our view, and the gel-like monsters are as charming as anything we’ve seen before. Although not unheard of, it’s still refreshing to get an “opposite” version of the usual tumble win mechanic, and the satisfying game pace adds to the experience. It’s fun to see the winning symbols accumulate, and even more so if you manage to rack up a decent win multiplier.This is far more likely to happen in the bonus round, of course, since the multiplier never resets. The multiplier is also highly unpredictable, not least in comparison with the usual progressive win multiplier, which adds tension to each round. It can spike by up to +100 from a single reel after all, and Monster Superlanche can easily sail up as a strong competitor to Play’n Go’s Toonz range. We highly enjoyed our session at least, and the 5,000x potential is solid when you take the very decent 1 in 3,745,318 hit rate into consideration.

Play’n Go has a head start though, but fans of cute, wobbly, gel-like monsters will hardly be disappointed by what Pragmatic Play has conjured up in this release. Monster Superlanche is a simple enough game, but the combination of features can be deadly in all stages.The charming critters drop down on a 6x5 grid inside a cave system, and winning symbols accumulate per tumble as the non-winners explode. Filling reels award multipliers up to x100, and these combine to boost the total win. The multiplier only keeps building in the bonus round, which can lead to payouts up to 5,000x your stake. The pace is excellent all the way, and the Ante Bet doubles your feature chances for a reasonable price.You can turn on the Ante Bet between base game spins, and it will cost you 25 % more per spin. The benefit is that your bonus round chances are doubled, from 1 in 292 spins to 1 in 146 spins. The top-tier RTP is slightly reduced, however, from 96.03 to 95.98 %.You win by landing 8 to 30 matching symbols anywhere in view, and they pay from 0.2-1.5x to 10-150x your stake. There are no wild symbols to help you out in this game. The Tumble mechanic is active on each win though, but not the way it usually works.Instead, all non-winning symbols are removed, and the winning symbols drop to the bottom of the grid. A new batch of symbols drop down to fill the gaps, and the process repeats if you improve the win with more of the same symbol type. Scatter symbols are also stored between tumbles, and you get the total symbols win when no more symbols land to improve it.Each reel displays a Random Multiplier per spin, and filling a reel with winning symbols at the end of the tumble awards the corresponding multiplier. The multiplier will boost the total win from that round, and if multiple multipliers are achieved they are added together before the boost. The possible multiplier values per reel are as follows: x2-x10, x15, x20, x25, x30, x40, x50, x75, or x100.You need at least 4 scatters in view in the same tumble sequence to trigger the Bonus Round, and you get 8, 12, or 20 free spins from 4, 5, or 6 scatters, respectively. Any multiplier boost you get during the bonus round is also added to the global win multiplier, and the global win multiplier accumulates without resetting. It’s always the global multiplier that’s applied to new wins, and you get 3, 8, 12, or 20 extra spins from 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters, respectively.Finally, non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can take advantage of the Bonus Buy option. This option is not available if the Ante Bet is turned on, however, and it will set you back 100x the stake. We got the minimum of 4 triggering scatters, and this gave us 8 initial free spins. It can spike by up to +100 from a single reel after all, and Monster Superlanche can easily sail up as a strong competitor to Play’n Go’s Toonz range. attr_description: Play’n Go still has plenty of joker installments up their sleeve it seems, and it wasn’t too long ago that we tried our luck at the original Free Reelin' Joker. It was an unusually simple experience, but with some reel-adding action to spice things up. The latter has been toned down in Free Reelin' Joker 1000, which comes with a coin win system on the single payline 3-reels grid. Numbers land to determine the sum total coin win, and no-value blanks can interfere.We don’t mind a simple, classic-inspired fruit machine once in a while, but we do mind the lowered 200x max win. It can only be landed in the bonus spin feature nonetheless, while 104x your stake is the most you can hope for in the base game. The same goes for the Chance Spin feature that triggers quite frequently in the main game, and overall this was not really an improvement over the original release.The numbers 0, 1, 2, and 5 can land on the single payline grid, and the Joker triggers the Free Reelin’ Bonus whenever it appears (more about that below). You can also land blank symbols, and these have no value. The combination of 1 to 3 digit numbers pay the corresponding amount in coins, and the maximum of 520 coins equals 104x your stake.Landing 3 zeros on the single payline of the 3 reels triggers the Chance Spin feature. The reels will then spin backwards, and this may land you a prize. The max prize is still 520 coins, which still amounts to 104x your stake.You need only a single Joker in view to trigger the Free Reelin’ Bonus feature. Reel 1 will then come with the number 1 for the free spin, and one extra reel is also added to the grid for the free spin. You will land only blanks and/or zeroes for this bonus spin, and up to 1,000 coins can be won at best. This cracks the max win potential of 200x your stake, and the feature cannot be retriggered.It’s interesting to note that the original Free Reelin' Joker comes with a 1,000x potential, while Free Reelin' Joker 1000 offers only 200x your stake. The 1000 in the title is derived from the fact that you can win up to 1,000 coins, but we have to say that we prefer the first game if we had to choose between the two. It was a simpler game with less features, and thereby truer to its fruit machine roots. Not that Free Reelin' Joker 1000 is overly complicated either, but the 200x max win was hard to get over.The coin win system with different numbers awarding the corresponding win is unusual, but it can hardly lead to anything significant anyway. Up to 104x your stake is possible outside of the Free Reelin’ Bonus Round, which will impress exactly nobody, and the Chance Spin feature will many times leave you empty handed. Free Reelin' Joker 1000 might appeal to a narrow niche of classic slot connoisseurs, but it will pass by unnoticed by most players.

sc_description: Play’n Go still has plenty of joker installments up their sleeve it seems, and it wasn’t too long ago that we tried our luck at the original Free Reelin' Joker. It was an unusually simple experience, but with some reel-adding action to spice things up. The latter has been toned down in Free Reelin' Joker 1000, which comes with a coin win system on the single payline 3-reels grid. Numbers land to determine the sum total coin win, and no-value blanks can interfere.We don’t mind a simple, classic-inspired fruit machine once in a while, but we do mind the lowered 200x max win. It can only be landed in the bonus spin feature nonetheless, while 104x your stake is the most you can hope for in the base game. The same goes for the Chance Spin feature that triggers quite frequently in the main game, and overall this was not really an improvement over the original release.The numbers 0, 1, 2, and 5 can land on the single payline grid, and the Joker triggers the Free Reelin’ Bonus whenever it appears (more about that below). You can also land blank symbols, and these have no value. The combination of 1 to 3 digit numbers pay the corresponding amount in coins, and the maximum of 520 coins equals 104x your stake.Landing 3 zeros on the single payline of the 3 reels triggers the Chance Spin feature. The reels will then spin backwards, and this may land you a prize. The max prize is still 520 coins, which still amounts to 104x your stake.You need only a single Joker in view to trigger the Free Reelin’ Bonus feature. Reel 1 will then come with the number 1 for the free spin, and one extra reel is also added to the grid for the free spin. You will land only blanks and/or zeroes for this bonus spin, and up to 1,000 coins can be won at best. This cracks the max win potential of 200x your stake, and the feature cannot be retriggered.It’s interesting to note that the original Free Reelin' Joker comes with a 1,000x potential, while Free Reelin' Joker 1000 offers only 200x your stake. The 1000 in the title is derived from the fact that you can win up to 1,000 coins, but we have to say that we prefer the first game if we had to choose between the two. It was a simpler game with less features, and thereby truer to its fruit machine roots. Not that Free Reelin' Joker 1000 is overly complicated either, but the 200x max win was hard to get over.The coin win system with different numbers awarding the corresponding win is unusual, but it can hardly lead to anything significant anyway. Up to 104x your stake is possible outside of the Free Reelin’ Bonus Round, which will impress exactly nobody, and the Chance Spin feature will many times leave you empty handed. Free Reelin' Joker 1000 might appeal to a narrow niche of classic slot connoisseurs, but it will pass by unnoticed by most players.

Queenie Details, RTP and Volatility

This Wild Streak Gaming slot, which was produced in collaboration with Pragmatic Play, features a grid of five reels and three rows.

Bets range from $0.25 to $125 per spin, while the standard RTP is 96.51%. However, some new online casinos make use of 95.44% and 94.56% versions.

Theme & Graphics in Queenie

The Queen of Hearts is a central character in Lewis Carroll’s Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, known for her penchant for beheading. This story is the inspiration for several popular online slot themes, and Queenie is just one of many from the genre.

Since the game is named after her, it’s not surprising to see the queen starring as one of its symbols. Others include the Mad Hatter’s famous headwear, a White Rabbit, and his pocket watch. A simple but sonorous instrumental plays in the background, while harmonious voices filter through in between.

The dark blue reels are bordered by fancy gold decor. To the left, the queen stares at you with eyes so cold they seem to peer into your soul. Above the grid, we catch a glimpse of a wheel with multi-colored segments. Keep that in mind, as you’ll learn more about this later in our Queenie review.

Queenie Slot Features

Now, let’s dive into the features and mechanics which give life to the Queenie slot.

Regular Symbols

The lower-paying symbols are playing card icons from 9 to A. Land three, four or five of these on a payline to earn 0.08x, 0.4x and 1x.

Queenie herself is the game’s most valuable symbol. She pays 1x, 4x and 10x whenever up to five appear on a line.

Other symbols in the Queenie slot are the White Rabbit, his pocket watch, the Mad Hatter’s iconic green hat and a golden crown. Rewards of 2x, 3x and 4x await if you’re able to match five on a payline.

Wilds and Scatters

The wild symbol in this game is a big red heart. Like typical wilds in most real money slots, it replaces all regular symbols to form wins. However, there are no scatters in this game.

Wheel Feature

If wild symbols land, there’s a chance you’ll randomly trigger this feature at the end of the spin. Doing so brings the aforementioned lucky wheel into full view, causing it to spin for one of five rewards:

A payout of up to 200x;

Multipliers reaching up to 100x;

A number of random wilds added to the reels;

The Jackpot Bonus feature;

From 10 to 100 free spins.

Jackpot Bonus

If the wheel lands on the jackpot segment, the Jackpot Bonus game kicks in. This offers four fixed jackpots, worth 4,000x, 200x, 50x, and 20x, respectively.

Before a jackpot is awarded, you must select three matching jackpot cards out of 12. If one of them is a boost card, the fixed jackpot increases by a random amount of between 5x and 800x.

Free Spins

Landing on a free spins segment of the wheel instantly awards the specified number of bonus plays.

It’s possible to activate the Wheel Feature during the free spins bonus, meaning you can potentially activate the jackpot feature or retrigger free spins. In addition, landing a wild during free spins guarantees you a spin of the Wheel.

Buy Free Spins

For 100x your bet, you can instantly trigger the free spins feature. This causes the wheel to spin, awarding you a randomly-selected number of free spins.

Img Description: Three mini jackpot cards are revealed during Jackpot Bonus, along with two minor cards, one major card and one boost card.

How to Play Queenie Online

Queenie works just like most conventional slots. The plus and minus buttons in the bottom-right corner of the screen are used to adjust bet sizes.

To spin, simply tap the circular button found between them. Unusually, there is no option for automatic spins in this game.

You’ll earn a payout whenever you land at least three identical symbols on a payline, from left to right.

Try the Queenie Demo for Free before playing for real money

While the lure of real money rewards can be strong, we’d advise trying our free Queenie game first. This provides a risk-free way to learn all of the game’s features and gain experience before playing for real.

Queenie Review – Our Final Verdict

Slots inspired by Alice and the characters from the Wonderland books are not exactly new to the gambling space. And it’s fair to say that Wild Streak Gaming isn’t exactly reinventing the wheel here.

The graphics are pleasing enough, especially the captivating depiction of the Queen of Hearts. But the usual stereotypical symbols are included on a bog-standard 5×3 grid. While the familiar control panel of the developer’s partner, Pragmatic Play, is also present.

At first glance, it seems as though Queenie might be a feature-rich slot, due to the various bonuses in store. But it’s actually not the case, as these elements all hinge on the same randomly-triggered feature.

The lack of a scatter symbol means you’re simply waiting for wilds to appear. When they do, you’re not even guaranteed access to the Wheel Feature that’s responsible for doling out rewards. If you’re lucky enough to trigger it, there’s a good chance you’ll receive neither a jackpot nor a free spins bonus.

Throw in the relatively low maximum payout of 4,200x and quite average 96.51% RTP, and you have a steady slot, but nothing more.

Introduction to Pelican Payday

Pelican Payday is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play where our friendly, feathery fisherman takes us out on the sea for a day. While being a Pragmatic Play release, this game is developed by Pragmatic Play POP, a sibling studio known for its mobile-first releases, which is exactly what Pelican Payday is. While it may be designed around mobile play and, in turn, is rather simple, Pelican Payday is a vibrant fishing-themed game with very few features. This may seem like a bit of a red flag to some players, but we can see the game’s potential for a more casual audience that cares more about sending a few spins for the fun of it, rather than for the expectation of explosive and potentially highly volatile wins. The gameplay loop is centered around its Money and Collect Symbols, which can lead to Cash Prizes up to 10X or Grand Jackpots up to 1,000X the bet. These prizes then become a bit easier to hunt down in the Free Spins feature, where all Prizes are collected into a Money Pot, helping you reach the max win of 5,000X the bet.

Pelican Payday is a simple game, both in its visuals and gameplay, that leans more into casual, mobile-first spins than anything else.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Pelican Payday is a video slot from Pragmatic Play with 3 Reels, 5 Rows, and 10 Paylines. You can choose between making a Min.bet of 0.1 and a Max.bet of 250. Pelican Payday comes with a higher-than-average RTP of 96.59%, a hit frequency of 18.58%, low volatility, and an okay max win of 5,000X the bet. However, do take note that the max win hit probability is 1 in 2,506,266 spins, the Free Spins hit frequency is 1 in 146.02 spins, and the game comes in multiple versions with lower RTPs of 95.61% and 94.59%.

The game starts out on a beach, with the waves rolling in underneath the playing grid. The titular pelican joins us above the playing grid, already having reeled in a handful of bills. Soundtrack-wise, the game has an arcadey yet beachy vibe that we kinda like, and it pairs well with its vibrant theme. You can play the game on most notepads, mobiles, and desktops.

The lower-paying symbols are J, Q, K, and A. Creating a win with 3 of the same symbols will pay out 0.3X to 1X the bet. The higher-paying symbols are a fishing lure, a tackle box, and a goldfish. Landing a win with 3 of the same symbols pays out 1.5X to 10X the bet. We also have a few Special Symbols, including Money, Collect, and Scatter Symbols, but more on these in the next section.

Special Features & Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Pelican Payday?

You can win up to 5,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot Pelican Payday?

The features are Money and Collect Symbols, and Free Spins.

Free Spins

Money and Collect Symbols

Money Symbols can appear on all reels with a random Cash Value of 0.5X to 10X the bet or a Mini (20X), Minor (50X), Major (100X), or Grand (1,000X) Jackpot. However, these can only pay out by landing a Collect Symbol at the same time, which can only appear on reel 3 in the base game.

By landing 3 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Free Spins feature with 8 spins. During the bonus game, all collected Money Symbols will go into a Money Pot, which will stay persistent between spins. Collect Symbols can now appear on all reels, and each time they do, they will collect the value in the Money Pot. You can retrigger the bonus game by landing 3 extra spins, awarding an additional 8 spins.

Final Thoughts on Pelican Payday

Pragmatic Play POP has had an interesting story, starting out under the name Fat Panda, which created exclusive mobile-first games for Pragmatic Play. Its releases weren’t anything special, but definitely catered to a specific audience, and after its rebranding into Pragmatic Play POP, that hasn’t changed, but we have seen a slight shift in their releases, and we would say for the better. Pelican Payday may not be the best game out there, but it does feel like a step up from what we saw before the rebranding. When it comes to the actual game, it delivers a rather solid experience. While its theme isn’t exactly original, its visuals pair well with the vibrant style and vibes the game aims to convey, and these extend to the gameplay and its stats.

Gameplay-wise, Pelican Payday isn’t the most complex, immersive, or engaging game, as it is, for the most part, rather boring, but we can’t deny there’s an audience for these simple games. The regular paytable and Cash Prizes aren’t the best, meaning if you’re looking for bigger wins, it is all about the Jackpots. However, in the base game, we wouldn’t really say that the prizes feel very reliable, and with no Feature Buy in sight, it means you might be stuck in the base game waiting room with the occasional small wins to keep you going until you hit the Free Spins bonus game. With that said, we do enjoy the Free Spins Money Pot mechanic, and even though we’ve seen it in other releases, many of which have even done it better, we think it works rather well, and can actually be pretty exciting if you hit an early Jackpot Prize to start cashing out on sizeable prizes. But at the end of the day, the game may just be a bit too simple for much of the modern audience, meaning it falls into a niche category where it serves as an okay slot experience.

Pelican Payday is a mobile-first slot release with a very simple gameplay loop of Cash and Jackpot Prizes, targeted at a more casual audience.

Sadly, John Hunter and the Book of Tut falls into the latter category. It’s not a bad game by any means, but it does not bring the book series an inch forward in terms of innovation, twists or originality.On a positive note, if you like the original Book of Ra, John Hunter and the Book of Tut stays very true to its legendary source of inspiration. The big difference is that the visuals are more modern, and the RTP is a lot higher (at least at most casinos, but beware of the flexible RTP ranges). The volatility is as high as you can expect from a book slot, and you can place bets between 10p and £100 per spin across all platforms and devices.Spinning with your Android, iPhone or iPad is no problem in other words, and you can win up to 5,000x your stake on a single spin here (which is the standard max win for most book slots). This is hardly John Hunter's first rodeo, and he should be quite familiar with the tombs of ancient egypt by now. So are we, by the way, and we think this game would have benefited from a more original theme, and perhaps also a 2 scatter respins feature, to give you a break sometimes when it comes to triggering the all-important bonus round.As you might have guessed already, John Hunter himself is the highest paying symbol in this game, and there are also 3 other egyptian related symbols of higher value here. The regular royal symbols have been dressed up with some egyptian ornaments, but they still pay low compared to the premium symbols. Multiplier boosted wild wins can lead to solid payouts also in the base game, and the 5,000x potential comes with a hit rate of 1 in 14,084,507 spins. This is not too shabby all things considered, and a lot hangs on building up a solid Nugget Value in the bonus round. The chosen symbol seemed to land quite frequently, but this will surely vary per session and with regards to how much it pays.

You need the Respins Bonus to close in on the generous 16,297x potential in other words, and individual pearl prizes up to 1,000x is admittedly a somewhat tempting prospect. Not least since the pearls can combine and be boosted by x2. The max win is 6,953x your stake.Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox - is a charming and colorful underwater installment in Yggdrasil’s Gigablox range, and you’ll benefit from treasure chest cash prizes up to 500x your stake. You get a random number of feature picks before the bonus round starts, and you can win up to 10,000x your stake via the 6 unique modifiers.Waterblox Gigablox - is a visually exquisite Gigablox installment from Peter & Sons, and it comes with a 6x6 grid with 50 betlines. Symbols are turned wild at random times in the base game, and on every bonus round spin. As the developers appear to heed to the saying that all new is well overlooked old, more and more slots get remakes or just minor updates. The time has come for Play'n Go to revive their another slot, Golden Ticket. When it was firstly released in 2014, it immediately took an honorable place among the developer's hits and became one of the most beloved slots in Play'n Go's portfolio. The long-awaited sequel is actually promising since the devs managed to keep the DNA of the original by saving the general concept and also reinvent it in terms of features and design to make it even more appealing.Golden Ticket 2 is the third remake from Play'n Go this year, following Blinged and Jolly Roger 2. The first one was just a visual upgrade for the most part with a slight enhancement concerning the feature set, which remained almost the same, though, with Jolly Roger 2 Play'n Go flexed their muscles and made it actually impressive to be a worthy opponent to NetEnt's Rage of the Seas. It already hints at what to expect from Golden Ticket 2, however, let's explore it in greater detail to find out whether the provider took an easy approach as they did in Blinged, or is it a complex upgrade that'll deliver a new layer of entertainment to the good ol' title.When it comes to the technical aspects, Play'n Go kept the original concept and just changed the figures. The actions take place across a 5x5 sized grid with Cluster Pays mechanic. The RTP is set to 96.5%, which is above the average level within the industry of 96%, however, Golden Ticker 2 comes with ranging RTP values that may vary depending on where you play, so be sure to check the in-game specs before depositing since some of the operators might provide either 94.5% or 91.5% versions. The game is powered by a high volatile math model which is 10 out of 10 rated by the developer, so don't expect to be showered in wins. Keep that in mind and adjust your bets wiser to survive in the long run.Players drop in by setting bets from 0.2$ to 100$ per spin, providing a pretty wide betting range that would appeal to both high-rollers and less risky casual players. True to Play'n Go's style, the payouts in their games don't exceed 5,000x of the bet, and Golden Ticket 2 is no exception, so taking into consideration the betting cap at 100$ per spin, all high-rollers can hope for a win of 500,000$ on a single spin when playing with the max bet option available.The slot comes with a 1920's circus theme, and the reels are set in the midst of a big top. Golden Ticket 2 actually offers perfects aesthetics when it comes to the game's appearance and setting. Thanks to the developer's meticulous approach to the design, the game boasts top-notch graphics and smooth high-quality animations. It's the first thing that catches the eye when you load the game, and we have to pay tribute to the design team who developed Golden Ticket 2, as everything looks outstanding and depicted in detail. During the gameplay, the main characters will perform their bits to the right of the reels, and they'll not only amuse you with their bizarre acts but they also are connected to some bonus features. The soundtrack is another of highlights as it captures the essential carnival vibe and fits the gameplay perfectly. It adds a final touch to the atmosphere, complementing the immersive effect so that you feel like attending a circus show in real life.Similar to the original part of the game, the paytable offers a bunch of symbols split into 2 categories, the characters, and their props. In Golden Ticket 2 new artists dominate the show, and you're about to join a female Ringmaster, a Knife-Thrower and a Clown, which are the premiums. On the lower side, we get their props, including the Ringmaster's hat and whip, the Knife-Thrower's knives and target, and the Clown's juggling pins and unicycle. You'll require at least 3 adjacent horizontally or vertically symbols to score a win, and the highest rewards are given for matching 5 instances of the same symbol on a single line. Thus, the low-paying ones award from 2x to 5x of the bet, while the artists award 10 times the bet for 5-of-a-kind combos. You can also benefit from a combo with 3 mixed characters, which will award 5x of the bet. There's also a Wild symbol included, which is represented by a golden big top. It acts as a substitute to any other regular symbols and at the same time is the most valuable symbol worth 50 times the stake for matching 5 Wilds on a line.The game comes loaded with features so that you'll hardly have a dull moment during the session. The first one to mention is the Cascading Wins feature, though, it works in a slightly different way than in most of the slots featuring this particular mechanic. Every time you score a win, the winning symbols get removed from the grid, however, don't expect new ones to tumble down onto the reels. Introduction to Wrappin' More Gold

Wrappin' More Gold is a casino slot from Play'n GO, once again venturing into the depths of Egyptian tombs to discover magnificent treasures. This time, it's a much lighter adventure, beginning in the open spaces of a desert city and working its way down the gold-filled chambers. Just like in the preceding release, Wrappin’ Gold, the studio infused the theme with casual vibes originating from animated movie-style graphics and a humorous design. Here, you'll meet a friendly mummy that will help you collect shimmering gems to trigger a cash-collecting bonus round with up to three unique modifiers. Depending on the collected stone, you may benefit from a larger grid, extra multipliers, and double prizes. Watch the bandaged creature roam the reels, grow in size, and collect coins until it empties the ancient vaults and awards the max win of 6,000x the bet.

If you're not yet ready for exploring the Egyptian pyramids, you can familiarise yourself with the journey ahead in the risk-free demo mode available at the top of the page.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

Wrappin' More Gold is a video slot from Play'n GO with 5 reels, 3 rows, and 20 active paylines. The betting range consists of multiple options, ranging from a Min. bet of 0.2 up to a Max. bet of 40. The game's math operates on a default RTP of 96.20%, indicating stable, long-term returns. However, several lower variants have also been released, including 94.20%, 91.20%, 87.20%, and 84.20%. Therefore, be sure to verify your version before playing. You can expect a relatively even average balance between the frequency and the size of wins due to medium volatility, while the max win can reach 6,000x the bet.

The adventure begins in the middle of an ancient Egyptian city dotted with sandstone buildings, hieroglyphed pillars, and scarce tropical vegetation. Behind the settlement, massive pyramids tower over the landscape, accompanied by a cartoonish version of the Sphinx. The scene abounds mostly in brown hues originating from the omnipresent sand, slightly tinted with the purples cast by the rising (or setting) sun. In the front, a playing grid rests flanked by two thick columns adorned with gold ornaments, while three round sarcophagi stand on its top ridge, surrounded by multicoloured gems. A classic Egyptian soundtrack flows gently in the background, emphasising the exotic atmosphere. You can play the game on any modern device, as the responsive design seamlessly adapts to all desktops, smartphones, and tablets.

Creating winning combinations requires landing at least 3 matching symbols on any of the 20 paylines while using neighbouring reels, starting from the leftmost one. Among the low-paying symbols, you'll find playing card ranks from J to A, awarding between 1x and 3x the bet for a complete line of 5. The high-paying group includes images of an Ankh cross, the eye of Ra, a scarab, a pharaoh, and Cleopatra, which yield payouts of between 7.5x and 75x the bet for a 5-of-a-kind hit. Wilds appear as a gold pyramid, and they substitute for all regular symbols, while paying 125x the bet for a complete line. Reels also hold purple, red, and green Scatter Gems, Mummy symbols, and Bonus Spins symbols.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Wrappin' More Gold?

You can win up to 6,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Wrappin' More Gold?

The features are Collect & Win, Instant Bonus, Bonus Spins, and Go Ultra.

Bonus Spins

Collect & Win

To trigger the game's main bonus round, you need to land a Mummy symbol on reel 1 and at least one Scatter Gem anywhere in view. It can also trigger randomly when any of the three Scatter Gems lands. You receive 5 spins played on a 5x5 grid with a 2x2 Mummy collector present. Throughout the round, coins with cash prizes and Scatter Gems land on an otherwise empty board. Each time a Scatter Gem lands, the Mummy moves toward it to collect it. All coins caught in the Mummy's active area are automatically collected when it settles. The Mummy grows in size to 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 after accumulating 5, 9, and 12 Scatter Gems, also awarding extra spins each time.

Depending on the mix of Scatter Gems that were present during the bonus-triggering spin in the base game, up to three modifiers can be active.

Expanding Scatter Gem (purple) = the total grid size during Collect & Win increases to 8x5.

Increase Scatter Gem (green) = enables gems with extra spins and multipliers of x2 and x3 during the Collect & Win feature.

Double Scatter Gem (red) = enables double coins and gems during the Collect & Win feature.

Instant Bonus

Every Wild landing on the grid is collected into the chest labelled 'Instant Bonus'. Randomly, on such an occasion, the feature may trigger and award a pick game. The 5x3 grid will be filled with magic scrolls, which you must select one by one. Once you match three identical ones, a corresponding prize will be awarded. It can be one of four jackpots valued at 5x (Mini), 10x (Minor), 100x (Major), or 2,000x the bet (Grand).

Landing 3 or more Bonus Spins symbols anywhere on the grid within the same base game spin awards 6 Bonus Spins. The round can also occasionally randomly trigger when 1 or 2 Bonus symbols land. Throughout the feature, there's a greater chance of triggering the Collect & Win Bonus and Instant Bonus. Hitting 3 or more Bonus symbols at the same time grants 3 additional spins.

Go Ultra

Go Ultra ante bet increases your active stake by 50% when activated. In exchange, it increases the chances of triggering the Collect & Win feature during Bonus Spins and awards 3 extra gems at its start.

Final Thoughts on Wrappin' More Gold

When you review dozens of slots each month, you often catch yourself wondering why providers still go for the most overused themes instead of trying to stand out with originality. The online gambling industry is bursting at the seams with all the ancient Egyptian games, and yet we keep seeing them regularly. Play'n GO in particular has found itself charmed by the exotic nature of the setting since its unquestionable Book of Dead hit from 2016. A decade later, the studio still regularly sticks to the African vibes, and here we have another picture packed with sand, gold, and ancient treasures. attr_description: 10,000 Wonders 10k Ways is only the second installment featuring ReelPlay’s trademarked 10K Ways engine. However, we hardly believe cloning Hypernova 10K Ways is the best way to hype this already somewhat underwhelming attribute. Sure, with that many win ways, and a Cascading Wins mechanic to boot, anything is theoretically possible in the base game. At least to the tune of 5,622x your stake, which is the capped potential.Still, most savvy players understand that the real juice is usually squeezed in the bonus round, and the 10K Ways makes no difference in a hold-and-win style Respins feature. The Bonus Respins feature, as it’s called here, is a very run of the mill effort, with jackpots up to 2,000x your stake. The Infinity Reels engine has been a moderate success so far, and we don’t think 10K Ways will supersede it.The Temple Wild symbol will only slide in on the top horizontal reel, and it steps in for all regular pay symbols to help complete winning combinations. The wild holds no value of its own, while the 4 premium picture symbols pay between 2 and 100 x your stake for 6 of a kind wins. All winning symbols are removed and replaced by the Cascading Wins mechanic, and this feature goes on as long as you keep winning.You trigger the Bonus Respins feature when you land 6+ Lamp cash scatters anywhere in view. The triggering cash symbols become sticky on a cleared grid, and you start with 3 respins in your tally. Any new non-blank symbols that land become sticky as well, and this resets the respins counter to 3 again. The feature goes on until you run out of respins, or you fill the grid with sticky symbols.The cash lamp symbols are worth between 1 and 100 x your stake, and in addition you can also land 4 different Diamond jackpot symbols. The red, pink, green and blue diamond awards a jackpot prize of 10, 50, 250 and 2,000 x your stake, respectively, and you can land more than one instance of the 2 lowest-value diamonds.Nothing very exciting happened for us in the base game, so you can safely skip to the 1:38-mark, where we finally trigger the Bonus Respins feature after plenty of teasers. The streak respins style bonus round plays out for the remainder of the 4-minute highlights video, and you can check it all out by hitting the play button below.If the 10K Ways version of Hypernova Megaways came across as a bit superfluous, what to say about a straight-up reskin clone of that effort? The Aladdin theme is colorful, cartoonish and more down to earth, but ReelPlay could have scored some points if they upped the potential to match the 10K-infused title. Infective Wild is one of the new Halloween-themed slot machines in 2023, created by Pragmatic Play. You’ll get to enjoy the thrill of sticky wilds during your free spins, and did we mention that the wilds are infectious? If they spread to the right symbols, you are in for a true treat this Halloween. Find out more about this exciting 5×5 slot, featuring a 96.06% RTP, in our detailed Infective Wild reviews.

Basic Details of the Infective Wild Slot

Slot Details, RTP and Volatility

The Halloween-themed slot Infective Wild is a 5×5 slot featuring 40 paylines. The best symbol in the game is the scary pumpkin, as it’s wild and even sticky in the free spins game.

You win by getting at least three matching symbols on a payline, but don’t expect to get too many wins. The slot has high volatility, and that means you might win seldom, but when you do you can hit it big. As for the theoretical return to player percentage, that is set at 96.09%, which is fairly standard for online slots.

High rollers will enjoy the high maximum bet, as you can stake as much as $240 per game round. Casual players, on the other hand, might find the minimum bet of 40c a bit too pricy.

Theme & Graphics in Infective Wild

Infective Wild is all about Halloween, and that’s evident both on the backdrop of the game and in the graphics of the symbols. The game is set in a dark graveyard, and that in itself should be enough to deter players who are easily spooked.

In a dark and gloomy graveyard is where we find the Infective Wild slot machine that features a 5×5 game with scary Halloween-themed symbols spinning across the reels.

Across the five reels, you’ll see a less-than-friendly-looking cat, a raven, a gravestone, and multi-colored potions. And, keeping watch beside the reels is the pumpkin man. The pumpkin is also one of the symbols of the game, and this orange glowing grin is less than comforting, although it is in fact one of the best symbols you can get.

As for the audio, that’s actually surprisingly cheerful. It sounds more magical than scary. But, with the evil laugh of the pumpkin man chiming in once in a while, it quickly goes from cheery to gloomy.

All in all, Pragmatic Play has done an outstanding job capturing the theme of the slot with its graphics and audio, without making it too morbid or scary.

Infective Wild Slot Features

There are several ways you can hit it big in the Infective Wild slot machine. Let’s dive in and see what awaits.

Regular symbols

There are eleven regular symbols in the Infective Wild online slot, six are high value while five are low value. To win, you always need at least three matching symbols on a payline, alternatively supplemented by a wild.

The high-value symbols are the cat, raven, hat, cauldron, gravestone, and potion. The maximum payout you’ll get by lining up five cats on a payline, as this pays 60x your bet. The low-value symbols are the card symbols 10, J, Q, K, and A. The minimum you can win is by lining up three 10, J, or Q on a payline, as this pays 0.2x your bet.

Infective Wild That Spread

The pumpkin with the evil grin is the wild symbol, and it can substitute for all other symbols except the scatter. It also pays out by lining up on a payline, and you can win between 3x and 60x your bet, depending on how many you get.

When you get a pumpkin that touches, horizontally or vertically, a cat or a raven, these symbols get infected and will also act as wild symbols. They in turn will then further infect any other ravens or cats they are in direct contact with.

This right here is the best bonus feature in the base game, as it can lead to massive combinations of wilds.

Free Spins With Sticky Infective Wilds

Three scatter symbols trigger the free spins bonus game. When this happens, eight single reels will appear, all showing a number between 1 and 3. These numbers are then added up, and represent how many spins you get.

Trigger the free spins bonus game and get between 8 and 24 free spins, all with sticky wild pumpkins. Match them up with cats or ravens, and they will get infected and become wild.

During the free spins, all pumpkin wild symbols you get on reels 1 to 4 are sticky, so once you get them, you have them throughout the bonus game. These are also infective, and will per usual rules infect cats and ravens. However, these infected symbols will not remain as sticky.

Buy the Bonus Feature

If you love free spins but can’t be bothered to wait until they trigger organically in the game, you can pay to get them. Buying the bonus game costs 100x your bet, and the minimum amount you’ll have to pay is $40. As a maximum, you can buy the top value free spins for as much as $24,000. The theoretical RTP for the Bonus Buy free spins is 96.06%, so slightly less than the average for the whole game.

Playing the Infective Wild slot is easy, and you just set your bet and press spin. You can also activate quick spins or turbo spins. Just know that the turbo option is so fast that you hardly see anything at all, except when it slows down to show a win. Auto-spins are also available if you prefer to not start every spin manually.

The Infective Wild Review – Our Final Verdict

Playing the Infective Wild slot is for sure entertaining, and we truly enjoyed this game. The infective wilds are a thrill, especially in the base game. We always appreciate it when it’s possible to get a big win without having to enter the bonus game first. But, there’s no denying that the sticky wilds in the free spins game are alluring as well.

One thing that has to be mentioned is that the game is not very suitable for players with a low bankroll. With a high volatility and a minimum bet of $0.40, you might spin away your bankroll quicker than you’re used to. Then again, you might get lucky and get a big win. In general, though, after this in-depth Infective Wild review, we have to conclude that the game is best suited for high rollers or players with a healthy bankroll.

Viking Runecraft Slot Review

Our Viking Runecraft review takes a detailed look at a Play’n GO game that’s absolutely bursting with engaging features.

Based on Norse mythology, this 7×7 highly-volatile cluster pays slot stars four of Asgard’s biggest names. What’s more, the gameplay is quite unusual, with a level-based system that rewards you as you progress.

Want to know more? Then stick with our Viking Runecraft slot review.

Software Provider Play’n GO

Release Date April 2017

RTP 96.71%

Volatility High

Max Win 5,000x

Reels x Rows 7 x 7

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.10 – $100

Number of Paylines Cluster Pays

Themes Norse Mythology, Fantasy

Basic Details of the Viking Runecraft Slot

Viking Runecraft Details, RTP and Volatility

The RTP of 96.71% is quite generous, though lower-paying versions of 94.66%, 91.66%, 87.66% and 84.66% exist. A maximum potential win of 5,000x awaits in this high-volatility slot which uses a cluster-paying mechanism and a 7×7 grid. Spin the reels from just $0.10 up to $100 per play.

Released back in April 2017, this Play’n GO slot proved popular enough to earn a sequel. Viking Runecraft Apocalypse offers a slightly lower RTP of 96.20%, though the maximum potential win was boosted to 10,000x.

Freya stands to the right of the grid during level three. 18 runes were collected on the last spin, seen to the left

Theme & Graphics in Viking Runecraft

Mythology influences many of the most popular casino slot themes, especially when it involves Norse deities like Odin, Thor and Loki. Viking Runecraft may not be original in terms of the subject matter, but it’s actually an extremely creative game.

Aside from the tense, cinematic music and dramatic sound effects, the graphics are also neat and tidy. There are some pretty cool animations accompanying various features, while the gods are beautifully detailed. However, as you’re about to discover, the real creativity lies under the hood, in the way the game works.

Viking Runecraft Slot Features

Brace yourself, as the next part of our Viking Runecraft review details the game’s many bonuses, modifiers and features.

Regular Symbols

There are nine regular symbols in the Viking Runecraft slot, four of which are items belonging to Norse deities. Thor’s Hammer is the highest-paying, with rewards of 5x for a cluster of five, rising to 1,000x for 15 or more.

Next comes Odin’s Helmet, followed by an ax and an amulet. These pay up to 150x, 100x and 80x, respectively. Five runestones are the lower-paying symbols, worth between 10x and 50x for a cluster of 15 or more.

Cascading Reels

If a cluster of five or more is created, winning symbols are removed and recorded in a chart on the left-hand side. New symbols cascade in from above, potentially creating new combinations.

Also to the left of the grid is a circular meter containing 20 symbols. For each one collected, a notch on the meter lights up. With every new winning cascade, the meter continues to charge. Fill it completely to trigger the Charge of Destruction feature.

Charge of Destruction

Once the meter is full, one of four random modifiers is awarded.

Fury Of Fenrir: Randomly selects four diagonal lines, removing two and switching the rest to the same symbol type.

Judgment Of Jörmungandr: A random chain is selected, with some turned into the same type of symbol and the rest removed.

Scorching Of Surtr: Three symbols are randomly chosen and their neighbors are transformed to the same type.

Lure Of Loki: Two symbol types are chosen at random, with one group removed and the others becoming the same type.

Ragnarök Free Round

There are two ways to activate the Ragnarök free spin feature. Collect 20 more symbols after triggering a Charge of Destruction, or 40 symbols prior to a Charge of Destruction.

Once triggered, a multiplier comes into play. Every winning cluster during Ragnarök charges the multiplier by one, up to a maximum of 15x. When the free spin ends, you’ll receive a Charge of Destruction to keep the round alive. This process repeats until all four Charge of Destruction features are used.

Level Up

You’ll notice a bingo-style pattern, as well as a ranking, to the right of the grid. Starting at level one, you can improve your rank and benefit from different features. To do so, simply form winning clusters on top of the grid spaces featured in the pattern.

Look carefully at the reel grid and you’ll notice some blue-colored squares. These correspond to the designated pattern. Win on those spaces and they’ll turn yellow, indicating they’re now complete. Turn them all yellow to increase your rank by one and change the active Norse god.

Gift Of The Gods

There are four deities to cycle through as you increase your level, each with their own special feature. On any losing spin, they could randomly bless you with their unique powers, which are as follows:

Thor: Strikes the grid with lightning to create up to nine wilds.

Odin: Adds two groups of adjacent wilds to the grid.

Freya: Creates clusters of wilds until at least one win is complete.

Heimdall: Adds a wild to every single row.

Runes Of Valhalla

In the top-left corner, you’ll notice a number which progressively increases as you form clusters. This is the Runes Of Valhalla bonus. To have a chance of winning it, you must collect at least one rune and complete the pattern to level up.

Every time this happens, you’ll spin the bonus wheel, where each rune has its own section. If you collected that particular rune prior to completing the pattern, it becomes active on the wheel. If the wheel lands on an activated space, you’ll win the entire Valhalla bonus.

Wilds and Scatters

This highly unusual slot features neither a wild symbol nor a scatter.

An exciting animation plays as the player levels up from one to two. Odin can now be seen to the right of the reels.

How to Play Viking Runecraft Online

There are no traditional paylines on the 7×7 reel grid. Instead, you’ll need to match symbols together in clusters of five. Form wins in accordance with randomly-chosen patterns to level up and benefit from the different Gift Of The Gods modifiers.

Choose your stake using the options beneath the reels, then hit the green button to spin. You can also configure automatic spins with the orange button.

Try the Viking Runecraft Demo for Free before playing for real money

As you’ve learned from our Viking Runecraft review, this is a pretty complex game with far more features than the average slot. So, before you head off to one of our recommended real money casinos, take the time to practice in a risk-free environment. Try the free demo here on this page first.

Viking Runecraft Review – Our Final Verdict

Play’n GO pulled off a masterpiece with Viking Runecraft. It’s not hard to see why they chose to create a sequel, as well as eventually remaking the original. There is just so much going on and it’s a real feast for the senses.

You can look at the generous RTP, broad betting limits and ever-popular theme of Norse mythology, all of which are appealing. But it’s the sheer number of intriguing features which really stands out, especially the progressive leveling system which kept us highly engaged.

It’s so frustrating — but in a good way — when you just need a single piece of the puzzle that’s stuck in the corner of the grid. Then, when you eventually level up, you can’t wait to see how the newly acquired deity will impact your game play. We just couldn’t put this one down. Full marks!

Introduction to Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead

Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead is a casino slot from Play'n GO, combining the studio's most recognisable series with one of the more recent ones. You can probably already make them out from the title alone, but for the sake of clarity, let us point out that it's Book of Dead and Legion Gold. However, the game has only a little visual touch of the former, along with a similar logo design, while utilising the majority of mechanics from the latter. Throughout multiple ancient Roman-themed instalments, including Legion Gold Unleashed and Legion Gold Victory, the gameplay revolved around cash respins and free spins with mega symbols. The new edition follows the same format, offering slightly more Egyptian-influenced visuals and a max win of 10,000x the bet.

If you'd like to test the game features without risking real money, you can do so in the free demo mode available at the top of the page.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead is a video slot from Play'n GO with 5reels, 3 rows, and 25 paylines, where you can choose your stake from a range of options, starting from a Min. bet of 0.1 up to a Max. bet of 100. The game's math operates on a default RTP of 96.20%, indicating stable, long-term returns. However, several lower variants have also been released, including 94.20%, 91.20%, 87.20%, and 84.20%. Therefore, be sure to verify your version before playing. You can expect a relatively even average balance between the size and frequency of big wins due to medium volatility, while the max win can reach 10,000x the bet. The base hit frequency sits at the rate of 35.97%.

The game's main scene bears marks of an intense battle, where both sides must have suffered great casualties. Tons of weaponry and armour lie scattered around between the rubble of an ancient temple. Torn flags, smouldering remains, and crumbled walls prove that it was a fierce confrontation, while an ominous, emotional soundtrack resounds over the ruins, emphasising the gravity of the recent events. However, the gold-framed grid withstood the chaos of the fight and hovers readily in the middle, packed with polished symbols rolling through hieroglyph-lined reels. You can explore this intense, ancient setting on any modern device, as the game adapts seamlessly to all desktops, smartphones, and tablets.

Creating winning combinations requires landing at least 3 matching symbols on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost one, while covering any of the 25 paylines. Among the low-paying symbols, there are royal playing card ranks, like J, Q, K, and A, awarding 2x the bet for a complete payline of 5. The high-paying group includes images of a crocodile, a cobra, a bull, and a lion, which bring payouts ranging between 8x and 20x the bet for a 5-of-a-kind hit. Reels will also hold Wilds represented by a Roman soldier, which substitutes for other regular symbols and awards wins up to 20x the bet for independent combinations. There are also several types of Coins with cash prizes, Golden Scales that collect them, and Scatters to trigger the Mega Spins.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead?

You can win up to 10,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead?

The features are Gold Re-Spins, Golden Scales, Mega Spins, Coin Chest, and Go Ultra.

Mega Spins

Gold Re-Spins

Landing 6 Coins anywhere on the grid activates Gold Re-Spins. Coins land with instant prizes ranging from 1x to 1,000x the bet. You receive 3 initial re-spins, and whenever you land a Coin, it remains in its position and resets the spin count so that there are still 3 remaining. At the end of the feature, all prizes from Coins are added together and paid.

Golden Scales

Landing a Golden Scale awards all Coin prizes currently in view. They can land both in the base game and during Gold Re-Spins, but they don't stick to the grid in the bonus round. They still reset the spin count, though.

Landing 3 Scatters anywhere on the grid at the same time triggers 5 Mega Spins. Three adjacent reels become synced, forming a Mega symbol that moves randomly between spins. It's possible to retrigger the round by landing a Mega Scatter, which awards another batch of 5 spins, up to a maximum of 45. Gold Re-Spins can be triggered during Mega Spins by landing a Mega Coin symbol.

Expanding Wilds

Coin Chest

Any Coins landing without the Golden Scale and in quantities that don't trigger Golden Re-Spins are collected in the Coin Chest. The feature may randomly trigger and award one of the bonus prizes worth 10x (Mini), 25x (Minor), 100x (Major), or 500x the bet (Grand).

Go Ultra

The Go Ultra ante bet increases the active stake by 50% and, in exchange, increases the frequency of high-paying symbols in the base game, increases the number of Mega Spins to 6, and increases the number of Gold Re-Spins to 4.

Final Thoughts on Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead

Seeing a title like Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead may lead some players to believe it would be an intriguing fusion of the studio's two popular IPs. And while both the original Book of Dead and Legion Gold are relatively simple slots, some clever combination of Expanding Symbols and Cash Re-Spins could produce interesting results. Unfortunately, Play'n GO did not let its creative juices flow in this case, and simply recycled the gameplay from the Roman-themed series without changing virtually anything. In fact, the game feels like a straight-up reskin of Legion Gold Reckoning, given identical structure, features, and statistics. Hence, once more, you'll be trying to collect coins with cash worth up to 1,000x the bet during the base game and one of the bonuses, and hoping for the 3x3 Mega symbol to produce payline wins in free spins. Occasionally, a random trigger of the Treasure Chest may also award one of the somewhat underwhelming jackpot prizes.

In terms of audiovisuals, the game follows a similar style as Legion Gold and the Sphinx of Dead, mixing some ancient Egyptian vibes into the Roman setting. The entire package boasts the usual, high-quality Play'n GO graphics with plenty of polish and smooth animations, but it doesn't divert from the recycled patterns.

Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead is another repetitive clone based on the commonplace cash re-spins and free spins with mega symbols.

Yggdrasil has basically invented this idea for their latest Norse mythology installment; Ragnawolves WildEnergy. The multiplier wild increments according to the “lazy caterer's sequence”, which is akin to Yggdrasil’s DoubleMax system. Countdown Wilds can prolong the session with up to 4 respins per symbol, and you get a higher hit rate of both symbols in the bonus round. The 10,000x potential is solid as well, and this is a powerful Norse end times release that we recommend you check out immediately.The premium symbols pay between 1 and 2 x your stake for 5 of a kind wins, and wild symbols play a major role in all stages of this game.
