It comes with a starting multiplier of x1 that increases to x2 for the first respin. Each win involving the multiplier wild awards another respin, and the reel with the multiplier wild remains in place as the remaining reels respin.This goes on indefinitely as long as the multiplier wild is involved in a win, and its multiplier keeps incrementing according to the “lazy caterer's sequence”: 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56, 67, 79, 92, … etc. with no upper limit. The multiplier boosts all line wins the multiplier wild partakes in.The Countdown Wild symbol can appear on both reels 2 and 4, and any win involving countdown wilds also triggers a respin. They come with countdown numbers of 2, 3, or 4, and this tells you how many respins the wild provides if involved in a win.You can land both multiplier wilds and countdown wilds at the same time, or during the same respins session to prolong the respins feature. Non-UK players can pay 10x the stake to be guaranteed at least one wild of any kind per spin.The Bonus Round triggers when you land 3 scatters on reels 2, 3, and 4, respectively, and this gives you 10 free spins. We will definitely return for more, and Ragnawolves WildEnergy is well worth checking out.

It was a huge sensation overall, so fans have their hopes set really high for the second part.There are not so many significant differences between the two parts, to be honest. A couple of extra features were added to make the gameplay even more exciting, while in terms of the looks Play'n Go kept the original DNA. Anyway, let's take a closer look at what changes did the game undergo to develop a sense of what Reactoonz 2 can offer.Loading the game will take you to a familiar setting for as alluded to earlier, the look remained almost identical to the first part. Play'n Go has taken a lazy approach to the design, though, thus don't expect any remarkable visuals here. Set in an enigmatic cosmic realm, the semi-transparent reels showcase a rather basic blue background with energy flows floating across it. It's not the best graphical slot for sure since the visuals are pretty simple, however, it's the general ambiance that plays a central role here. The payouts are rather promising actually since full combos will award from 3x to 500x of the total bet.Helping you to form winning combinations are 4 Wild symbols, each of which acts as a substitute for any other regular symbol and comes with its own unique ability. Those include Uncharged Wilds, Energoon Wilds, Electric Wilds, and Gargatoon Wilds. More on that below.Alike the previous part of Reactoonz, this slot is played across a 7x7 sized grid with Cluster Pays mechanic, meaning that you have to match symbols in clusters to get rewarded. You'll require 5 horizontally and vertically adjacent symbols to score a win, while 15+ clusters are the most desirable for they can lead to majestic prizes.When it comes to the math model, it's a bit frustrating to report that Play'n Go has slightly cut the stats in comparison to the original, though, the potential has been bumped up after the devs heard the voice of people. One thing that remained the same is the volatility level, which is still high, rated by the developer 8 out of 10, so adjust your bets wiser to survive in the long run. Introduction to Triple Beasts of Fortune

Triple Beasts of Fortune is a casino slot from Play'n GO, where raging animal spirits bring legendary wins worth up to 30,000x the bet. Set in the barren landscapes studded with ominous rock formations, the game embraces nature through intimidating fauna and mysterious energy that fuels its fury. To unleash the ancient energy, you must match the enigmatic gemstones adorned with runes to skulls of the same colour. Every time it happens, you stand before a chance to enter Free Spins with one or more helpful modifiers active throughout the round. The spirits can grace you with additional multipliers on Wilds, increased payout values, and a larger grid to maximise your win potential. If you channel all three animal auras at the same time, your round will benefit from the ultimate synergy of features!

If you'd like to test how the natural energy transforms into wins, check out the risk-free demo mode at the top of the page.

Triple Beasts of Fortune is a video slot from Play'n GO with 5 reels, 3-6 rows, and up to 7,776 ways to win, where you can choose your stake from a range of options, starting from a Min. bet of 0.1 up to a Max. bet of 50. The game's math operates on a default RTP of 96.20%, indicating stable, long-term returns. However, several lower variants have also been released, including 94.20%, 91.20%, 87.20%, and 84.20%. Therefore, be sure to verify your version before playing. You can expect big wins to happen slightly less frequently but carry more value on average due to medium-high volatility, while the max win can reach 30,000x the bet.

The game's main scene offers a simple view of a barren wildland haunted by roaming thunderstorms and covered with an endless stream of dust carried by strong winds. The mountainous landscape is stripped of any vegetation, making the place look like the end of the world. In the middle, encased in a natural rock frame, hovers the playing panel, where animal symbols and royals on stone tiles populate the reels. Next to it, three buffalo skulls pulsate with ancient energy, ready to absorb the power of mysterious gemstones. The overall design is clean and polished, with some subtle idle animations keeping the scene alive. Thanks to the responsive nature of the setup, you can launch the game on any modern device, whether you play on a desktop, a smartphone, or a tablet.

Creating winning combinations requires landing at least 3 matching symbols on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost one. Among the low-paying symbols, you'll find royal playing card ranks, like 10, J, Q, K, and A, awarding 0.3x the bet for a complete way of 5. The high-paying group includes animals, such as a snake, a crow, a boar, a bear, and a bison, which bring payouts ranging between 0.4x and 1.4x the bet for a 5-of-a-kind hit. Reels will also hold Wilds represented by an irregular rock with the word 'Wild', which substitutes for other regular symbols, but appears only on reels 2, 3, and 4. There are also three types of Scatters appearing as green, red, and blue gemstones adorned with runes.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Triple Beasts of Fortune?

You can win up to 30,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Triple Beasts of Fortune?

The features are Free Spins and Go Ultra.

Free Spins

Every time a gemstone Scatter lands on the reels, it's collected by a skull of the matching colour. When it happens, there's a chance that the bonus game with the corresponding upgrade will be awarded. In each mode, you begin with 7 free spins that cannot be retriggered. Depending on the combination of Scatters that triggered the round, one, two, or all three upgrades will be active throughout the feature.

Upgrade = doubles the payouts of the highest-paying bison symbol and increases its number on all reels.

Expand = increases the grid size to 6 rows, thus enabling 7,776 ways to win.

Multiplier = enables multipliers of x2 and x3 on Wilds.

Go Ultra

When you enable the Go Ultra ante bet, your base stake will increase by 50%. In exchange, when you trigger the bonus round, you receive 14 Free Spins instead of 7.

Final Thoughts on Triple Beasts of Fortune

Another day, another 3-pot collection game. We've probably said it before, but what else is there to say when providers continuously repeat the same mechanics, just redressing them in different themes? If it were at least something unique and entertaining that covers the reels and their surroundings, perhaps the level of excitement would be higher. Seeing the umpteenth buffalo slot wrapped around a simple gameplay, where three upgrades empower standard Free Spins, is hardly something to write home about. Even if you play slots occasionally, you have undoubtedly encountered a fair amount of those already. The cycle is identical to what it has been for years with this format, which requires you to collect three types of Scatters into their matching pots and hope that one of them randomly activates and awards Free Spins. The trifecta of upgrades is obviously where the biggest potential lies, making the multiplier Wilds and doubled payouts on the highest-value symbol work in unison on the expanded grid.

The audiovisual package is relatively average as well. Play'n GO knows how to deliver an eye-pleasing setup, and it's perfectly visible here through polished symbols and nice effects accompanying wins and feature triggers. Still, it's a generic animal-themed slot with a pinch of mystery depicted as their thundering fury.

Triple Beasts of Fortune is an unimpressive release, reiterating the overused 3-pot mechanics in a natural theme populated by raging animals.

If you’re looking for something revolutionary, Secret of Dead is not it. This release basically combines elements from 2 previous Play’n Go installments, namely Scroll of Dead and Legacy of Dead.You get a 6th reel bolted on in all stages of the game this time, not only in the bonus round, but you’re still dealing with 10 paylines. As in Legacy of Dead, each bonus round retrigger gives you another chosen expanding symbol. However, the top-tier Shai (Egyptian goddess of fate) symbol is worth 2x as much in the bonus round, leaving you with a solid 10,000x single spin potential (which also happens to be the game’s win cap).The royal symbols pay up to 25x your stake for 6 of a kind wins, while the premiums pay between 100 and 500 x your stake for the same. The Ankh symbol replaces the usual Book symbol, and it serves double duty as both wild and scatter. As a wild, the Ankh steps in for all regular pay symbols to help complete winning combos, and it holds no value of its own.Landing 3, 4, 5 or 6 Ankh scatters at the same time awards a scatter win of 1x, 10x, 50x or 250x your stake, respectively, and it also triggers the Bonus Round with 8, 10, 12 or 15 free spins, respectively. A pay symbol is selected randomly before the free spins start, and it becomes the special Expanding Symbol during the feature.The Expanding Symbol pays like a scatter symbol, meaning that you only need to land enough instances anywhere for all instances to expand and give you a corresponding full-reels payout. The expanding symbol doesn't need to land adjacent in other words, and it expands and pays after the regular win calculation has been summed up.You win +5 extra spins when you land 3+ scatters anywhere in view during the bonus round, and you also get an additional randomly chosen Expanding Symbol added to the mix. It’s thus possible to turn up to all 9 pay symbols into special expanding scatter pay symbols. The top-tier Shai symbol (egyptian lady Fortuna) pays double if expanding.The gamble feature can be chosen after any win, including the total win from the bonus round, and it’s a classic card color/suit guessing double/quadruple or nothing game. You can gamble your winnings up to 5 times in a row, or up to 2,500x your stake at the most.You get to see a few smaller wins, and a bonus round teaser, before the feature finally triggers close to the 1-minute mark. We got the minimum of 8 free spins, and ‘10’ was chosen as our special expanding symbol. We came close to filling the screen a few times, and we also took our chances in the gamble feature afterwards. We understand that Play’n Go can easily milk it for all its worth by doing what they are doing though, and connoisseurs will probably not mind yet another variant. The bonus round comes with a 6th reel though, as well as a randomly chosen expanding symbol. This gives you a 7,500x single spin potential during the feature.Legacy of Dead - is Play’n Go’s highly popular follow-up to their iconic Book of Dead, and the big twist is that you get a new randomly chosen expanding symbol per bonus round retrigger. Up to all 9 pay symbols can thus become expanding scatter pay symbols, and the max win is the standard 5,000x your stake.Ghost of Dead - is another installment in Play’n Go’s ongoing ‘Book slot’ series, and you get random base game Ghost Spins that come with a chosen expanding symbol. You can choose 1 of 3 random expanding symbols when the bonus round triggers, and the Awakened tier with 1 extra expanding symbol is your best chance at cracking the 10,000x potential.

Rise of Olympus 1000: Play'n GO Turns Up the Multiplier Math

Grid Layout and How Wins Form

The game plays out on a 6x5 grid using a scatter-pays system. There are no traditional paylines or "ways" here. Instead, a win lands whenever 8 or more matching symbols appear anywhere in view. When that happens, the winning symbols are removed and fresh ones cascade down to fill the gaps, so a single paid spin can chain into several consecutive wins. That cascade loop is the heart of the game and the route to its biggest payouts.

RTP and Volatility

The default return to player is 96.24%, which sits just above the typical industry average. Be aware that Play'n GO supplies the title in several configurable RTP versions (96.24%, 91.24%, 87.24% and 84.24%), so the figure you actually play on depends on the operator hosting the game. The volatility is rated High. In practice that means a choppy base game with stretches of small or no returns, balanced against the rare sequences where the multiplier meter and cascades combine for something large.

The Multiplier Meter and Free Spins

The standout feature is the multiplier system. Multiplier symbols carry values that climb through a series of steps reaching as high as x1,000, and the values you collect are added to a running total. Landing 3 or more Scatters awards 12 free spins, and this is where the engine really matters: every multiplier value you gather feeds a persistent total meter that applies to all future wins during the round, stacking alongside any new multiplier symbols that drop in. It is this compounding behavior, rather than any single huge symbol payout, that pushes the game toward its ceiling.

Optional Ante Bet

For players who want to lean into the feature, there is an optional Ante Bet that adds 50% to your stake per spin. With it switched on, multiplier symbols are guaranteed to upgrade during consecutive cascades, sharpening the path toward bigger combined multipliers. It is a trade-off: you pay more per spin in exchange for a more aggressive multiplier build, which suits the high-volatility profile but burns through a balance faster.

Maximum Win Potential

The top theoretical win is 60,000x your bet. As with any high-variance slot, that figure represents an extreme outcome that very few players will ever see, and it depends on the multiplier meter reaching exceptional heights inside the free spins round. The more realistic appeal is the range between those peaks: strong cascade sequences with an elevated meter can still return solid multiples of your stake well short of the cap.

Betting Range and Mobile Play

Stakes start at 0.10 per spin, giving lower-budget players room to explore the cascade mechanic before committing more. The Ante Bet, when active, raises the cost of each spin by half.

Try the Demo

The demo uses the same grid, scatter-pay mechanic, multiplier meter and free spins as the full game, making it the sensible way to get a feel for the high volatility before deciding whether it fits your style. Explore more Play'n GO slots, or try similar titles such as Tomb of Gold 2, Lion Saga Odyssey and City of Sound.

However, this slot title seems inspired by another top iGaming developer - Pragmatic Play!Seasoned gamblers are well-aware of Gates Of Olympus, its sequels, and the hype that followed the release of the original. The mighty Zeus the Thunderer has granted his favor and will accompany you on this mythological adventure. He will stay on the left side of the 5x5 grid and will frequently add Multiplier symbols to the reels. It was quite successful, actually, and it turned into a series with a couple of awesome sequels. The soundtrack is of high quality and includes theme-related effects, like thunderbolts and Hellas tunes.7×7 Zeus is built with mobile gamblers in mind and is based on HTML5, which explains the slot's compatibility with Android and iOS. You can use various features to make the gameplay even smoother, like Buy Feature and Autoplay, but Quickspin is not available!As I already mentioned, the basic board consists of 5 reels and 5 rows. I will introduce the special mechanic in one of the following sections, but for now, I'll only say that the active zone can increase up to 49 symbols in total.7×7 Zeus stands out with amazing symbol artwork and epic animation effects when a win is scored. A couple of mythological creatures land as the highest-valued characters, while the medium and low-paying figures are heroic artifacts and multicolored gems.Pegasus pays 8x the bet for 7 to 9 matches, 20x for 10 or 11, and 100x for 12 and more in view. Griffon is also generous - 3x, 10x, and 30x the stake, respectively. The Helmet of Ares and the Trident of Poseidon pay up to 20x and 12x, while the Goblet of Dionysus - up to 10x the wager.Red, yellow, purple, blue, green, and cyan gems form the most common win combinations and pay different prizes between 0.20x and 8x the bet. Sadly, substituting wilds are missing, and skaters land as Zeus' Thunderbolt. The betting range is slightly shallower than usual - €0.20 to €80 per spin.The 7×7 Zeus RTP ranges, but both official rates are lower than expected - 94% and 90.50%. All that in a medium to highly volatile environment with an average Hit Frequency coefficient. All that only calls for applying betting strategies to your play! The 7×7 Zeus max win is 10,149.70x the bet or up to a pretty decent €811,976.7×7 Zeus might look like Gates of Olympus on steroids, but actually, it is not another complete copycat. The provider has taken full advantage of GATI's resources and has combined them with some pretty wild ideas. It’s not just the expanding grid, but let’s start with it to show you why it’s rather unique!The favorite scatter-pay mechanics find a new application in this Legendary slot. If you spot any of the primary symbols on at least 7 places anywhere on the grid, a prize is paid according to the Paytable. Symbols involved in the combinations are removed, and the combos are listed in the Drop History panel beneath Zeus.The rest of the symbols on the grid fall down, creating cascades and as usual, new ones come from above to fill out the empty spaces. This sequence can continue for as long as new winning formations appear on the reels. These mechanics are active during the base game and bonus round!The Thunder Scatter is a special symbol that may land randomly on any spin and in different numbers. Each one will then increase the grid with either a row upwards or a reel - to the left or to the right. The maximum exposure is 49 symbols, but they can be distributed in different grid layouts.Thunder Reels can modify the board in any of the following configurations: 5x5 to 5x9, 6x5 to 6x8, 7x5 to 7x7, 8x5, 8x6, and 9x5. Larger grids increase the chance of landing winning combinations in more massive sizes. Each expansion affects the Multiplier Symbols in view, if any.Zeus has the power to cast Multipliers on the playing grid on each spin or consecutive symbol drop. They can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 50x, 100x, or 250x. Each Multiplier symbol in view double ups in case of a win or a Thunder Scatter expansion.The maximum value of any Multiplier is 250x, and the total win from a spin is multiplied by the combined Multiplier symbols in view. From my experience, while testing the slot, Zeus intervenes pretty often, but the dropping rate during the base game is not stable.If you are lucky to land 3, 4, or 5+ bonus scatters, you'll get a cash prize of 2.50x, 5x, or 150x the bet, respectively. But also, they will trigger the Free Spins minigame and will award 12 wager-free rounds. Keep in mind that the bonus triggering rate is 1 in 281 spins, so don't expect it too often!The bonus round starts with a grid layout of 5x5, and if it gets enlarged via Thunder Scatters, the new configuration doesn't reset. It will stay the same until the end of the feature or until new Thunder Scatters appear. In any case, it can't exceed the 49-symbol maximum!Similar to Gates of Olympus, Free Spins in 7×7 Zeus is played with a Total Multiplier, which starts from zero. The total spin Multiplier is added to the counter in case at least 1 winning combination was formed. New combos will be increased by the combined value of the new Multiplier symbols and the current Total Multiplier.7×7 Zeus is packed with a Bonus Buy, but it might eb disabled by some casino operators. Whenever active, it provides players a couple of options at the asking prices:ProsConsSo, to wrap all this up and continue forward, 7×7 Zeus is an excellent alternative if you are a fan of Greek Mythology slots with advanced mechanics. Indeed, there are too many there, and most features Pay Anywhere, or Cluster Pays with cascades and other grid modifiers.Well, here 4ThePlayer has added a few dramatic twists like an expanding grid, in a rather unique way, and doubling multipliers. Both have massive potential and, combined, can easily bring the win cap. Perhaps that's why the number of Zeus' add-ins is lower than expected, especially during Divine Free Spins.The max win and the lower cap on the Multipliers ranks the title behind Gates of Olympus 1000, but in terms of features, it's way ahead. Perhaps this is the reason why I would like to recommend 2 Gods Zeus vs Thor as an alternative and not one of the Pragmatic Play upgraded copycats.Overall, 7×7 Zeus won’t disappoint you and I recommend the game warmly. Nevertheless, the approach should be with caution due to the several "underwater traps". The Multiplier drop rate and betting range's wideness might not be enough for you to develop a winning strategy. Wildies Details, RTP and Volatility

Theme & Graphics in Wildies

We’re not really sure where the name Wildies comes from. Perhaps it’s a play on a famous cafe somewhere in the world that this writer is too ignorant to know about. That would be our best guess, since the setting is a cozy looking coffee and cake shop.

Wildies Slot Features

Now to the main part of our Wildies review. It’s time to assess the features and symbols of this Pragmatic Play title.

Regular Symbols

Eight regular symbols exist in the Wildies slot. The four lower-paying symbols are playing card icons J through A, all of which pay the same. You’ll receive 0.2x, 0.4x and 1x whenever you land three, four or five on a payline.

The higher-paying symbols are in keeping with the cafe theme. A colorful candy cane awards up to 12x, followed by a tempting cup of coffee that pays 16x for five-of-a-kind.

Wilds

The wild symbol is a sandwich cookie with a pink filling, reminiscent of a Vienna finger. As with most real money slots, this substitutes for other regular symbols to form wins. However, due to its unusual size, it always covers two positions on the reels.

There are also prizes for collecting multiple wilds. Three, four and five on a payline returns the same as the highest-paying regular symbol: 2x, 6x and 30x.

Scatters

We’re not entirely sure what the scatter is meant to be. Perhaps a slice of pink marble cake? Whatever it is, it sure looks appealing. And not just because it can trigger a bonus of six free spins, which we’ll discuss shortly in this Wildies review.

Wild Respins

If a wild symbol appears during the base game, a respin is triggered. The wild stays on the reels for this spin, potentially earning you extra rewards.

Should additional wilds appear during the respin, the feature will retrigger a maximum of four times. Each extra wild also carries a multiplier, starting with 2x, followed by 3x, 5x and 10x.

Land at least three scatters to trigger free spins. The game begins with a wild randomly placed onto the grid, which moves to a new position for every spin. Any additional wilds also remain in play for the duration of the bonus feature, with multipliers as described above.

If a scatter lands, it will be collected. For every three gained, an extra wild is added to the reels. Triggering the bonus with four or five scatters means the round begins with extra wilds and some scatters already collected.

The aim is to match at least three of the same symbol on a payline. More symbols means a bigger payout. Scatters are the key to unlocking free spins and the maximum potential payout of 7,500x.

Even though this is a fairly straightforward game, it never hurts to play for free before heading to a real money casino. The demonstration game on this page will help you get to grips with the rules and features, before risking your own cash.

A cafe has to be one of the quirkier slot themes around. We can’t think of many similar titles, anyway, which has to be a positive. Even though many familiar Pragmatic Play elements can be seen here, at least the developer is trying something different, no matter how minor.

As long as land at least one symbol that’s not a blank, the respins tally resets to 3 again. Each symbol you land will also become sticky on the reels. The different colored money bags, as well as the chest symbol, trigger the following features:The Hold & Spin Respins feature ends when you run out of respins, or when all 20 reel positions have been covered. All the money bag values are then summed up, and the global multiplier is applied if you landed at least 1 green bag. If all 20 positions are filled, you also win the Grand Jackpot of 1,000x your stake.A lot has been stripped away from this Deluxe version, but at least you now have the opportunity to purchase the Money Respins feature. It will cost you 100x your stake, and this gives you between 8 and 19 money bag symbols on the next spin. The bonus buy feature is not included for UK players.After a while of base game grinding, we gave in to temptation and paid for the Money Respins feature. The visuals might have been shined up a tiny bit, but the 15,000x potential is less than half of what is advertised in the original title. And let’s be honest, some of these games do a better job of transporting us to ancient Egypt than others. But when it comes to Pragmatic Play ‘s ‘Ancient Egypt’, you can tell they did their research. The symbols, the background music, and the overall aesthetic make you feel like you’re exploring a pyramid rather than just spinning a slot machine.

But here’s the thing – we’ve seen so many Egyptian-themed slot games, it’s easy for them to start feeling repetitive. So it takes a game like ‘Ancient Egypt’ to remind us why we fell in love with the theme in the first place. It’s got enough unique features to make it stand out, like the Scarab symbol that acts as both a wild and a scatter, triggering the bonus round when you land three or more of them.

Overall, ‘Ancient Egypt’ is a solid addition to the extensive catalog of Egyptian-themed slot games. It’s definitely one of the best-looking ones out there, and with the potential for big wins in the bonus round, it’s worth exploring. Who knows, maybe this is the game that will finally allow you to fulfill your dream of living like a pharaoh. Or, you know, at least buying some nice Egyptian cotton sheets.

Are you ready to travel to the land of the pharaohs? ‘Ancient Egypt’ is a five-reel slot machine with 10 paylines – the perfect game for adventure lovers. Welcome to the land of pharaohs, hieroglyphics, and treasures beyond your wildest dreams. ‘Ancient Egypt’ has brought to life the glory of this civilization in a slot machine. In this section, let’s explore the symbol values and the story behind them.

Queen Cleopatra, the last pharaoh of ancient Egypt, is the highest-paying symbol. If five Cleo symbols appear, you get $250! That’s like finding a valuable artefact in the tomb of Tutankhamun. The coveted Eye of Ra follows next, and the deity Anobi and Egyptian cross complete the thematic symbols. Don’t worry if these names are unfamiliar; the game rewards you with a payoff nonetheless.

In addition to these thematic symbols, there are the card symbols ranging from ten to ace. These playing cards have the lowest values but help increase your winnings. You can’t decipher the hieroglyphs of a pyramid without a guide, nor can you win in this game without the help of these cards.

But the symbol that holds the key to the most significant winnings is the Golden Scarab. It’s both the Wild and Scatter symbol that helps complete a winning combination or activates the bonus round, respectively. As they say, ‘to beetles that bring fortune, take care not to step on them.’ So, watch your step and let the Golden Scarab lead the way.

‘Ancient Egypt’ takes you back in time to explore the secrets of this old civilization and win some treasure. So, what are you waiting for? Spin the wheel, align the symbols and become the king of the pyramids!

Introduction to Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity

Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity is a casino slot from Pragmatic Play that adds a twist to a familiar formula. This is the third and latest installment in the studio’s long-running series, reminding us of previous visits to the Chinese mountain village in Chests of Cai Shen and Chests of Cai Shen 2. Here, Pragmatic Play has kept the design intact with minor changes to this high-volatility gameplay. As usual, we get the Pots mechanic, with Bonus Features that affect the Hold & Win-based Bonus Game with its corresponding feature. This time, the studio offers all four Bonus Pots we’ve seen in previous releases, making this a mash-up of the series’ best-known features. For fans of the series, it might work as a familiar experience, combining elements from previous games, but for us, it lacks the ambition, both visually and mechanically, to get us excited.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity is a video slot by Pragmatic Play that features 5 reels, 3 rows, and 25 paylines. You can select bet sizes ranging from 0.25 to 250, with a default RTP of 96.5%, which is considered above industry average. However, the operators can choose to use lower ones, such as 95.5% or 94.5%. This game has high volatility and a hit frequency of 31.84%, offering potential wins up to 15,000X your bet. On average, it takes 57,012,543 spins to land the maximum win. Landing wins bigger than 5000X and 1000X the bet, respectively, average 1 in 499,466 and 162,023 spins.

The game’s design is based on a familiar Asian theme, set in a harmonious Chinese mountain village. The 5x3 game grid is in the middle of the screen, with the 4 Pots above the reels. If you want to boost the gaming experience for a cost, activate the Feature Buy buttons on the left side. All other buttons, including the Spin and Bet Size, can be found below the reels. You can play Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity on all mobile devices, desktops, and notepads. You create a winning combination by landing 3 or more of the same symbol types on adjacent reels starting at the leftmost reel.

The lower-paying symbols are 10, J, Q, and K. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays 0.8X. The higher-paying symbols are an A, a snake, a pig, a bunny, a bull, and Cai Shen. Landing 5 of the same symbol type pays between 1.2X and 3.2X.

The game’s Wild Symbol is a red symbol type with Chinese letters, and can only appear on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5. There is no traditional Scatter Symbol in this game; instead, 5 types of Bonus Coins can land on the reels. Whenever a Bonus Coin lands in view, it can randomly trigger the Bonus Game with its corresponding Bonus Feature. During the Bonus Game, the Money Symbol (gold coin) can land with values ranging from 0.6X to 150X the bet. Let’s find out what kind of features this game has to offer.

Special Features & Slot Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot of Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity?

The max win is 15,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot of Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity?

The features of this slot game are Wild Symbol, Bonus Coins, Chest Respins, and Feature Buy.

Chest Repins

Wild Symbol

The Wild Symbol substitutes all symbols except Bonus Coins and Money Symbols and helps you create winning combinations. It can only land on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5.

Bonus Coins

Whenever one of the four types of Bonus Coins lands during the Base Game, they can randomly activate the Chest Respins feature. Each Bonus Coin comes with its corresponding Bonus Feature, which is carried over to the Chest Respins.

The following Bonus Features are:

Green “Prosperity” Coin = After every respin, there is a chance that up to 3 Money Symbols currently on screen get their value upgraded with a random value.

Blue “Fulfillment” Coin = The game grid gets divided into 4 zones, and a random multiplier with values of 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 10X, or 100X is assigned to each of the zones. Whenever a zone is filled with Money Symbols, their values are multiplied by that specific Zone Multiplier.

Red “Double” Coin = The Chest Respins is played on two 5x3 grids instead of one, featuring its own set of Money Symbols and respins.

Purple “Longevity” Coin = The feature starts with 4 respins instead of 3, and gets reset to 4 whenever a Money Symbol lands on the reels.

Multi-color “Quad” Coin = Can randomly trigger 1, 2, 3, or all 4 of the Bonus Features.

Chest Respins

This feature can be randomly triggered whenever a Bonus Coin lands in view, awarding 3 respins with one or several Bonus Features activated. Only blanks or Money Symbols can land on the reels. Whenever a Money Symbol lands, it gets locked in position for the remainder of the feature and resets the respins.

The Money Symbol can land with a value of 0.6X, 0.8X, 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 8X, 10X, 12X, 14X, 16X, 20X, 30X the bet. It can also land as the Mini, Minor, or Major Prize awarding 10X, 20X, or 150X the bet, respectively.

The triggered Bonus Feature applies its corresponding effect to the feature. When no more respins are left, you are awarded the total value of all Money Symbols in view. However, if all reel positions are filled with Money Symbols, you are awarded the Grand Prize of 5,000X the bet.

Feature Buy

If you want to boost the gaming experience for a cost, use the Feature Buy options with an RTP of 96.5%:

200X (Fulfillment) = Activate the Bonus Game with at least one 100X Multiplier guaranteed.

750X (Quad) = Activates the Bonus Game with all Bonus Features. Also, at least one 100X Multiplier on each grid is guaranteed.

Final Thoughts on Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity

Pragmatic Play invites us to a familiar Asian-inspired gaming experience, adding another entry to their Chests of Cai Shen series. Here, we get almost identical visuals as previous games, presenting a generic Chinese theme, without any surprises.

So what makes this game stand out from previous releases? The studio has kept the core gameplay intact, offering the recycled Pots mechanic, in which one or more Bonus Features can impact the Hold & Win Bonus Game. This time, we get all four Pots from the previous releases in the same game, making this a mash-up of the two other Chest of Cai slots. However, Pragmatic Play has included a chance to trigger all Bonus Features at once, but without boosting the max win of 15,000X the bet. We would like to see a new modifier in this game, which would’ve pushed the series forward instead of this recycled formula.

Overall, the combination of previous features might appeal to fans of the series, offering all their favorite Bonus Features in a single experience. Even though we’ve seen it all before, there are still some decent wins, especially when all Pots are activated at once. However, the main gameplay remains the same, lacking the necessary innovation needed to earn a good rating. If you want more from Pragmatic Play we recommend Gates of Olympus 2500.

Chests of Cai Shen - Infinity is a slot that keeps the gameplay intact, acting as a “best of” version of previous games in the series.

The 5,000x potential is the same as in the predecessor, and we had good fun testing Jewel Rush at least.You need between 5 and 15+ matching symbols in a cluster anywhere in view to win, and each spin drops 49 symbols onto the 7x7 grid. Winning symbols are removed and replaced by new and or existing symbols dropping down via the Tumble feature, and this repeats for as long as you keep winning.You get a Random Multiplier Feature in the base game, as winning symbols may come with an x2 win multiplier. All multiplier symbols that partake in the same win will boost that win, and the multipliers multiply together before being applied. You can get a cluster win multiplier up to x256 via this feature.You need at least 3 scatter symbols in view to trigger the Bonus Round, and this gives you 10 free spins. Symbols in winning clusters can come with multipliers of x2 or x4 in the bonus round, and they multiply together before boosting the cluster win just like in the base game.The maximum multiplier is still x256 though, but they hit more frequently in the bonus round. You retrigger the bonus round with 10, 11, 12, 13, or 14 free spins, respectively, when you land 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 scatters in the same free spin. Non-UK players, and anyone eligible, can purchase the feature for 100x the stake.You get to see a few base game wins here and there, before we purchase the bonus round close to the 1-minute mark. The feature plays out for the remainder of the 2:15-minute highlights video, and you can see for yourself how we fared by hitting the play button below.Pragmatic Play has seen great success with Sugar Rush, which became an instant classic, and Jewel Rush has great potential as well. Not because it’s anything too special, but because of the easy-going and enjoyable gameplay. Everything flows smoothly all the way, and not least if you switch on turbo mode or hold down the spacebar to spin. Winning clusters will simply get boosted by multipliers (or not) each time. The good news is, of course, that the multipliers multiply together instead of simply being added together.This is a simpler and more straightforward way of doing things than in the predecessor game, where highlighted positions produced multipliers. The colorful and sparkling jewels filling the grid all the way are enjoyable and mood-lifting to watch, and solid multiplier boosts up to x256 can benefit you in all stages of the game. You get more frequent multiplier boosts in the bonus round, and the 5,000x potential is the same as in Sugar Rush. The candy theme is not everyone’s favorite after all, as it can affect your diet, and with Jewel Rush Pragmatic Play has given players a solid alternative.

Hugo Legacy

Our Hugo Legacy review takes a look at the latest slot to star 1990s cult hero Hugo the Troll. The likable fantasy character returns, along with all of his friends, in this August 2023 release which marks his 30th anniversary.

The Hugo Legacy slot by Play’n GO will appeal to a mass audience, with wide betting limits, well-balanced volatility and an action-packed cluster pays mechanism. To learn all about these, plus the slot’s many other features, keep reading!

Software Provider Play’n GO

Release Date August 2023

RTP 96.20%

Volatility Medium

Max Win 3,000x

Reels x Rows 7 x 7

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.10 – $100

Number of Paylines Cluster Pays

Themes Fantasy, Cartoon

Basic Details of the Hugo Legacy Slot

Hugo Legacy Details, RTP and Volatility

Although the 3,000x max win of the Hugo Legacy slot isn’t the biggest around, the standard Return To Player rate of 96.20% is a little above average. Be careful though, as several much less generous versions of the game can be found at some online casinos. These values are 94.20%, 91.20%, 87.20% and 84.20%.

The game’s mathematical model is nicely balanced, offering enough decent wins to keep even the most impatient of players happy. Play’n GO rates the variance level as 6/10. You can play from just $0.10 per spin, which suits casual gamers well enough. But higher-rollers are kept in mind too, with a maximum play of $100.

Theme & Graphics in Hugo Legacy

Hugo Legacy is set in a fantasy world, with a scenic forest sitting behind the 7×7 reel grid. This is beautifully depicted, while the cast of characters are also drawn in great detail. Throughout the game, a dramatic, almost cinematic score plays, adding to the drama and tension.

Anyone who grew up watching Hugo the Troll’s touch-tone telephone games on 1990s television shows will instantly get it. Hugo’s familiar friends all make an appearance in the game, while the old-school red telephone to the right of the grid is a nod to the character’s origins.

Hugo the Troll stands to the left of the 7×7 grid which has just paid $1.20. The game’s logo is seen at the top-right.

Hugo Legacy Slot Features

No Hugo Legacy review would be complete without a runthrough of the slot’s key gameplay features. So let’s address that immediately.

Regular Symbols

The game’s higher-paying symbols are Hugo and four of his friends. Jean Paul the monkey, Fernando the toucan, Don Croco the crocodile and the evil witch Scylla all make an appearance. They can pay up to 1,000x for a cluster of 20 or more.

Lower paying symbols are images from Hugo games of old, including mining carts, dynamite and a skeleton key. You’ll also find bars of gold with “30 years” etched into them, a nod to the fact that this is an anniversary slot.

Cascades

Match at least five symbols in a cluster and they’ll vanish from the playing grid. This creates space for new symbols to tumble in, potentially leading to winning combinations.

Wild

Like all good online slots, Hugo Legacy features a wild symbol. This is a huge, sparkling diamond and it can replace any regular symbol to create wins.

Telephone Meter

There’s no scatter in this game, but it’s still possible to earn free spins. Every time you form a winning cluster, the symbols involved are added to the telephone meter. Charge it enough and various benefits will come your way.

Match at least 15 symbols in any single round and spin a wheel containing all of the game’s characters. Whichever is chosen brings their own unique element to the rest of the spin:

Hugo: Between five and eight wilds are added to the reels.

Scylla: Destroys lots of symbols, while protecting one or two randomly-chosen types.

Don Croco: Between two and five types of symbols are transformed.

Fernando: Changes a symbol to wilds at random.

Jean Paul: Picks a symbol type and creates a cluster.

Free Spins

Keep charging the meter to 35 and you’ll win a free spin. The more symbols you collect, the better the spin you’ll receive:

35: Two character modifiers in play.

40: Three character modifiers.

45: Four character modifiers with five collected wilds.

50: All five character modifiers with 30 collected wilds.

During a free spin, all winning wilds collected from the first phase are returned to the grid once the character modifiers are complete.

Before playing your free spin, you’ll have the chance to gamble and win additional character modifiers. However, losing means you’ll play with just one modifier.

Scylla the evil witch poses on the left of the reels during the free spin bonus. A big win of $50.44 has just been paid.

How to Play Hugo Legacy Online

The mechanics of Play’n GO’s Hugo Legacy slot are extremely straightforward. Choose your stake from the options at the base of the reels, or use the plus and minus signs to adjust the bet. To spin, hit the double arrows button just to the right.

There are no playlines here. Instead, you’ll need to match a cluster of at least five same-type symbols. Do so and they’ll be removed from the 7×7 grid, allowing new symbols to drop into the spaces.

If you’re able to clear 35 symbols in one spin, the telephone to the right of the reels will be sufficiently charged to earn you a free spin.

Try the Hugo Legacy Demo for Free before playing for real money

Playing free slots is always the best way to understand a game before you risk your hard-earned cash. Why not enjoy the Hugo Legacy demo right here on this page? It’s a risk-free opportunity to safely make mistakes before graduating to real money play.

Hugo Legacy Review – Our Final Verdict

This is the sixth release in Play’n GO’s Hugo series and we were a little surprised by the direction taken. As you’ve learned elsewhere in this Hugo Legacy review, the maximum win in this medium-volatility slot is just 3,000x. And yet the previous title, Hugo Carts, was extremely volatile, with an impressive 25,000x top payout.

If the potential rewards were an initial disappointment, everything else came as a nice surprise. The game is extremely easy to pick up, while the betting limits are wide enough to appeal to any level of gamer. We loved the dramatic soundtrack, which fits the wider fantasy theme perfectly. While the visually-detailed characters each bring an interesting attribute to the game, without being overly complicated.

When playing the Hugo Legacy free demo, we found it hard to trigger the bonus spins. But we were treated to a plentiful supply of big wins and high-tempo action that was great fun to experience.

Ghost of Dead Slot Review

This Ghost of Dead review runs through the key features of a spooky Play’n GO slot released in September 2021. Although Rich Wilde doesn’t feature in this particular release, it’s another game which utilizes the popular “Book of” format.

Dare you enter the haunted crypt in search of a 10,000x payout? Before you do, read our Ghost of Dead review in full to prepare yourself for the potential horrors within.

Software Provider Play’n GO

Release Date September 2021

RTP 96.21%

Volatility High

Max Win 10,000x

Reels x Rows 5 x 3

Minimum – Maximum Bet $0.01 – $50

Number of Paylines 10

Themes Ancient Egypt

Basic Details of the Ghost of Dead Slot

Ghost of Dead Details, RTP and Volatilit

To kick off this Ghost of Dead review, let’s quickly lay out what’s under the hood of this ghoulish game. For starters, be prepared for a scarily high level of volatility which results in a top potential win of 10,000x.

The game’s return to player rate is generally a quite average 96.21%. However, a number of lesser-paying versions exist online, including 94.21%, 91.21%, 87.22% and 84.22%, so watch out.

Unusually for Play’n GO, this is a penny slot, so you can literally play from just $0.01 per spin. There are 10 adjustable paylines on the 5×3 grid, with a maximum possible bet of $50.

A scarab symbol is visible on reel one after a losing spin. The bet size is $1, seen below the 5×3 reel grid.

Theme & Graphics in Ghost of Dead

If Play’n GO is known for one thing, it’s the Rich Wilde series. These slots further popularized the “Book of” format, originally developed by Novomatic. Although its Ghost of Dead slot doesn’t feature the erstwhile explorer, it still adopts one of the industry’s most popular slot themes — Ancient Egypt.

Unless you’re completely new to video slots, you’re sure to have seen at least one similar game in the past. This particular release does at least try to be a little scarier than most, set in an eerie, spider web-ridden tomb.

The music is equally creepy and the game’s sound effects echo ominously around the crypt. There’s also a ghost that haunts the scatter symbol, making an appearance during one of the free spins rounds. Ultimately though, it all looks and feels a lot like countless other slots.

Ghost of Dead Slot Features

At this stage of our Ghost of Dead review, it’s time to explore deeper into the game’s various features.

Regular Symbols

Nine regular symbols feature in the paytable, and the four highest-paying examples are very much in keeping with the theme. The ankh and Egyptian cobra both return a maximum of 600 coins for five on a payline, with the scarab beetle offering up to 1,600. However, the pharaoh’s mask is the most valuable, paying as much as 10,000 coins for five-of-a-kind.

Five lower-paing playing cards round things off, with the Q, J and 10 returning between four and 80 coins each. The A and K pay slightly better, with up to 120 coins on offer.

Wild and Scatters

Like all of the Play’n GO “Book of” games, the scatter doubles as a wild that can substitute for normal symbols to create wins. However, there are two scatters in this slot. Both are canopic jars, which the Ancient Egyptians used to mummify dead bodies.

One scatter is perfectly ordinary, but it can randomly turn “spectral” on any given spin and begin to glow green. Find three or more regular scatters to trigger Free Spins, while the Spectral Scatters unlock a special Awakened Free Spins game.

Ghost Spin

Something else which can randomly trigger on any base game round is the Ghost Spin. Here, a symbol is arbitrarily selected by the titular specter. If it’s able to create winning combinations, it will expand and cover a full reel.

Gamble

The Ghost of Dead slot also offers you the chance to gamble your prize after any winning spin. Simply guess the suit or color of the hidden playing card to increase your win by 4x or 2x. The game is entirely optional, of course, and you can collect at any time.

Free Spins

Collect three or more regular scatters to earn ten free spins. Before they begin, you’ll choose one of three symbols to act as the special expanding symbol throughout. These enable you to create winning combinations across reels which are not adjacent to one another.

Land three more scatters during the bonus game to retrigger the feature with a further ten spins.

Awakened Free Spins

These are triggered whenever you find three or more Spectral Scatters. They play out largely in the same manner as the regular spins, only a ghost will choose an extra expanding symbol for you.

A win of 8 coins can become 16 or 32 during the gamble feature. The last result, shown beneath the card, was a red diamond.

How to Play Ghost of Dead Online

Before we wrap up our Ghost of Dead review, let’s quickly run through how to play. First, use the plus and minus icons to set a stake and toggle the number of active paylines from one to ten. Tap the circular arrows in the bottom-right corner to spin, or use up to 100 auto plays via the orange button.

The idea is simple enough: land matching symbols on a payline from left to right to secure a prize. You’ll need at least three of the low-payers and two of the more valuable symbols. Collecting three of either scatter triggers the corresponding free spins bonus.

Try the Ghost of Dead Demo for Free before playing for real money

We strongly advise playing our free Ghost of Dead demonstration game before heading to a real money casino. Even if the game seems straightforward, you may be caught out by an unfamiliar feature or rule. Testing free slots before risking money is always a good idea.

Ghost of Dead Review – Our Final Verdict

All in all, this is a solid addition to the Play’n GO catalog. Fans of Rich Wilde and other “Book of” slots will definitely want to give it a try, as will history lovers. It’s easy on the eye, too. But in truth, there’s not much going on that you won’t have already seen.

The random Ghost Spin is a minor but welcome addition to the usual format. It keeps things interesting while waiting for free spins, which can take a frustratingly long time to appear due to the game’s high variance.

There’s a bit of something for everyone, though. Smaller-staking players will appreciate the variable paylines and low betting limits, if not the high volatility. While the 10,000x top prize is sufficiently tempting to stick around.

Cat Wilde and the Lost Chapter: Rich hands the baton to his daughter in this 96.20% RTP game with a 10,000x max win.

Book of Ra: Novomatic’s 2008 release had a big influence on Book of Dead and played a huge role in popularizing the “Book of” format.

Santa's Slay is a casino slot from Reel Kingdom that turns the Christmas cheer into a high-volatility snowstorm of excitement. Base Game

Theme, Gameplay & Payouts

Santa's Slay is a video slot from Reel Kingdom featuring 5 reels, 4 rows, and 10 paylines. The reels are placed to the right, and to the left stands a reindeer wearing a Santa's hat. The reels spin to the sound of a slow, heartwarming Christmas tune with soft bells, making it feel like you're sitting by the fireplace with a hot drink while hoping Santa brings you something shiny. Wins are formed by landing three or more matching symbols on one of the paylines, starting on the first reel to the left. You can access Santa's Slay from pretty much anywhere since the game is available across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

You can win up to 2,000x the bet.

What features are available in the slot Santa's Slay?

The features are Wild Symbol, Free Spins, Ante Bet, and Feature Buy.

Wild Symbol

The Ante Bet lets you double your total bet to increase the number of Scatter symbols that appear on the reels, giving you a higher chance of triggering the bonus round.

Feature Buy

If you don't feel like waiting at all, you can jump right into the Free Spins by purchasing the feature for 100x your current total bet. When you buy it, 3, 4, or 5 Scatter symbols are guaranteed to land on the triggering spin, instantly starting the feature.

The Wilds become even better in the Free Spins, where they can become sticky and stack up multipliers.

We found ourselves getting pulled into the atmosphere quickly with the sounds of gentle bells and a warm background melody. Building up the size and value of the Mystery Egg is what this game is all about, and when it drops it transforms all underlying symbols into a randomly selected matching symbol. A single cluster payout of 1,000x your stake is also possible without any egg or multiplier action, so things can certainly get interesting when the egg is boosted.Every win triggers the Tumble feature, which removes all winning symbols from the grid. This creates a gap that’s filled with existing and/or new symbols dropping down from above, and the process goes on as long as you keep landing new winning clusters.The Progressive Egg Feature is triggered whenever you land a 4-leaf clover or watering can symbol anywhere in sight. The watering can increase the size of the egg symbol that will drop later, and the egg can be as big as 6x6. The 4-leaf clover on the other hand, increases the multiplier value from x2 up to x10 at the most.At the end of a tumble sequence, the egg drops to a random marked position, turning all symbols involved into a random matching symbol. If this leads to a win, the payout will be boosted by whatever multiplier value you’ve managed to rack up. The hen on the right-hand side holds up a sign that shows your egg size and multiplier progress, and everything resets once the tumble sequence is over.You trigger the Bonus Round whenever you land 4, 5 or 6 scatters anywhere in view, and this awards 10, 15 or 20 free spins, respectively. Landing 4+ scatters anywhere awards +5 extra spins, and there is no cap on the number of retriggers you can get. Non-UK players can purchase the bonus round from the in-game menu for 100x the total stake.We have included a couple of longer Egg upgrade sequences from the base game, before the bonus round is triggered at 2:34 into the 6-minute highlights video. These are well worth a watch, as they give you a good impression of what the base game is capable of. See how it all played out by hitting the play button below.The Progressive Egg system Pragmatic Play has come up with in Chicken Drop is kind of clever. They tend to avoid falling for the temptation of simply copying Play’n Go’s grid slot system, where symbol collection triggers modifiers. It can be hard to get into longer tumble sequences where the egg and/or multiplier grows significantly in the base game, but this is to be expected in a highly volatile game.This all changes in the bonus round however, as you’ll now get an Egg drop at the end of each spin sequence, and the Egg attributes don’t reset between spins. It comes with random sticky wild respins, but the big highlight is the bonus round where the carrot-munching rabbit wild can grow up to 5x5 in size, and thus cover the entire grid. This awards the game’s max win of 2,000x your stake.The Great Chicken Escape - is a fun and feature rich Pragmatic Play farm slot where the ‘soldier chickens’ are plotting their escape. Our Scales of Dead review takes an in-depth look at the latest title in the famed Book of Dead series from Play’n Go. The award-winning developer once again takes us treasure hunting in ancient Egypt, courtesy of this September 2023 release.

Lucky players can claim up to 10,000x in this high volatility slot. You’ll uncover many features to help you achieve this, including wilds, scatters and two free spins games. Read on to discover more.

Basic Details of the Scales of Dead Slot

Scales of Dead Details, RTP and Volatility

The Scales of Dead slot expands on the popular Rich Wilde series, notably Book of Dead, from Play’n Go. As such, it follows the typical 5×3 reel layout with 10 fixed paylines.

The optimal RTP is pegged at a slightly-above-average value of 96.21%. However, some online casinos use lesser figures of 94.21%, 91.21%, 87.21% and 84.21%. Wherever you opt to play, it’s possible to do so from $0.10 up to $100 per spin.

Scales of Dead features a high level of volatility, awarded a 9/10 rating by the provider, so don’t expect frequent payouts. However, if you do land a winning combination, it can be highly rewarding – up to 10,000x, in fact.

Theme & Graphics in Scales of Dead

Scales of Dead features a typically Egyptian theme. Upon loading the game, you’re immediately greeted by a dramatic score and a sandy background, with the famous pyramids off to the left. The reels quickly cover this scene, but they fit the theme perfectly.

Expect to see plenty of gold, for instance, while the lower-paying playing card symbols are styled to look like hieroglyphs. There’s a lot of detail in these symbols, especially the representations of Anubis and Horus.

Another nice touch is the tomb symbol, with its flickering torches burning brightly either side. But then we’ve come to expect this sort of thing from a top-class developer like Play’n GO.

The base game with its 5×3 reel setup. The green spin button is visible by the autoplay button in the bottom-right corner.

Scales of Dead Slot Features

Play’n Go has incorporated many rewarding features into this slot, including wilds, free spins and a gamble feature. The following section of our Scales of Dead review will now cover these in more detail.

Regular Symbols

There are ten symbols in total. The traditional playing cards A through 10 represent the lowest-paying regular symbols. You’ll earn between 8x and 15x your total wager whenever you match five on a payline, with 0.4x to 0.5 for three-of-a-kind.

In contrast, the higher-paying symbols are represented by a Cobra, Anubis, Horus and an Ankh. The Cobra pays the highest, supplying up to 500x when you land five. With all of these symbols, you only need two to earn a prize.

Wilds

The tomb featuring a golden snake is the wild symbol. It can substitute any other regular symbol to complete a winning combination. Landing between two and five on the reels earns you 1x, 10x, 100x and 500x your wager, respectively.

Scatters

The same snake tomb symbol also serves as the Scales of Dead scatter. Landing three or more scatters on the reels triggers the free spins round.

Free Spins Feature

This round begins with eight free spins, with one regular symbol transforming into a special expanding symbol. Rack up enough and they’ll expand, covering the reels and triggering bigger payouts.

Sandstorm Feature

Landing two scatter symbols during the free spins game activates the Sandstorm bonus feature. Here, you’ll receive four Sandstorm free spins, with multipliers of up to 4x. You can retrigger this feature with a further two scatters, allowing up to 30 free spins.

Gamble Feature

Introduction to Fat Cats DoubleMax

Fat Cats DoubleMax is a casino slot from Reflex Gaming that aims to deliver on classy spins and volatile potential. While we wouldn’t exactly call them the epitome of healthy pets, there’s no denying that many see a certain cuteness in chubby felines. However, in Fat Cats DoubleMax, these cats are no pets, as we find ourselves in one of their manors, where we see fat stacks of cash and gold bars just lying around. Cats aside, as you can see in the title, this is a DoubleMax release, meaning it’s a Cascade and Win Multiplier-centric release, and works similarly to the many other prior DoubleMax releases, such as The Runemakers DoubleMax or Diamond Symphony DoubleMax. Outside of this feature, we have a game filled with GigaBlox Symbols, randomly triggering Reel Bonuses, and a simple, yet volatile Free Spins bonus game. All of this comes together into a potentially explosive game with a max win of 10,000X the bet.

Reflex Gaming comes with a rather standard DoubleMax release, where Multiplier, Cascades, Gigablox, and Reel Bonuses combine to deliver volatile wins.

Base Game

Theme, Gameplay, & Payouts

Fat Cats DoubleMax is a video slot from Reflex Gaming with 5 Reels, 5 Rows, and 50 Paylines. You can choose between making a Min.bet of 0.1 and a Max.bet of 100. Fat Cats DoubleMax comes with an average RTP of 96%, a hit frequency of 24.08%, high volatility, and a good max win of 10,000X the bet.

As mentioned earlier, Fat Cats DoubleMax is set in a fancy, extravagant mansion, presumably owned by one of the cats, as evidenced by the many paintings in the background. On top of this, as we enter the bonus game, we’re welcomed inside the man’s vault, where rows of stacked gold bars can be seen, further alluding to the fact that these fat cats have fat stacks. You can play the game on most notepads, mobiles, and desktops.

Winning combinations can be made by landing 3 or more of the same symbols in adjacent rows, starting from the leftmost row, thus creating a payline. The lower-paying symbols are 10, J, Q, K, and A. Creating a win with 5 of the same symbols will pay out 0.3X to 0.4X the bet. The higher-paying symbols are cats with various backgrounds, including the blue cat, green cat, purple cat, orange cat, and red cat. Landing a win with 5 of the same symbols pays out 0.5X to 1.5X the bet. When it comes to Special Symbols, we have Wilds and Scatters, which we will discuss in more detail in the next section.

Special Features & Mechanics

What is the max win in the slot Fat Cats DoubleMax?

You can win up to 10,000X the bet.

What features are available in the slot Fat Cats DoubleMax?

The features are Wild Symbols, Cascades, Gigablox, DoubleMax Multiplier, Reel Bonuses, Free Spins, Ante Bet, and Feature Buy.

Free Spins

Wild Symbols

Wild Symbols help form winning combinations by being able to substitute for all symbols except Scatter Symbols. Each time a winning combination is made, a Wild Symbol will be created.

Cascades

Whenever a winning combination is formed, the Cascade mechanic activates, removing the winning symbols and allowing new symbols to fall from above, potentially creating new winning combinations.

Gigablox

Paying Symbols have a chance to appear in Gigablox form, increasing their size to 2x2 or 3x3.

DoubleMax Multiplier

A DoubleMax Multiplier sits next to the playing grid, with a Multiplier Value that starts at 1X and doubles with each win. The DoubleMax Multiplier is added to all wins and reset between spins in the base game.

Reel Bonuses

There are three types of Reel Bonuses that can randomly trigger as you spin, and they are as follows:

The Golden Claw = Can trigger on any random losing spin, moves a Gigablox symbol to reel 1 to form a win.

Champagne = Can trigger on any random losing spin, converts a full reel to one of the same symbols to guarantee a winning combination.

Paw Slap = Will randomly upgrade the DoubleMax Multiplier by 1 to 5 steps.

By landing 3, 4, or 5 Scatter Symbols, you will be awarded the Free Spins feature with 7, 10, or 12 spins. The bonus game starts with a 1X DoubleMax Multiplier and doesn’t reset between spins.

Feature Buy

Ante Bet

By turning on the Ante Bet, you increase your chances of triggering the Free Spins feature, but at the cost of increasing your current bet by 30%.

Through the Feature Buy, you can instantly enter the bonus game for a price based on the current bet.

100X = Awards the Free Spins feature.

Final Thoughts on Fat Cats DoubleMax

Fat Cats DoubleMax is, on a gameplay level, an enjoyable slot experience, but it definitely isn’t trying to reinvent the wheel, as it comes with a relatively standard and familiar package of features. However, if we turn to its visuals and theme, the game does get a bit more disappointing. While we understand not every player cares about these things, we do believe they serve as important tools to immerse, engage, and interest players. On that end, Reflex Gaming definitely dropped the ball, as Fat Cats DoubleMax is a pretty ugly game compared to most other modern releases, and its theme isn’t exactly something we’re dying to play, as it isn’t all that interesting.

Gameplay-wise, just as we said earlier, Fat Cats DoubleMax is an enjoyable experience. However, it doesn’t bring anything new to the table, and, coupled with its more-than-lackluster visuals and theme, the game feels quite forgettable. That isn’t to say that its spins are bad, as we have to give Reflex Gaming credit for delivering on a very volatile and potentially explosive release. This actually comes down to how well the features work together, as the progressive Multiplier and Cascade mechanics are the core, while the rest of the features are mostly there to keep the spins rolling, whether it’s Gigablox or Reel Bonuses. This is all then capped off with the Free Spins bonus game, where the persistent Multiplier shines, which is where the volatile nature of the game comes from. All in all, we still believe Fat Cats DoubleMax has a solid enough gameplay loop, but we wish we saw something that actually stood out, and that’s not counting the ugly visuals. But if you’re a fan of DoubleMax releases, or just want to experience a game about fat cats and fat stacks, then this might be a game worth checking out.

Fat Cats DoubleMax is a slot that doesn’t try to be anything unique when it comes to its features, instead relying on familiar DoubleMax Multiplier and Cascade mechanics with complementary features to help keep the wins growing.

Of course, it resets per paid spin, and you’ll also land occasional expanding wilds to help top up your balance. Your chances of cracking the decent 10,000x potential increases in the hard-to-trigger (1 in 420 spins) bonus round, but you’re compensated by a surprisingly solid 1 in 3,039,514 max win probability.The Wild symbol can land on reels 2 to 6 only, and it steps in for all regular pay symbols to help complete winning combinations. The Wild holds no value of its own however, and the premium gem symbols pay between 1.5 and 25 x your stake for 6 on a payline. All winning symbols are removed via the Tumble mechanic, and new and/or existing symbols drop down to fill the gaps. This process repeats as long as you keep winning, and you can thus get indefinite extra wins per spin.The previously mentioned Wild symbols will expand to cover the entire reel whenever they land, and this Expanding Wild feature is active both in the base game and during the bonus round. Each Tumble win increases the win multiplier by +1, but the multiplier resets to x1 between paid spins in the base game.The Bonus Round is triggered when you land 4, 5 or 6 scatters, and this awards a scatter payout of 5, 10 or 100 x your stake up front. You also get 12, 16 or 20 free spins, respectively, and the biggest difference from the base game is that the unlimited progressive win multiplier does not reset between spins. The wilds still expand, and you get +5 extra spins when you land 3+ scatters anywhere within the same free spin tumble sequence.Depending on your jurisdiction, a Bonus Buy option may be available. This feature is not available for UK players for sure, but it’s something to consider since the bonus round triggers only once in 420 base game spins on average. Purchasing the feature sets you back 80x your stake, and you’re then guaranteed 3+ scatters on the spin that follows.You get to see a few okay base game top-up wins, before we trigger the bonus round with 5 scatters close to the 1-minute mark. Adding an increasing tumble win multiplier to the base game is a decent touch though, and not something you see all that often with this engine.It combines well with the tried and tested expanding wilds, although larger payouts are more likely to happen in the bonus round where the multiplier just keeps building. The Pay All and Boost rewards will give you huge bet and win multipliers, while the Double Up reward will double your payout.Land 3 or more Biker Bash Scatters to get to the Biker Bash feature. Retriggers are possible as well – just get 3 or more extra Biker Bash Scatters and you’ll get 10 extra free spins!Finally, there’s also the Wild Ride feature. It’s an ambitious release and one that even boasts a massive 10,136x jackpot. The theoretical RTP isn’t particularly good, but that’s the only objective minus that we were able to find in the entire package. It’s just so much fun overall that we simply have to recommend it to all players that like the idea of following a gang of motorbike pigs around!

The chef on the left-hand side is charming enough as well, and he knows how to cut and slice like a pro.There is slicing and cutting going on in all stages of this game, as the main feature is the Two-For-One Symbol Splitting. This happens to random symbols per spin, and it’s your best shot at landing larger payouts due to the rather modest symbol values. Sliced symbols count as two symbols when part of a win, and this increases the number of win ways up to 1,000, at best.Symbols will sometimes land with a fluorescent wasabi icon attached, and you need 3 of those in view to trigger the Bonus Round.
